items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 107年會考
items.prompt: NBN NEWS------------------------------------------------------------------------ Ryan Kim 7/15/2013 Guesses about Carolyn Cole have been flying around since last week, and now things have taken a new turn. Last week Carolyn Cole won the Inscriber Prize, the country’s biggest book prize, with her book Paper Soldier. Cole herself did not show up for the prize. It was not only the first time in history that a first-time writer won the prize, but also the first time that the winner did not appear. Now here comes another “first time” for the Inscriber： Cole is not real. “She” is in fact Thomas Goode. Goode is known for his picture books. His best-known book, Blue Moon, won him two national book prizes and sold over one million copies. Goode had tried to write “serious” books before. His first try was Parent, which came out in 2006. Sadly, Goode’s big name did not help, and there was little interest in Parent. Goode’s friend told NBN that he wanted to write a book under a different name. Goode thought that people might treat his book seriously if they did not know it was from a picture book writer. For the moment, there has been no word from Goode yet.【107教育會考】（ ）1. From the news story, which fact is seen as “a new turn”? (A) Carolyn Cole is a first-time writer. (B) Carolyn Cole won the Inscriber Prize. (C) Carolyn Cole is not the winner’s real name. (D) Carolyn Cole did not appear for the Inscriber Prize.（ ）2. Which is most likely true about the Inscriber Prize? likely 可能 (A) It was started by NBN News. (B) It is a new prize for picture books. (C) It is a prize only for first-time writers. (D) It is treated seriously by writers in the country.（ ）3. What can we learn about Thomas Goode? (A) He has won the Inscriber Prize twice. (B) He told NBN that Paper Solider was his work. (C) He wants to be more than just a picture book writer. (D) His life as a picture book writer has not been successful.（ ）4. What do we know about Thomas Goode’s books? (A) The sales of Parent were bad. (B) Paper Soldier is his best-selling book. (C) His first picture book came out in 2006. (D) Blue Moon was written under a different name.
choices: Carolyn Cole is a first-time writer.
Carolyn Cole won the Inscriber Prize.
Carolyn Cole is not the winner’s real name.
Carolyn Cole did not appear for the Inscriber Prize.（ ）2. Which is most likely true about the Inscriber Prize? likely 可能
It was started by NBN News.
It is a new prize for picture books.
It is a prize only for first-time writers.
It is treated seriously by writers in the country.（ ）3. What can we learn about Thomas Goode?
He has won the Inscriber Prize twice.
He told NBN that Paper Solider was his work.
He wants to be more than just a picture book writer.
His life as a picture book writer has not been successful.（ ）4. What do we know about Thomas Goode’s books?
The sales of Parent were bad.
Paper Soldier is his best-selling book.
His first picture book came out in 2006.
Blue Moon was written under a different name.
items.explanation: 1. 關鍵字是本句裡的「現在」，第二段描述的都是過去一週的事情，第三段才是「現在」新發生的事情，也就是「Carolyn Cole 其實不是作者的真名」，故選 (C)。2. 第二段第一句的同位語指出 Inscriber Prize 是該國最大的書籍獎項，表示此獎項「在該國受到作家們的重視」，故選 (D)。3. 第三段指出 Thomas Goode 以繪本作家的身分聞名，第四段指出他其實早就想寫嚴肅題材的書籍，並且希望讀者能接受，與選項 (C)「他希望不只是當一名繪本作家」相符，故選之。4. 第四段第三句提到「人們對《家長》一書並不感興趣」可推知，「《家長》一書銷售不佳」，故選 (A)。

items.prompt: Jenny’s bag is very heavy because filled with toy cars.【106教育會考】(A) it is (B) they are (C) there is (D) there are
items.explanation: 依句子結構，because 引導的副詞子句缺主詞，故不會選形成存在句的 (C) 或 (D)；依句意，Jenny 的「袋子」會沉重的原因是因為「袋子」裡塞滿了玩具車，而 Jenny 的「袋子 (bag)」為單數，故選 (A)，讓 it 代替前面提到過的 Jenny’s bag。

items.prompt: Below is an infographic.【111教育會考】 infographic 資訊圖表（ ）1. What can we learn about sugar from the infographic? (A) There are 4 g of sugar in 66 g of ice cream. (B) A woman can eat as much sugar a day as a man can. (C) Taiwan eats more sugar for each person than the US does. (D) 400 ml of rice milk has less sugar than 400 ml of grape juice.（ ）2. What can be a reason why the list of “Sugar that is hidden in foods and drinks” is put in the infographic? (A) To help us understand how sugar hurts our body. (B) To show what kinds of foods and drinks are popular with children. (C) To tell us that we often have more sugar than we can without knowing it. (D) To let us know how much sugar is enough to make foods and drinks taste good.
choices: There are 4 g of sugar in 66 g of ice cream.
A woman can eat as much sugar a day as a man can.
Taiwan eats more sugar for each person than the US does.
400 ml of rice milk has less sugar than 400 ml of grape juice.（ ）2. What can be a reason why the list of “Sugar that is hidden in foods and drinks” is put in the infographic?
To help us understand how sugar hurts our body.
To show what kinds of foods and drinks are popular with children.
To tell us that we often have more sugar than we can without knowing it.
To let us know how much sugar is enough to make foods and drinks taste good.
items.explanation: 1. 從圖表可知，米漿含有 8 茶匙的糖，葡萄汁含有 12 茶匙的糖，因此 400 毫升米漿含有的糖比 400 毫升葡萄汁含有的糖少，故選 (D)。2. 左列提出每人每天可攝取的糖量及糖可能對我們身體所產生的作用，由此可推知右表「隱藏在食物和飲料的糖」最有可能是要告知我們常攝取過量的糖卻不自知，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: Here’s The Piano Lesson, one of Henri Matisse’s most famous paintings. The boy in the picture is the painter’s son, Pierre. In the picture, Pierre looks quite serious. Why? Well, look at the yellow candle on the red piano. It’s almost burned down. So maybe Pierre has already practiced for hours. And Matisse uses a lot of gray, not a very fun color, right? It shows how the poor kid feels, don’t you think? On the top right corner, you can see a woman sitting straight on a seat. Is she Pierre’s piano teacher? Or his mother? Well, if you’re a Matisse fan, you’ll know this is in fact another painting by him, Woman on a High Stool. Interesting, right? Matisse likes to do that a lot. In fact, there’s another work by Matisse in the picture. Did you find it? Right! The sculpture on the bottom left corner! Matisse painted this picture in 1916. Pierre was already 16 then, but the artist painted his son much younger than he really was. Pierre had gone away to be a soldier, and Matisse didn’t know whether he would come back. Maybe this is a worried father’s way to remember the good old days.【110教育會考】 sculpture 雕像（ ）1. What can we learn about The Piano Lesson from the reading? (A) Matisse painted it when his son was away from home. (B) The woman who sits on a seat behind the boy is his mother. (C) Matisse uses yellow and red to show that his son was happy. (D) The candle on the piano shows that the piano lesson has just begun. （ ）2. What does do that mean in the reading? (A) Put his family in his paintings. (B) Paint to remember the good old days. (C) Use a lot of fun colors in his art works. (D) Put his earlier art work in a new painting.（ ）3. What is NOT used in the reading to refer to Henri Matisse? refer to 指稱 (A) The artist. (B) The painter. (C) The poor kid. (D) A worried father.
choices: Matisse painted it when his son was away from home.
The woman who sits on a seat behind the boy is his mother.
Matisse uses yellow and red to show that his son was happy.
The candle on the piano shows that the piano lesson has just begun. （ ）2. What does do that mean in the reading?
Put his family in his paintings.
Paint to remember the good old days.
Use a lot of fun colors in his art works.
Put his earlier art work in a new painting.（ ）3. What is NOT used in the reading to refer to Henri Matisse? refer to 指稱
items.explanation: 1. (B) 該女人來自 Matisse 過去的作品，並非孩子的母親；(C) 本畫運用灰色來表現男孩的心情，而男孩看起來是嚴肅的；(D) 文中第一段根據蠟燭的燃燒狀態，推論 Pierre 已經練習數個小時了。由最後一段可知，Matisse 是在兒子去從軍之後畫了本畫，故選 (A)。2. that 用來指涉之前提過的事情，本段前面描述畫作中右上角的女子來自之前的作品《高腳凳上的女子》，且後方又給了另外一個例子，指出左下角的雕像亦為 Matisse 的作品，可推知 do that 指的是「將他較早期的作品放進新畫作中」，故選 (D)。3. 第一段的 the poor kid 指的是畫作中的男孩 Pierre，而非 Matisse，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: Joey：Lynn, have you tried Caldron? I’ve heard that restaurant is good. Lynn：I have. I went there once for Tom’s party.Joey：And?Lynn：Well, I never thought I would have to cook for myself when eating out.Joey：But it’s fun to cook your own food.Lynn：I don’t see any fun in that. Besides, I want nice food.Joey：So you didn’t like the food there?Lynn：Everything tasted the same. I mean, they were all cooked in the same boiling pot. How could they taste different? I just kept throwing strange things into the pot. I didn’t even know what half the things were made of.Joey：Don’t worry. Everything should be safe to eat after a hot bath in the pot. And you didn’t get sick after that, right? Besides, you tried something different there. Still a good experience, I think?Lynn：I don’t think we share the same idea of good experiences.【110教育會考】（ ）1. Lynn took some photos at Tom’s party. Which is most likely one of them? likely 可能 (A) (B)(C) (D)（ ）2. What can we learn about Lynn from the dialogue? (A) She does not cook. (B) She likes to try new food. (C) She did not enjoy the food at Caldron. (D) She changed Joey’s idea about Caldron.
choices: （ ）2. What can we learn about Lynn from the dialogue?
She likes to try new food.
She did not enjoy the food at Caldron.
She changed Joey’s idea about Caldron.
items.explanation: 1. 由 Lynn 第四次說話的描述可知，所有的東西都被丟進沸騰的鍋子裡一起烹煮，故選 (B)。2. (A) Lynn 只提到不想外出用餐時還要自己煮飯；(B) Lynn 只提到自己想要美味的食物，並未提到是否喜歡嘗試新菜色；(D) 對話中是 Joey 試圖改變 Lynn 對餐廳的看法；(C) 由 Lynn 第四次說話對菜色的描述，可知她不喜歡，故選 (C)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 106年會考
items.prompt: Ruth: I’ve got two tickets for a football game. The Lions vs. the Sharks, front-row seats, next Saturday. Interested? You can take Jessica to the game.Nate: How did you get the tickets?! They were all sold out months ago!Ruth: And a table for two at Leeds.Nate: Leeds?! But I called them yesterday and they said they were all booked for the year!Ruth: Now it’s yours. You and Jessica can have a lovely dinner there after the game.Nate: Wait a second. This is just not like you. What’s the catch?Ruth: Well, you know this Friday I’m leaving for my vacation in London, and….Nate: And what? Ruth: And I was thinking if Charlie could stay with you next week.Nate: The whole week?!Ruth: Please! I can’t just leave him in my apartment.Nate: You know I hate that stupid dog! And he hates me too.Ruth: Please! You’re my last hope.Nate: I need to think about it.Ruth: OK, but not too long. book 訂位【106教育會考】（ ）1. What does the catch mean in the dialogue? (A) A plan that starts well but ends badly. (B) A fact that everyone knows but never talks about. (C) A problem that is hidden behind something good. (D) An action that is right in one way but wrong in another.（ ）2. What does it mean in the dialogue? (A) Taking care of Charlie. (B) Having dinner with Jessica. (C) Going to the football game. (D) Going to London for vacation.（ ）3. What do we know from the dialogue? (A) Ruth will go to London next Saturday. (B) Ruth had trouble booking a hotel room in London. (C) Nate is the first person that Ruth thought of for help. (D) Nate is surprised that Ruth was able to book a table at Leeds.
choices: A plan that starts well but ends badly.
A fact that everyone knows but never talks about.
A problem that is hidden behind something good.
An action that is right in one way but wrong in another.（ ）2. What does it mean in the dialogue?
Going to London for vacation.（ ）3. What do we know from the dialogue?
Ruth will go to London next Saturday.
Ruth had trouble booking a hotel room in London.
Nate is the first person that Ruth thought of for help.
Nate is surprised that Ruth was able to book a table at Leeds.
items.explanation: 1. Nate 發現 Ruth 的表現一點也不像 Ruth（This is just not like you.），可推論 Nate 開始懷疑 Ruth 突然對他這麼好，裡頭一定「有問題」，故選 (C)。2. 由 Nate 的倒數第二次說話可知 Nate 與 Ruth 的狗 Charlie 彼此討厭對方，所以 Nate 需要考慮的是到底要不要幫 Ruth 「照顧 Charlie」一個星期，故選 (A)。3. 由 Ruth 與 Nate 第六～八行對話可知，Nate 對於 Ruth 可以在 Leeds 訂到位子感到訝異，故選 (D)。另，Ruth 提到本週五去倫敦，故不選 (A)；Ruth 本週五就要到倫敦了，所以在飯店訂房上應該沒有問題，故不選 (B)；由對話倒數第三行可知，Nate 是 Ruth 拜託的最後一個人，故不選 (C)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 106年會考
items.prompt: Cinema TimesJune 5th, 2005 Thanks to globalization, we get to see movies from around the world. If anyone should feel most excited about globalization, it is US movie makers. A study in 2001 shows that, for every 100 people who go to the theater, 85 see US movies. This may be good news for US movie makers, but not for those in other countries. Chart 1 shows the percentages (%) of US movies in five countries in 1984 and in 2001; Chart 2 shows the percentages (%) of domestic movies in the five countries in 1984 and in 2001. In Chart 1, we can see that US movies have been popular in foreign markets. In Chart 2, we can see that domestic movies in the five countries are not doing well in their domestic market. The falling market for domestic movies may be a serious problem, but there is something more important. When people welcome US movies with open arms, they in fact also say yes to the American way of thinking. Some people in these countries worry that what is lost may not just be their domestic market for domestic movies, but also their own way of thinking that has been passed down from parents to children. globalization 全球化 domestic 當地的；國產的；本國的【106教育會考】（ ）1. What does the report say about globalization’s influence on the movie world? (A) It has changed the way of making movies. influence 影響 (B) It has changed a country’s domestic market for movies. (C) It has brought together movie makers from around the world. (D) It has helped US movies make more money abroad than in the US.（ ）2. What can we learn from the report? (A) The American way of thinking may be changed when it is brought to other countries. (B) More and more people are asking their country to help their domestic movie business. (C) US movies are popular in foreign markets because English is spoken in many countries. (D) The fact that US movies are popular may mean the American way of thinking is popular.（ ）3. From the charts, which is true? (A) The percentage (%) of US movies has changed the least in Spain. (B) In each of the five countries, the percentage (%) of domestic movies has fallen. (C) Of all five countries, UK’s domestic movies have the smallest drop in percentage (%). (D) When the percentage (%) of domestic movies drops, the percentage of US movies rises.
choices: It has changed the way of making movies. influence 影響
It has changed a country’s domestic market for movies.
It has brought together movie makers from around the world.
It has helped US movies make more money abroad than in the US.（ ）2. What can we learn from the report?
The American way of thinking may be changed when it is brought to other countries.
More and more people are asking their country to help their domestic movie business.
US movies are popular in foreign markets because English is spoken in many countries.
The fact that US movies are popular may mean the American way of thinking is popular.（ ）3. From the charts, which is true?
items.explanation: 1. 文章第一段指出全球化的影響，讓美國電影席捲全球，第二段則延續說明這影響排擠了各國自己的電影，造成各國國產電影在自己的市場上比率下降，有人擔心因此而導致自己文化思想的消失。與上述內容最接近的為選項 (B) 全球化對世界電影的影響是「改變了一個國家的電影市場」，故選之。2. 選項 (A)、(B)、(C) 均未在文章中提到，只有選項 (D) 「美國電影受歡迎的這事實也許代表了美式思考方式也受到了歡迎」與第二段倒數第二句話意思相符，故選之。3. 選項 (A)「美國電影的百分比在 Spain 的變化最少」，Spain 的變化是 +9%，應該是 UK 的 -7% 變化最少；選項 (B)「五個國家中，每個國家的國產電影百分比都下降了」與 Chart 2 的趨勢相符；選項 (C)「五個國家中，UK 國產電影下降的百分比最少」，UK 下降了 12%，應該是 Germany 的 1% 最少；選項 (D)「當國產電影百分比下降時，美國電影的百分比上升」，與 UK 的情況不符。因此本題答案為選項 (B)。

items.prompt: Our Pinky Street, one of the oldest streets in the world, was almost lost to a big fire last night. Most of the old houses on Pinky were burned down. The living history we are proud of is dying. But we should never give up. Pinky is like a parent, always there caring for our town. Now we must do something together to get the old Pinky back. There will be a meeting at 2：00 this Saturday afternoon at Town Office. Anyone who wants to help is welcome. Let’s see what we can do.Adam Bolton, Town OfficeMarch 9【105教育會考】（ ）1. What is the reading for? (A) Finding out why the old street was on fire. (B) Inviting people to do business on the old street. (C) Getting people to find ways to save the old street. (D) Asking for help for people who got hurt in the fire.（ ）2. Which is NOT used in the reading to talk about the old street? (A) A good friend. (B) The old Pinky. (C) A parent. (D) A living history.
choices: Finding out why the old street was on fire.
Inviting people to do business on the old street.
Getting people to find ways to save the old street.
Asking for help for people who got hurt in the fire.（ ）2. Which is NOT used in the reading to talk about the old street?
items.explanation: 1. 文章最後四句點出本文的主要目的為開會（a meeting），會中要一起討論如何（Let’s see what we can do）找回以往的 Pinky Street （to get the old Pinky back），故選 (C)。2. 選項 (A)「一個好朋友」未在文中出現；選項 (B)「老 Pinky」在文章第六句；選項 (C)「一個家長」在文章第五句；選項 (D)「一個活歷史」在文章第三句。故選 (A)。

items.unit: 106年會考
items.prompt: When you need to see a doctor, surely you will want to see a good one. But there is one important thing you may never have thought about: Has your doctor rested enough? Doctors in our country often have to work 34 hours or longer without sleep. Most of them work 104 hours a week, and some even 150. (There are only 168 hours a week!) One report said that a doctor who works such long hours cannot think more clearly than a drunk driver. Another found that doctors who sleep 5.8 fewer hours than the week before might make 22% more serious mistakes. Surely no one wants to get in a car that is driven by a drunk driver. So, how safe would you feel when you are under the care of a tired doctor? Sadly this problem has been around for a long time. There are no laws about it yet and hospital bosses don’t look like they care either. And that is why we doctors are asking you to join us on the street this Sunday. Fight together with us on the street so we can fight better for your life in the hospital. Time: 1 p.m. May 2nd Place: City Hospital Square drunk 酒醉的 law 法律【106教育會考】（ ）1. What is this reading for? (A) Telling people rules about hospital visits. (B) Getting people to stand up and speak for doctors. (C) Telling people how to find a good doctor for themselves. (D) Getting doctors to share their experiences in saving lives.（ ）2. What does this problem mean in the reading? (A) Doctors’ long working hours. (B) Doctors’ problems with nurses. (C) Doctors do not see enough people a day. (D) Doctors are not paid enough for their work.
choices: Telling people rules about hospital visits.
Getting people to stand up and speak for doctors.
Telling people how to find a good doctor for themselves.
Getting doctors to share their experiences in saving lives.（ ）2. What does this problem mean in the reading?
Doctors do not see enough people a day.
Doctors are not paid enough for their work.
items.explanation: 1. 本篇文章的目的在最後一段—邀請讀者於本週日加入醫生們的行列，一起上街抗議，為醫生說話，故選 (B)。2. 此處的 problem 便是文章在第一段提出的問題：「醫生休息夠了嗎？」，第二段則是補充說明這問題的癥結是「醫生的工作時間過長」。因此本題選 (A)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 103年會考
items.prompt: （Six people are being interviewed about the garden on the roof of their building.）Jasmine：I loved the idea when Wilber first told me about it. We had lots of meetings with our neighbors, trying to make them understand why it’s good to build a garden on the roof. Now people love coming here, and it’s helped many of us become friends!Wilber：The whole thing wasn’t easy at first. But Jasmine helped a lot. And she was really good at making people happy to give money for the roof garden.David：My kids love going up there. They sit there watching butterflies and birds. The roof garden brings them closer to nature.Samuel：You want something green? Visit the park! It’s only one block away! After the roof garden was built, bugs started flying into my apartment! And the kids leave mud on the stairs when they come down from the roof!Rosie：Our building is now cooler in the summer. My baby sleeps well even on hot summer days!Flora：Guess where these tomatoes are from! Not from the supermarket. They’re from our roof! Isn’t that wonderful? roof 屋頂【103教育會考】（ ）1. What do we know about the six people in the interview? (A) They all said good things about the roof garden. (B) Some of them were paid to help build the roof garden. (C) They all talked about the roof garden before it was built. (D) Some of them worked on the plan to build the roof garden.（ ）2. Which of the good things about the roof garden is NOT talked about in the interview? (A) It brings people in the building closer together. (B) It uses the rainwater that falls on the top of the building. (C) It makes the building a more comfortable place during summer. (D) It gives people in the building a chance to grow their own food.（ ）3. What does the whole thing mean in the interview? (A) Having meetings at the roof garden. (B) Taking care of the roof garden every day. (C) Having people agree to the idea of the roof garden. (D) Inviting people to make more use of the roof garden.
choices: They all said good things about the roof garden.
Some of them were paid to help build the roof garden.
They all talked about the roof garden before it was built.
Some of them worked on the plan to build the roof garden.（ ）2. Which of the good things about the roof garden is NOT talked about in the interview?
It brings people in the building closer together.
It uses the rainwater that falls on the top of the building.
It makes the building a more comfortable place during summer.
It gives people in the building a chance to grow their own food.（ ）3. What does the whole thing mean in the interview?
Having meetings at the roof garden.
Taking care of the roof garden every day.
Having people agree to the idea of the roof garden.
Inviting people to make more use of the roof garden.
items.explanation: 1. 選項 (A)「所有人都說屋頂花園的好話。」六個受訪人中，Samuel 並沒有說好話，故不符；選項 (B)「有些人收錢協助蓋屋頂花園。」只說讓人欣然出錢，並未說有付錢讓人協助，故不符；選項 (C)「所有人都在蓋屋頂花園之前談論過它。」並未在訪談中提及，故不符；選項 (D)「有些人執行蓋屋頂花園的計畫。」由六人訪談中可明確知道 Jasmine 與 Wilber 是執行計畫的人，與敘述相符。故本題選 (D)。 2. 選項 (A)「它讓公寓裡人們更靠近。」符合 Jasmine 說的話；選項 (B)「它利用落在公寓頂上的雨水。」未在訪問中提到；選項 (C)「它讓公寓在夏季成為較舒適的地方。」符合 Rosie 說的話；選項 (D)「它給公寓裡的人們機會種自己的食物。」符合 Flora 說的話。故本題選 (B)。 3. 由 at first（起先；開始時）可判斷 Wilber 指的是蓋屋頂花園這件事情，再由 Wilber 所承接的 Jasmine 訪談內容可得知，他們的確花了點力氣 trying to make them understand why it’s good to build a garden on the roof（試著讓他們的鄰居理解為何在屋頂蓋花園是件好事），故選 (C)。選項 (A)、(B)、(D) 並未在整個訪談中提到。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 105年會考
items.prompt: 【105教育會考】（ ）1. What does IT in picture 7 mean? (A) Rule 22 is easy to follow. (B) Anyone can die at any time. (C) Flying airplanes is dangerous. (D) The soldier has become crazy.（ ）2. What can we learn from the comics? (A) The doctor tried several ways to help the soldier. (B) The soldier cared about his life more than his job. (C) The soldier went to ask the doctor about Rule 22. (D) The use of “catch-22” appeared before Joseph Heller’s book.（ ）3. From the comics, which is most likely an example of “catch-22”? likely 可能 (A) I need to go to hospital, but there are no hospitals near my house. (B) I need my key to open the door of my house, but I left my key at school. (C) I need some special experience to get this job, but I can’t get this kind of experience except from this job. (D) I want to go out with Jennifer on New Year’s Day, but I’m not sure whether she wants to go out with me that day.
choices: Anyone can die at any time.
The soldier has become crazy.（ ）2. What can we learn from the comics?
The doctor tried several ways to help the soldier.
The soldier cared about his life more than his job.
The soldier went to ask the doctor about Rule 22.
The use of “catch-22” appeared before Joseph Heller’s book.（ ）3. From the comics, which is most likely an example of “catch-22”? likely 可能
I need to go to hospital, but there are no hospitals near my house.
I need my key to open the door of my house, but I left my key at school.
I need some special experience to get this job, but I can’t get this kind of experience except from this job.
I want to go out with Jennifer on New Year’s Day, but I’m not sure whether she wants to go out with me that day.
items.explanation: 1. 代名詞 it 常用來代替前一句提過的事、物，而上一句中需要醫生去相信的事情為 he (the soldier) is crazy，故選 (D)。2. 選項 (A)「醫生試了數種方式來幫助軍人」，漫畫中醫生只有解釋 Rule 22（第 22 條軍規）給軍人聽，故不符；選項 (B)「軍人在乎他的生命勝於他的工作」，第四、六格漫畫指出軍人不想死，想脫離這危險工作（get out of my dangerous job），故相符；選項 (C)「軍人去問醫生關於 Rule 22（第 22 條軍規）的事」，漫畫第六格指出軍人找醫生的目的是想知道如何脫離危險的工作，故不符；選項 (D)「catch-22（進退兩難）一詞的使用在 Joseph Heller 的書之前便已經出現」第十格漫畫指出「catch-22」一詞是在這本書問世時出現（Now people use…），故不符。因此本題選 (B)。3. 由漫畫第十格的簡圖可簡單歸納 catch-22 的意思為—目的與條件是相牴觸的狀況，最符合此狀況應為選項 (C)「我需要一些特殊經驗來得到此份工作，但這種（特殊）經驗卻只能從這工作中得到」，故選之。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 104年會考
items.prompt: NEWS HUNTKieran Hardy 11/07/2013 For years, we thought our Earth was the only blue dot up there. Now another has been found. Its name is HD189773b. HD189773b is an exoplanet, a planet outside our Solar System, and is one of the nearest exoplanets to Earth. Even so, ＿1.＿. Here’s why： It is 63 light years away. That means it is 370,440,000,000,000 miles from us. Even if we fly at 3,500 miles an hour, it will take more than 12 million years to get there. ＿2.＿：It is much bigger, it is made of gas and it is burning hot. In heat as great as 1,000°C, life is not possible. What is worse, it rains glass. If 1,000°C does not kill you, glass rain will. Even so, finding this blue giant ＿3.＿. It is the first time that we have been able to see the color of an exoplanet. The color of a planet gives us ideas about what is happening on it. While we have a long way to go before we find a new planet to live on, finding a blue dot is a good start. exoplanet 系外行星 Solar System 太陽系【104教育會考】（ ）1. (A) we cannot really call it a neighbor (B) we do not know anything about it yet (C) we might not be able to stay there for long (D) we are not sure how long it takes to get there（ ）2. (A) What’s more, it is not water that makes HD189773b look blue (B) With its blue color, HD189773b could be a second Earth for us (C) Except for its blue color, HD189773b is nothing like our home planet (D) Because of its blue color, people guess there might be life on HD189773b（ ）3. (A) gives us hope (B) took hard work (C) has changed our life (D) helps us know more about Earth
choices: we cannot really call it a neighbor
we do not know anything about it yet
we might not be able to stay there for long
we are not sure how long it takes to get there（ ）2.
What’s more, it is not water that makes HD189773b look blue
With its blue color, HD189773b could be a second Earth for us
Except for its blue color, HD189773b is nothing like our home planet
Because of its blue color, people guess there might be life on HD189773b（ ）3.
helps us know more about Earth
items.explanation: 1. 由下面幾句的解釋，可判斷這顆行星離地球真的很遙遠，要花上千萬年才能飛抵該星球（take more than 12 million years to get there），根本算不上近鄰（neighbor），故選 (A)。2. 寫作中，冒號後面通常為補充說明。由冒號後面敘述，這星球又熱（1000℃）又下玻璃雨（glass rain），生命不可能存活（life is not possible），可判斷這顆星球除了顏色，其他條件與地球完全不同。故選 (C)。3. Even so（即便如此）為轉折語氣，表示此段應該是描述找到這顆行星的好處。再由最後一關鍵詞 a good start（好的開始），可判斷，寫作者認為，找到這顆行星的同時，也帶來了希望。故選 (A)。

items.prompt: The snow last weekend stopped us from going out, so we just watched TV at home.【110教育補考】(A) common (B) enough (C) full (D) heavy
items.explanation: 會因而不能外出，應該是因為那場「大」雪，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 105年會考
items.prompt: The wind keeps blowing.The door keeps opening.Will you be with me, my dear Lucy,When I look for candyDown there in the dark, dark kitchen? The wind keeps crying.The door keeps shaking.Will you be with me, my dear Lucy,When I pick up my toy puppyOut there on the high, high balcony? Wish you could always be with meAnd make them go away with your Do-Re-Me.I remember last HalloweenThey ran away when you started to sing,“Dear Tommy, my little king,Close your eyes and have a sweet dream.” So please stay with me and singTo stop them kicking the door, riding the wind,And pulling me down to their house under the ground.They’ll go away if you sing here for me,In a voice that gets a black cat’s hair standing,The strongest legs shaking, and the window glass breaking.(ideas from Matthew Sweeney’s poem) poem 詩【105教育會考】（ ）1. Which is most likely true about the speaker in the reading? likely 可能 (A) He thinks a black cat is hiding somewhere in the house. (B) He feels lonely because he is the only child in his family. (C) He is looking for something he left somewhere in the house. (D) He is afraid of being by himself when he feels ghosts around.（ ）2. What can we learn about Lucy in the reading? (A) She keeps opening the door. (B) Her voice makes the speaker feel safe. (C) Her candy was hidden in the kitchen. (D) She was away from home last Halloween.
choices: He thinks a black cat is hiding somewhere in the house.
He feels lonely because he is the only child in his family.
He is looking for something he left somewhere in the house.
He is afraid of being by himself when he feels ghosts around.（ ）2. What can we learn about Lucy in the reading?
Her voice makes the speaker feel safe.
Her candy was hidden in the kitchen.
She was away from home last Halloween.
items.explanation: 1. 第一、二段的 Will you be with me, my dear Lucy，與第三段的 Wish you could always be with me、第四段的 So please stay with me…，可推知說話者非常希望有人陪在身邊；而第三段的 Halloween 與第四段的 under the ground 點出了希望有人陪的原因，是害怕萬聖節住在地底下，到處出沒的死人或鬼。故選 (D)。2. 第三段 They ran away when you started to sing、第四段 They’ll go away if you sing here for me 中的 they 均指說話者害怕的東西，這些東西會因為 Lucy 唱歌而離開，由此可推斷 Lucy 的歌聲能給說話者安全感，故選 (B)。

items.prompt: My ＿＿＿ hurts so much that I cannot even turn my head.【113教育會考】(A) arm(B) knee(C) neck(D) stomach
items.explanation: 由後句「無法轉頭」，推知是「脖子」痛，故選 (C)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 103年會考
items.prompt: Cecilia：Eddie’s having a tasting party this Saturday.Gloria：No!Cecilia：And we’re both invited.Gloria：No! I told you I’d never go to any of his tasting parties again!Cecilia：He said he wanted to share his newest cakes with his dearest friends.Gloria：If he sees us as his dearest friends, he should stop having tasting parties!Cecilia：Well, looks like baking really brings joy to his life.Gloria：But it takes joy away from mine! Last time I was in bed for three days after his party.Cecilia：If you hate it so much, you can just tell him.Gloria：Why do I always have to be the bad person? Remember when I woke him up from his dream of making clothes? There was a lot of crying, and he wouldn’t talk to me for moment. You do it this time.Cecilia：I can’t. How am I going to face him in our dancing classes if I tell him?Gloria：So we still have to lie at his party again?Cecilia：I’m afraid so.【103教育會考】（ ）1. What can we learn about Eddie? (A) His friends think he is a great dancer. (B) He is taking baking classes with Cecilia. (C) His friends did not like the clothes he made. (D) He did not know how to say no to his friends.（ ）2. Which is true? (A) Cecilia has not talked to Eddie for a month. (B) Cecilia had a good time at Eddie’s last party. (C) Gloria shared Eddie’s cakes with other friends. (D) Gloria does not want to go to Eddie’s tasting party.（ ）3. What does it mean? (A) Tell Eddie about his baking. (B) Tell Eddie to stop telling lies. (C) Tell Eddie how to find joy in baking. (D) Tell Eddie to stop crying over small things.
choices: His friends think he is a great dancer.
He is taking baking classes with Cecilia.
His friends did not like the clothes he made.
He did not know how to say no to his friends.（ ）2. Which is true?
Cecilia has not talked to Eddie for a month.
Cecilia had a good time at Eddie’s last party.
Gloria shared Eddie’s cakes with other friends.
Gloria does not want to go to Eddie’s tasting party.（ ）3. What does it mean?
Tell Eddie to stop telling lies.
Tell Eddie how to find joy in baking.
Tell Eddie to stop crying over small things.
items.explanation: 選項 (A)「他的朋友認為他是個很棒的舞者。」對話中只說有上舞蹈課，沒說是個好舞者；選項 (B)「他跟 Cecilia 在上烘焙課。」對話中只有說上舞蹈課，沒說上烘焙課；選項 (C)「他的朋友不喜歡他做的衣服。」與倒數第二個 Gloria 所述相符；選項 (D)「他不知道如何跟朋友說不。」未在對話中提及。故本題選 (C)。 2. 從第二個 Gloria 對話可知，Gloria 不想去 Eddie 的品嘗會。故選 (D)。 3. 由對話可知，Cecilia 與 Gloria 都不喜歡 Eddie 的烘焙，之前是由 Gloria 戳破 Eddie 做衣服的夢，所以這次 Gloria 希望由 Cecilia 來戳破 Eddie 的烘焙夢，由此判斷句中的 it 是指告知 Eddie 關於他的（爛）烘焙，故選 (A)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 108年會考
items.prompt: Below is part of a new shopping center’s market report.-------------------------------------------------Our busiest time is weekend afternoons, between 1：30 p.m. and 3：30 p.m. About half the business of the week is done then. So it would be better if we move Weekend’s Best Buy from Saturday evening to Saturday afternoon when there may be more shoppers during the sale. We should also think about having more free buses during the weekend, as 75% of the shoppers who were interviewed said two buses an hour are just not enough.Weekend evenings are second busiest, though it is not as good as last season. An interesting fact is that business is better on weekday evenings, usually one hour before closing, than on weekend mornings. Most of the shoppers then are people who live near or working parents who do their last-minute shopping. They together make up almost 60% of the business on weekday evenings. It might bring in more business if we open half an hour longer during weekdays, until 10：30 p.m. as 由於 make up 構成；組成【108教育會考】（ ）1. What does the report NOT suggest? suggest 建議 (A) Having more free buses for shoppers. (B) Changing the opening hours on weekdays. (C) Making plans to help weekday morning business. (D) Changing the time of the special sale on weekends.（ ）2. What does the report say about the shopping center? (A) Its business on weekdays is not as good as last season. (B) It has a special sale one hour before closing every day. (C) Most of the shoppers take the free buses to the shopping center. (D) A large part of its shoppers on weekday evenings are working parents.（ ）3. Which picture is most likely used in the report? likely 可能 (A) (B) (C) (D)
choices: Having more free buses for shoppers.
Changing the opening hours on weekdays.
Making plans to help weekday morning business.
Changing the time of the special sale on weekends.（ ）2. What does the report say about the shopping center?
Its business on weekdays is not as good as last season.
It has a special sale one hour before closing every day.
Most of the shoppers take the free buses to the shopping center.
A large part of its shoppers on weekday evenings are working parents.（ ）3. Which picture is most likely used in the report? likely 可能
items.explanation: 1. 本題在問報告上「沒有」建議的事項。選項 (A) 建議在第一段第四句；選項 (B) 建議在第二段倒數兩句；選項 (D) 建議在第一段第三句。而報告中「沒有」提供促進週間上午時段生意的計畫，故選 (C)。2. 第二段第三句指出，週間晚上關店前的一小時，大部分的顧客是住在附近的居民或者是上班族家長，與選項 (D) 內容相符，故選之。3. 本題可用消去法。第一段第一、二句指出，「週末下午」時段造就了將近「一半」的營業額，故不選 (A)；第二段第一句指出，「週末晚上」時段營業額居次，故不選 (C)；第二段第二句指出，「週間晚上」生意比「週末上午」好，故不選 (D)。故選 (B)。

items.explanation: 「找了好幾個小時，鑰匙卻一直在口袋裡」，可推知說話者會覺得自己像個「傻瓜」，故選 (A)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 114年會考
items.prompt: In the picture is a UK electricity worker in the 1970s. Pictures like this appeared in many newspapers at the time. In 1972, electricity workers in the UK asked to be paid more, and they decided to stop working until their wish was answered. The government worried that there wouldn’t be enough electricity for the country if these workers didn’t go to work, so it agreed to give them the pay rise. However, the story didn’t end there. A year later, the electricity workers asked for another pay rise. To get what they wanted, they worked shorter hours and acted like they would walk away from their job anytime. But this time, the government decided to fight. To save electricity, it made new rules for people to follow. For example, each family could turn on the heat in only one room; TV stations had to stop their shows at 10:30 p.m.; businesses could open only three days a week. People’s lives were greatly changed. Without enough heat to keep the house warm, people covered themselves in blankets all the time. Hospitals had to use candles because they couldn’t keep all the lights on. Factories couldn’t keep their machines working. Many people lost their jobs. For months, people were paying the price while the electricity workers were fighting for their wish. In the end, the government agreed to the second pay rise. This picture shows what many people thought of the electricity workers during the “dark” time. electricity 電力 government 政府【114教育會考】（ ）1. What is the reading mainly about? (A) The tips on using a picture to tell a story. (B) The change that electricity brought to people’s lives. (C) The history behind the picture of a UK electricity worker. (D) The story of a famous UK electricity worker from the 1970s.（ ）2. In the UK in the 1970s, what did people most likely think of the UK electricity workers? likely 可能 (A) They were not brave enough to fix their problems. (B) They worked like robots and never learned to change. (C) They were asking too much and did not know when to stop. (D) They did not care whether their job might hurt people’s health.（ ）3. Why does the writer put the “ ” mark around the word dark in the last sentence? (A) To say that the “dark” time was actually not dark. (B) To tell people that the word was said by the government. (C) To mean both the days without lights and the difficult lives people lived. (D) To show that the government and the electricity workers both lost their fights.
choices: The tips on using a picture to tell a story.
The change that electricity brought to people’s lives.
The history behind the picture of a UK electricity worker.
The story of a famous UK electricity worker from the 1970s.（ ）2. In the UK in the 1970s, what did people most likely think of the UK electricity workers? likely 可能
They were not brave enough to fix their problems.
They worked like robots and never learned to change.
They were asking too much and did not know when to stop.
They did not care whether their job might hurt people’s health.（ ）3. Why does the writer put the “ ” mark around the word dark in the last sentence?
To say that the “dark” time was actually not dark.
To tell people that the word was said by the government.
To mean both the days without lights and the difficult lives people lived.
To show that the government and the electricity workers both lost their fights.
items.explanation: 1. 由文章開頭提及這張 1970 年代英國電力工人的圖片，接著講述當時電力工人罷工、要求調薪、政府與人民的反應，以及最後達成協議的歷史背景等，可推知全文是在講述「一張英國電力工人圖片背後的歷史」，故選 (C)。2. 文章提到，電力工人又再度要求調薪，並採取相關強硬手段，這讓政府決定制定嚴格的用電限制規定，導致民眾生活受到很大影響，又圖片顯示了大眾認為工人「總是獅子大開口」、「沒有良心」和「一味索取」，可推知當時民眾普遍應是不滿電力工人，認為「他們要求太多，且不知道何時該停止」，故選 (C)。3. dark 可形容光線是「昏暗的；黑暗的」，也可形容處境是「傷心絕望的；哀愁的」，作者在 dark 一詞上加上引號一方面是為了表示這段時期人們經常生活在「昏暗的」環境，一方面是為了表示這段時期「人們生活困難」的雙重含義，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: I don’t like any one of these three watches. Can you show me ＿＿＿ one?【104教育會考】(A) the others (B) other (C) either (D) another
items.explanation: one ＝ a watch，代替前面「已提過、未指定」的單數可數名詞，而「other＋複數可數名詞」、「another＋單數可數名詞」，故選 (D)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 110年會考(補考)
items.prompt: (At Dora’s house)Jason：How was your trip to France?Dora：Wonderful! I visited the Louvre, one of the world’s largest museums.Jason：Did you know there’s another Louvre in the city of Lens, just two hours by car from Paris?Dora：Yes, but I just stayed in Paris. Maybe next time.Jason：I see. So are these the photos you took in France?Dora：Right. I’m picking a photo for my foreign pen friend, but I just can’t decide which is the best.Jason：Let me see... How about this one? Dora：Why do you like it?Jason：Don’t you think you look more beautiful in it? We all look better with our left side facing the camera.Dora：How so?Jason：A book I just read says that the left side of our faces works harder than the right side when we cry or laugh. That’s why it is always our best side.Dora：And that’s why Leonardo da Vinci painted Mona Lisa that way!【110教育補考】（ ）1. What do we know about Dora? (A) She went to France with Jason. (B) She visited the Louvre in Lens. (C) She is not good at taking pictures. (D) She had trouble deciding which photo to choose.（ ）2. Which is most likely said in the book that Jason read? (A) Our faces work to show how we feel. (B) We need a good camera to take nice pictures. (C) It is good for your health to sleep on your side. (D) It takes practice to paint like Leonardo da Vinci.（ ）3. What does this one most likely look like? (A) (B) (C) (D)
choices: She went to France with Jason.
She visited the Louvre in Lens.
She is not good at taking pictures.
She had trouble deciding which photo to choose.（ ）2. Which is most likely said in the book that Jason read?
Our faces work to show how we feel.
We need a good camera to take nice pictures.
It is good for your health to sleep on your side.
It takes practice to paint like Leonardo da Vinci.（ ）3. What does this one most likely look like?
items.explanation: 1. 由 Dora 第三個對話可知，她無法決定要寄哪一張照片，可知她有困難，故選 (D)。2. 由 Jason 最後一個對話可知，他讀的書講的是左右臉對於表情的控制，故可能會提到 (A)。3. this one 指的是要寄給筆友的照片，而 Jason 建議 Dora 寄「左臉面向鏡頭」的照片，Dora 最後又補充說是「蒙娜麗莎」的角度，與之相符的為 (D)。

items.prompt: John will stay with his sister until he ＿＿＿ an apartment.【113教育會考】(A) will find(B) would find(C) finds(D) found
items.explanation: until 引導的時間副詞子句，用現在簡單式表未來，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: Tom ＿＿＿ ten pounds over the past two months. He looks much thinner now.【104教育會考】(A) loses (B) has lost (C) will lose (D) was losing
items.explanation: over the past two months 表「過去到現在這兩個月期間內」，再從第二句 now 可判斷，前一句在講述「一件事情持續至今」，故選 (B)。

items.unit: 108年會考
items.prompt: In my school days, I ＿＿＿ to English radio programs every day. That was how I learned English at that time.【108教育會考】(A) listen (B) have listened(C) used to listen (D) was listening
items.explanation: 關鍵為第一句表達「狀態或習慣」的 every day，以及下一句的「過去式」時態；由此可推斷，第一句是在說明「過去的習慣」，要表達「過去的習慣，現在無此習慣」，須用「used to＋原形動詞」，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: I with my phone when the light turned red. I didn’t notice it and almost got hit by a car.【111教育補考】(A) was playing (B) played(C) am playing (D) would play
items.explanation: 當燈號變成紅燈時，我「正在玩手機」，表過去短時間內正進行的動作，用過去進行式，故選 (A)。

items.unit: 110年會考
items.prompt: Usually I wouldn’t cross the park at this time of night. But walking around the park would take more time, and it was raining so hard that I couldn’t even see clearly what was right before me. So I entered the park. And that was the first stupid thing I did tonight.Soon after I walked into the park, I saw a man under a tree up ahead. My heart fell. The stories I’d heard about the park 1. into my head at this moment. Anyone with a clear mind would just turn back. But me? No. I did 2. stupid thing：I decided to hurry past him.Just when I was passing the man, he raised his head and gave me the strangest smile ever. I got scared and started running. “Hey!” the man shouted from behind. “Wait!” He was running after me!I ran like crazy. I had hoped the trees would keep some rain off. And they 3. . But they also made the park look even darker. I couldn’t see what was ahead of me. Then, I ran into something. It was the man!“Don’t kill me!” I cried.“What? I 4. to give back your bag! You dropped it,” the man gave me my bag.Now, I felt saying that to the man was the stupidest thing I did tonight.【110教育會考】（ ）1. (A) are all coming (B) have all come (C) were all coming (D) would all come（ ）2. (A) another (B) one (C) the last (D) the other（ ）3. (A) have (B) did (C) had (D) would（ ）4. (A) was trying (B) try (C) would try (D) will try
items.explanation: 1. 本文描述過去的事，故不選與現在式相關的 (A) 與 (B)；由句末的 at this moment 可知在描述過去這個時刻正在發生的事，用過去進行式，故選 (C)。2. 第一段最後一句指出進入公園是第一件蠢事，而文末還有最蠢的事，所以這裡決定快速通過那名男子是「另一件」蠢事，故選 (A)。3. 本段描述過去發生的事，故不選現在式 (A)；本句表示上一句所希望的 the trees would keep some rain off（這些樹會遮擋一些雨水）這件事有發生，故用「過去簡單式助動詞」did 陳述事實；而 (D) would 表從過去的角度指將來發生的事，不符合上下文意，故選 (B)。4. 由下一句「你弄掉它了」，可知是解釋剛才試著追趕的原因，因此用「過去進行式」，故選 (A)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 112年會考
items.prompt: Doraemon, a blue Japanese robot cat, has hated mice since his ears by a mouse.【112教育會考】(A) bit (B) bite (C) were bitten (D) have bitten
items.explanation: since（自從）後接過去簡單式，表自過去某時間點起，且耳朵是「被」咬，因此須用過去式被動語態，故選 (C)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 109年會考
items.prompt: Kivalina, an island village in Alaska, USA, is known by only a few people. It cannot be found on most maps of Alaska because it is only 10 km2. This small Arctic village is home to 400 Inuit people*. However, their home will become uninhabitable because the island could be covered by the Chukchi Sea by 2025. These Inuit people will have to leave their home. But life now is already difficult. Over the past twenty years, winters have become warmer, the Arctic ice has kept melting, and the sea has been rising. These changes have made it harder to live by hunting and fishing than before. What’s worse, there is no Arctic ice thick enough to keep them safe from terrible wind and rain. These Inuit people think it is the oil and power companies in Alaska that have brought all these troubles, but they are the ones who are paying the price. It would cost hundreds of millions to move their village, and they have no idea where to get the money. Groups like ReLocate are working together with the Inuit people to save Kivalina, but nobody is sure if their hard work will come to anything. All the Inuit people can do now is to pray the rising sea will not cover their home too soon.* The Inuit people are a group of people who live in the Arctic. melt 融化 hunt 打獵 company 公司【109教育會考】（ ）1. What can we learn about Kivalina? (A) It is waiting to shine. (B) It has become history. (C) It is fighting for one last hope. (D) It has given up its chance to rise.（ ）2. What does it mean when we say a place is uninhabitable? (A) It is not big. (B) It is not popular. (C) It cannot be bought. (D) It cannot be lived in.（ ）3. What does the writer think about the Inuit people in Kivalina? (A) Their way of living has been hurting the earth. (B) They might not be able to get enough money to move their village. (C) They should make the oil and power companies fix their problems. (D) There are better ways than to move their village to somewhere else.（ ）4. What does the reading say about the Arctic ice? (A) The Arctic ice covered 10 km2 of Kivalina. (B) The melting Arctic ice kills about 400 Inuit people each year. (C) The Arctic ice helped the Inuit people in Kivalina during bad weather. (D) The melting Arctic ice has given the Inuit people enough water to use.
choices: It is fighting for one last hope.
It has given up its chance to rise.（ ）2. What does it mean when we say a place is uninhabitable?
It cannot be lived in.（ ）3. What does the writer think about the Inuit people in Kivalina?
Their way of living has been hurting the earth.
They might not be able to get enough money to move their village.
They should make the oil and power companies fix their problems.
There are better ways than to move their village to somewhere else.（ ）4. What does the reading say about the Arctic ice?
The Arctic ice covered 10 km2 of Kivalina.
The melting Arctic ice kills about 400 Inuit people each year.
The Arctic ice helped the Inuit people in Kivalina during bad weather.
The melting Arctic ice has given the Inuit people enough water to use.
items.explanation: 1. 由文章第三段可知，因紐特人雖然沒錢也不知成果如何，但他們還在努力挽救他們的家，可知他們「還在為最後一線希望奮鬥」，故選 (C)。2. 由後兩句「該島可能會被楚克奇海所覆蓋」以及「必須離開他們的家園」，可推知 uninhabitable 的意思為「無法居住的」，故選 (D)。3. 文章第三段提到「村莊搬遷將花費數億美元，而他們不知道從哪裡籌錢」。可推知作者認為因紐特人「可能無法湊足村莊搬遷的費用」，故選 (B)。4. 由第二段最後一句可知，現在北極的冰不夠厚，無法幫忙阻擋惡劣的風雨，所以可推知「以前的北極冰夠厚，可以幫忙阻擋惡劣的天氣」，故選 (C)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 104年會考
items.prompt: From：Lisa Clyne (lisaclyne@mail.com)To：Mary Faber (maryfaber@mail.com)Date：Thursday, April 2, 2015Subject：Welcome---------------------------------------------------------------------Dear Mary,Uncle Billy and I are excited about your visit.The weather has ＿1.＿ these days. Like today, it was sunny in the morning, but rained heavily at noon. So we’ve＿2.＿： If the weather is nice, I’m going to take you to Smith Farm. They’re having a special horse show this week. I’m sure you’ll like it. And ＿3.＿. We can go shopping at Mimi’s Department Store; there we can walk around without getting wet. Rain or shine, we hope you will have a good time here.See you tomorrow at the train station at 9：00 a.m.Love,Aunt Lisa【104教育會考】（ ）1. (A) got better (B) been warm (C) changed a lot (D) become wet and cold（ ）2. (A) made two plans for you (B) worried about your trip to here (C) decided to take you to a nice place (D) prepared everything you’ve asked for（ ）3. (A) we’ll agree with each other (B) don’t worry if it rains (C) we all love animals very much (D) don’t forget to check the weather
choices: worried about your trip to here
decided to take you to a nice place
we all love animals very much
don’t forget to check the weather
items.explanation: 1. 寫作中，通常以下一句來補充說明本句的意思。文中的下一句「舉例 （Like…）」說明「上午晴天，正午卻下大雨」，表示天氣變化大（changed a lot）。故選 (C)。2. 寫作中，冒號後面通常為補充說明。文中冒號後面的句子為條件句 If the weather is nice,… 可判斷，Aunt Lisa 接下來要講的是計畫：根據天氣好、壞，要帶 Mary 去不同的地方。故選 (A)。3. And 之前，描述了若天氣好時（If the weather is nice,…）要去的地方，所以 And 之後應該就是天氣不好時要去不會弄濕身體的地方（without getting wet）。故選 (B)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 114年會考
items.prompt: 【114教育會考】（ ）1. What do the comics tell us? (A) Enjoy life while we can. (B) Follow the old ways of life. (C) Save our planet before it’s too late. (D) Treat others the way we want to be treated.（ ）2. What can we learn about the people in the comics? (A) They made fire before starting a fight. (B) They fought for land and plants all the time. (C) They prayed to the statues beside a large fire. (D) They used statues to show how strong they were.（ ）3. What does did it in Picture 7 mean? (A) Fall to the ground. (B) Cut down the last trees. (C) Move the statues to fighting grounds. (D) Understand how important trees were.
choices: Follow the old ways of life.
Save our planet before it’s too late.
Treat others the way we want to be treated.（ ）2. What can we learn about the people in the comics?
They made fire before starting a fight.
They fought for land and plants all the time.
They prayed to the statues beside a large fire.
They used statues to show how strong they were.（ ）3. What does did it in Picture 7 mean?
Move the statues to fighting grounds.
items.explanation: 1. 漫畫提到復活節島上的人們曾因樹木豐富而生活美好，但過度砍伐導致土地乾燥、食物和水變少，最後島上居民受苦。這故事提醒我們若不珍惜和保護自然資源，地球也會遭受同樣命運。為時未晚前，我們應拯救地球免於滅亡，故選 (C)。2. 圖二提及人們用樹木來生火和蓋房子，圖六提及人們爭鬥時會將雕像搬到戰場上，但並未提及爭鬥開始前要生火，故不選 (A)；由圖一～圖三可知，人們起初在復活節島上生活得很好，甚至在空閒時間，還會用大石頭製作雕像，故不選 (B)；全文未提及人們會在大火旁向雕像祈禱，故不選 (C)；由圖六可知，爭鬥時，人們會將雕像搬到戰場上，以展現他們的力量，故選 (D)。3. 由前句「人們明知樹木對他們有多麼重要」及前半句「但他們還是……」，再結合後句「當最後的樹木倒下時，島上的人們也隨之衰敗了」，可推知此處的 did it 指「砍掉最後幾棵樹木」，故選 (B)。

items.unit: 108年會考
items.prompt: Joyce tells her brother everything. She never ＿＿＿ anything from him.【108教育會考】(A) covers (B) believes (C) hides (D) takes
items.explanation: 由「Joyce 告知她弟弟每件事」可知，她從未「隱瞞」她弟弟任何事；「hide＋sth.＋from＋sb.」表「對某人隱瞞某事」，故選 (C)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 105年會考
items.prompt: Mark studies very hard and never classes. He goes to school even when he is sick.【105教育會考】(A) loses (B) misses (C) changes (D) forgets
items.explanation: 第二句說明了 Mark 去上學的狀況—goes to school even when he is sick（即使生病也去上學），可推知 Mark 從未錯過（never misses）任何一節課，故選 (B)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 104年會考
items.prompt: B&J Café ＿＿＿ known as the tallest building in town. However, O&G Restaurant became the tallest building in 2010.【104教育會考】(A) has been (B) had been (C) is (D) would be
items.explanation: 第二句出現過去時間點 2010 年。由上下文可知，第一句「B&J Café 成為城中最高建築」這件事情發生在第二句「O&G飯店成為（城中）最高建築」之前，須用過去完成式表示，故選 (B)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 109年會考
items.prompt: For the past twenty years, my father in a school library. But he’ll leave the job next month. 【109教育會考】(A) worked (B) has worked(C) is working (D) works
items.explanation: 由後句提到父親下個月將會離開現在的工作，可知目前仍在學校的圖書館工作，從過去二十年持續到現在的事件，用現在完成式，故選 (B)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 104年會考
items.prompt: Froggie was a frog who never remembered where he had been. His biggest dream was to find the best pond to swim freely without worrying about water snakes. One day, Froggie hopped to a kitchen and jumped into a pot full of hot water. Froggie felt the burning heat and hurried out of the water as fast as his legs could carry him. “I almost died there!” Froggie thought. A few days later, Froggie went back to the same kitchen, totally forgetting he had been there. He again hopped into the same pot. This time, the water inside was cool. He looked around and thought, “There’s no water snake trying to eat me and I can have this place all to myself!” At that moment, Froggie knew it was his dream pond. What he didn’t know was that the water was warming up over a low heat. After thirty minutes of swimming, Froggie felt the water was warmer but he thought of this as a nice surprise. “This sure is the best place for swimming. I get to have a hot bath, too.” During his comfortable bath, the water kept getting warmer and warmer. Froggie was so comfortable that he fell asleep. And he never woke up.【104教育會考】（ ）1. What lesson can we learn from Froggie’s story? (A) Life is too short; one should live it to the fullest. (B) Those who use their time well will win in the end. (C) People are blind to problems that slowly get worse over time. (D) It is difficult to give up old habits, but easy to pick up new ones.（ ）2. What do we know about Froggie? (A) He learned to share what he liked with others. (B) He thought what he had hoped for became real. (C) He once almost lost a dear friend to a water snake. (D) He wanted to go back to the same pot for a hot bath.
choices: Life is too short; one should live it to the fullest.
Those who use their time well will win in the end.
People are blind to problems that slowly get worse over time.
It is difficult to give up old habits, but easy to pick up new ones.（ ）2. What do we know about Froggie?
He learned to share what he liked with others.
He thought what he had hoped for became real.
He once almost lost a dear friend to a water snake.
He wanted to go back to the same pot for a hot bath.
items.explanation: 1. 第三段 Froggie 選擇忽略水溫緩緩升高（getting warmer and warmer）的環境改變，導致最後的死亡（And he never woke up）指出了本故事的寓意，與選項 (C) 「人們對於緩慢惡化的問題視而不見」最接近，故選之。2. 選項 (A)「他學會與他人分享自己喜歡的事物」、選項 (C)「他有次差點因為水蛇而失去一個摯友」和本句 There’s no water snake trying to eat me and I can have this place all to myself! 不符；選項 (D)「為了熱水浴，他想回去同樣的鍋內」和本句 Froggie went back to the same kitchen, totally forgetting he had been there 不符。選項 (B)「他以為他的願望成真」與 Froggie knew it was his dream pond. What he didn’t know was... 相符，故選之。

items.prompt: Robert likes to take a walk in the park after work. One day when he was walking in the park, he heard a woman calling his name. He stopped to look around, but didn’t see anything 1. . Shortly after Robert saw it, it was gone. Though Robert felt a little strange, he did not think about it too much and sat down for a rest on a bench in the park. Then he noticed the snake he had just seen 2. . Robert was too afraid to move away from the bench. Right at this moment, a woman behind him shouted, “Come here, Robert. You can’t stay on the bench like that. 3. .” In surprise, Robert turned around and said to the woman, “Excuse me, but that’s not a very nice thing to say, and in fact some people say I’m handsome.” “I’m not talking to you,” said the woman. “I’m telling Robert, my pet snake, to get down from the bench, not you.”【107教育會考】（ ）1. (A) like a snake (B) that could move (C) except a little snake (D) that could make noise （ ）2. (A) climbing up the bench (B) running after a woman (C) stopping beside his feet (D) falling down from a tree（ ）3. (A) The bench is broken (B) The seat has been taken (C) People will be scared by you (D) The paint of the bench is still wet
choices: People will be scared by you
The paint of the bench is still wet
items.explanation: 1. 由後句「Robert 看到小蛇後不久，牠就消失了」可知，Robert 除了一隻小蛇之外，什麼都沒看到，故選 (C)。2. 由後句「由於 Robert 太害怕了，以至於無法離開長椅」可知，那條蛇正「爬上那張長椅」，故選 (A)。3. 由 Robert 說：「不好意思，但妳這樣說不太禮貌，而且事實上有些人說我很帥」及該女子說：「我不是在跟你說話，我是叫我的寵物蛇 Robert 從那張長椅下來，不是在叫你」可知，Robert 誤會該女子說：「人們會被你嚇到」，故選 (C)。

whether they are men or women

items.prompt: Dear Traveler, You have bought an NFR ticket online for a train that runs between White Water City and Cloud City. We are sorry to tell you that, because of the typhoon last month, the Sand Town – Spring Town line will be closed between August 14 and 28 2016. During this time, some trains will change lines and will not stop at a few stations. There will be free buses to take travelers to these stations. Please check below for the changes. Visit http：//www.nfr.gov/ for more information.We wish you a nice summer.Lena MullerNational Formosa Railway1. Trains that run between Green City and Cloud City will take the Smoke Town – Spring Town line, and will stop at every station. Below are the trains that will change lines. 2. The free buses for the Sand Town – Spring Town line will wait at Green City (going south) and Spring Town (going north) stations. No stop at Gray Village.【110教育會考】 line 路線（ ）1. Why does National Formosa Railway write this letter? (A) There is a train ticket sale. (B) A train line will be closed in July. (C) It will open a new train line in August. (D) Some of its trains will run on different lines.（ ）2. What is true about NFR’s trains between August 14 and 28 2016? (A) No trains will stop at Spring Town. (B) Trains that change lines will all stop at Cloud City. (C) People can take the free buses to any station on the Sand Town - Spring Town line. (D) People can go to Hill Town on any train that runs between Green City and Cloud City.（ ）3. James lives in Smoke Town. He wants to go to Black Town on August 19. How can he get there? (A) Take Train RL202 to Green City, get off there, and take the free bus. (B) Take Train RL103 to Green City, get off there, and take the free bus. (C) Take Train RL102 to Spring Town, get off there, and take Train RL201. (D) Take Train RL101 to Cloud City, get off there, and take the free bus.
choices: There is a train ticket sale.
A train line will be closed in July.
It will open a new train line in August.
Some of its trains will run on different lines.（ ）2. What is true about NFR’s trains between August 14 and 28 2016?
No trains will stop at Spring Town.
Trains that change lines will all stop at Cloud City.
People can take the free buses to any station on the Sand Town - Spring Town line.
People can go to Hill Town on any train that runs between Green City and Cloud City.（ ）3. James lives in Smoke Town. He wants to go to Black Town on August 19. How can he get there?
Take Train RL202 to Green City, get off there, and take the free bus.
Take Train RL103 to Green City, get off there, and take the free bus.
Take Train RL102 to Spring Town, get off there, and take Train RL201.
Take Train RL101 to Cloud City, get off there, and take the free bus.
items.explanation: 1. 信件的第二段提到，上月的颱風導致沙土鎮─春日鎮路線將關閉，部分車次也將會改變行駛路線，鐵路局因此來信通知乘客，故選 (D)。2. 由信件內容可知，沙土鎮─春日鎮這條路線在 8 月 14 日至 28 日會關閉，所有行駛於碧綠城和雲朵城間的列車都將改而行駛煙霧鎮─春日鎮路線，且站站停靠，由此可推知，每一班列車都會停靠介於煙霧鎮與春日鎮之間的山丘鎮，故選 (D)。3. 由於沙土鎮─春日鎮路線關閉，欲從煙霧鎮前往漆黑鎮需搭火車再轉乘免費接駁公車，而公車僅停靠碧綠城和春日鎮，因此必須前往這兩個車站搭乘公車。從煙霧鎮出發，需搭乘北上列車才能抵達碧綠城，故選 (A)。

items.prompt: I didn’t take the bus today because it was . All the seats were taken and a lot of students were standing.【112教育會考】(A) dirty (B) fast (C) full (D) wrong
items.explanation: 由後句「所有位子都被坐走，且很多學生站著」，可推知沒搭公車是因為公車「客滿」，故選 (C)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 104年會考
items.prompt: (At Liz’s birthday party)Amber：Don’t tell me you didn’t go to Garden House.Keith：Why would I go there?Amber：For Liz’s birthday cake! I left you a voice message this morning!Keith：But you said Matt would go to the bakery! And why did you come here without me? I was waiting outside your apartment for an hour!Amber：No! I said I’d have lunch with Matt, and we’d come straight here from the restaurant. So I asked you to help get the cake after work.Keith：No, you did not! And why didn’t you answer my calls?Amber：My cellphone is dead! I said in the message that you could call Matt’s number if you wanted to find me. Now please tell me you did bring the gift we got for Liz.Keith：What gift? I’m sure you didn’t say anything about a gift in the message. Amber：I told you that yesterday! message 留言【104教育會考】（ ）1. What is Garden House? (A) A bakery. (B) A gift shop. (C) A flower shop. (D) An apartment.（ ）2. What can we learn about Keith? (A) He forgot to meet Amber and Matt for lunch. (B) He did not know how to get to Amber’s apartment. (C) He called Amber without knowing her phone was not working. (D) He did not know Amber left him a voice message this morning.（ ）3. Which sentence was most likely part of the message that Amber left Keith this morning? likely 可能 (A) “Matt and I will go to the party after lunch.” (B) “Don’t forget to buy a birthday gift for Liz.” (C) “You can go straight to the party from your office.” (D) “I need to talk to you about the party this weekend.”
choices: An apartment.（ ）2. What can we learn about Keith?
He forgot to meet Amber and Matt for lunch.
He did not know how to get to Amber’s apartment.
He called Amber without knowing her phone was not working.
He did not know Amber left him a voice message this morning.（ ）3. Which sentence was most likely part of the message that Amber left Keith this morning? likely 可能
“Matt and I will go to the party after lunch.”
“Don’t forget to buy a birthday gift for Liz.”
“You can go straight to the party from your office.”
“I need to talk to you about the party this weekend.”
items.explanation: 1. 第二個 Amber 第一句「For Liz’s birthday cake! （拿蛋糕）」 說明了 Garden House 為 bakery，故選 (A)。2. 倒數第二個 Keith 與 Amber 可知 Keith 打了數個電話給 Amber（why didn’t you answer my calls），不知道 Amber 電話沒電了（My cellphone is dead!）。故選 (C)。3. 第三個 Amber 說明了語音留言內容：Amber 與 Matt 一起吃午餐，所以兩人會直接從餐廳去慶生會，因此要 Keith 下班後幫忙去取蛋糕。只有選項 (A) 相符。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 113年會考
items.prompt: Yan lived a good life in a big house. One day he invited a friend to dinner at his house. However, on the dinner table there was only one small dish of one small fish. The friend looked quietly at the fish. It was no bigger than a finger. Then he asked Yan if he could borrow a lamp. “What for?” Yan asked. “Well, it’s so dark in here,” the friend said with a dry smile, “I can’t see the other delicious dishes you’ve prepared for me.” Chang kept a lot of ducks and chickens on his farm. One day, his best friend came to visit him. At noon, Chang told his friend that he couldn’t let him stay for lunch because there wasn’t much food to eat. The friend looked out at Chang’s farm animals for a moment. Then he asked Chang if he had a big knife. “Yes, but what for?” Chang asked. “I’m thinking about killing the horse I rode here so we’ll have something for lunch,” the friend said. “But how are you going to go home without it?” “Well, you wouldn’t mind lending me one of your many ducks or chickens so I can ride it home, would you?”【113教育會考】（ ）1. What kind of people do Yan’s and Chang’s friends most likely think Yan and Chang are? likely 可能 (A) They enjoy good food. (B) They don’t like to share. (C) They like to make friends. (D) They don’t like new things.（ ）2. What is it in the second story? (A) A big knife. (B) The horse. (C) Lunch. (D) One of Chang’s ducks or chickens.
choices: They don’t like new things.（ ）2. What is it in the second story?
One of Chang’s ducks or chickens.
items.explanation: 1. 由「Yan 住著大房子卻只招待朋友吃一條小魚」及「Chang 的農場有許多雞鴨卻不招待朋友吃午餐」，可知Yan 和 Chang 為人吝嗇，應是「不喜歡分享」的人，故選 (B)。2. 由 Chang 問「但你沒有牠要怎麼回家呢？」，可知 it 指的是上一句朋友提到他騎來的「馬」，故選 (B)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 106年會考
items.prompt: Englishman Robert Scott is known for leading two trips to Antarctica. The first one made him a star; the second 1. . After his first successful trip, Scott decided to be the first person to stand on the South Pole. However, 2. . He would be in a race with Roald Amundsen, from Norway. Both left their countries by ship in June of 1910 and arrived in Antarctica in January of 1911. About ten months later, both teams started their trips down to the South Pole. 3. . Amundsen’s team used dogs, and Scott’s team used horses. Because horses weren’t good at traveling on snow, it took Scott’s team 77 days to arrive at the South Pole. They got there on January 17, 1912, and were surprised to find that Amundsen was ahead of them. The news hit Scott very hard, but what he didn’t know was that 4. . His team began their long trip home with broken hearts. After days of terrible weather and little food, Scott lost his men one after another, and he himself was the last one to meet the end of his life. No one on his team lived to go back home and tell their story. It was only learned through Scott’s diary.【106教育會考】（ ）1. (A) hurt his health (B) opened his eyes (C) cost him his life (D) made his dream come true（ ）2. (A) he didn’t want to take this trip with others (B) he wasn’t the only one who had this dream (C) he wouldn’t let anyone else take his prize away (D) he couldn’t miss the chance to make his country proud（ ）3. (A) And Scott used a popular way for his men to travel fast (B) But there were problems to deal with before they traveled (C) But Amundsen didn’t know better about animals than Scott (D) And their ways of traveling decided which team would win（ ）4. (A) there was still hope (B) no one ever believed him (C) the worst had not come yet (D) Amundsen had not been honest
choices: he didn’t want to take this trip with others
he wasn’t the only one who had this dream
he wouldn’t let anyone else take his prize away
he couldn’t miss the chance to make his country proud（ ）3.
And Scott used a popular way for his men to travel fast
But there were problems to deal with before they traveled
But Amundsen didn’t know better about animals than Scott
And their ways of traveling decided which team would win（ ）4.
the worst had not come yet
items.explanation: 1. 本句的答案在故事的最後，Robert Scott「死於第二次」從南極洲返家的路上，故選 (C)。2. 由下一句可知這次旅程 Scott 要與 Roald Amundsen 競爭，表示 Scott 不是唯一一個想成為第一個踏上南地極的人，故選 (B)。3. 空格的下一句說明了 Amundsen 與 Scott 用不同的動物遠征南極，接著又說明了兩種方式的優劣，造就了最後 Amundsen 隊贏，Scott 隊失敗的結果，因此應填入「他們行進的方式決定了哪一個隊伍終將獲勝」。故選 (D)。4. 由空格之後的文意可知 Scott 輸了競賽「還不是最壞的事」，因為後面還有更糟的—他的隊員與他自己相繼於歸途中死去，故選 (C)。

items.explanation: 「生日」會是個好「藉口」來要求他人為自己做某事，譬如，要求父親買貴重物品給自己，故選 (B)。

items.subject: 英文

items.prompt: FunGana 2016 No idea where to spend your vacation? If you are a big fan of sun, beach, and water sports, then you must join FunGana 2016! Over the years, FunGana has taken people to many places in Gana. This year, we are taking you to Piso Island, one of Gana’s beautiful islands. Piso Island is adjacent to Wako Island, the biggest island in Gana, so it is only 15 minutes away by boat from Wako Island. The best time to visit? All year around, the weather on Piso Island is just wonderful for a vacation. You can sail out to watch whales, or enjoy one of the best mud springs in the world. We will also show you around the island in a special car, the Cocoon Rider. It’s our pleasure to help you enjoy your stay on Piso Island.Find out more about FunGana 2016 athttp：//www.fungana2016.com.gn.【105教育會考】（ ）1. What is FunGana 2016 for? (A) Studying sea animals in Gana. (B) Giving courses in water sports. (C) Giving weather reports in Gana. (D) Helping people experience Gana.（ ）2. What does the reading say about Piso Island? (A) It makes the best cars in Gana. (B) It has nice weather in every season. (C) It is the most popular island in Gana. (D) It has the most mud springs in the world.（ ）3. What does adjacent to mean? (A) Like. (B) Near. (C) Bigger than. (D) Warmer than.
choices: Helping people experience Gana.（ ）2. What does the reading say about Piso Island?
It makes the best cars in Gana.
It has nice weather in every season.
It is the most popular island in Gana.
It has the most mud springs in the world.（ ）3. What does adjacent to mean?
items.explanation: 1. 第二段第一句點出 FunGana 過去幾年已經帶人造訪 Gana 的許多地方，與選項 (D)「助人體驗 Gana」的意思最為接近，故選之。2. 第二段中間形容 Piso 島的天氣整年都適合度假（All year around, the weather on Piso Island is just wonderful for a vacation.），與選項 (B)「它每個季節天氣都不錯」相符，故選 (b)。3. 本題找連接詞 so（所以）—因為不遠、很近（near），所以搭船只要 15 分鐘就能到（so it is only 15 minutes away by boat from Wako Island），故選 (B)。另，the biggest island in Gana 為逗號前 Wako Island 的同位語，故不選 (C)。

items.prompt: Hi! Andy,How are you? Guess where I am now? In one of the lowest places in the world! After a two-day bus ride and a one-day walk from Tausa, I finally 1. here. The weather here was so hot that I drank up most of the water I brought. I was worried that there 2. no more water. Luckily, I found a small town that 3. here for hundreds of years and got help from some friendly people. You know, the most difficult part of this trip was that I had to find my own way and take care of different problems by myself. I was a little afraid before the trip, but now I’m having a good time. Let’s have coffee together after I get back. 4. you more about my trip.Love,Diana 2005.12.12【110教育補考】（ ）1. (A) get (B) will get (C) got (D) would get（ ）2. (A) would be (B) will be (C) has been (D) is（ ）3. (A) is (B) has been (C) will be (D) would be（ ）4. (A) I’ll tell (B) I told (C) I’ve told (D) I’m telling
items.explanation: 1. 要對方猜猜看自己現在在哪裡，可知是已經到達，故用過去式 got。2. 在過去的時間點，擔心未來會沒有水，用 will 的過去式 would，故選 (A)。3. 由後方 for hundreds of years 可知「已有數百年」，描述從過去到現在的情況，應用現在完成式 has been。4. 前句說「等我回去後，一起喝咖啡」，可知事情尚未發生，「之後」才跟對方多聊聊自己的旅程，故選未來式 (A)。

items.prompt: Animals have their special ways to deal with hard times in nature. The superb fairy-wren, one kind of bright-blue bird in Australia, is one example. This year, a ten-year study showed that this small bird has eggs of different sizes in different kinds of weather. When the weather is hot and dry, there is less food for young superb fairy-wrens, and they die easily. So the mother bird will make larger eggs to help her babies grow stronger inside before they break out of the eggs into the “hungry” world. However, not all mother birds are able to do this trick. Only those with at least one male child can. When the weather is “good,” the mother will make smaller eggs, and her sons will bring food back for their baby brothers and sisters from the eggs. With her sons’ help, the mother can save more energy to make larger eggs when the weather is bad. Isn’t this amazing? male 雄性 energy 能量【108教育會考】（ ）1. Which is the best title for this reading? title 標題 (A) Australia：The Best Place for Birds. (B) Mother Bird Fights Weather Changes. (C) Larger Mother Birds Have Larger Eggs. (D) Family Love：Brothers & Sisters Work Together.（ ）2. What does this trick mean in the reading? (A) Having eggs of different sizes. (B) Growing stronger inside the egg. (C) Saving food for weaker baby birds. (D) Helping baby birds break out of the eggs.（ ）3. What can we learn about superb fairy-wrens from the reading? (A) Male birds can usually live for ten years. (B) Baby birds grow well in hot, dry weather. (C) Young male birds share the job of feeding the baby birds. (D) Mother birds make smaller eggs when there is less food outside.
choices: Larger Mother Birds Have Larger Eggs.
Family Love：Brothers & Sisters Work Together.（ ）2. What does this trick mean in the reading?
Saving food for weaker baby birds.
Helping baby birds break out of the eggs.（ ）3. What can we learn about superb fairy-wrens from the reading?
Male birds can usually live for ten years.
Baby birds grow well in hot, dry weather.
Young male birds share the job of feeding the baby birds.
Mother birds make smaller eggs when there is less food outside.
items.explanation: 1. 由全文可知主要是在描述澳洲的壯麗細尾鷯鶯媽媽可以因應天氣好壞而產下大小不同的蛋，選項 (B) 的標題最符合本文大意，故選之。2. 由第一段可知，壯麗細尾鷯鶯媽媽的妙招是指「她們可以因應天氣不同而產下大小相異的蛋」，故選 (A)。3. 由第二段第三句可知，壯麗細尾鷯鶯媽媽的兒子可以幫忙餵食剛孵出的弟妹們，故選 (C)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 110年會考(補考)
items.prompt: A fan of Last Autumn? Then, you don’t want to miss Highland Castle, where the movie was made. Walking in the castle, you’ll feel like you are being taken back to those famous scenes – the back garden where Sir William and his future wife Lady Mary had their first kiss, the drawing room where Lady Mary lay in Sir William’s arms for the last time and never opened her eyes again....A true story of Sir Anthony Airyman (1758 – 1801), Last Autumn shows the happy days of his life in Highland Castle. Built in 1625, the castle was all Sir Anthony had after his wife, Lady Helen, was gone. It was kept as it had been to remember their life there until a fire burned down half of it.Sir Anthony died soon after, and the castle was passed down in the family until his great-great-grandson, Lewis Airyman, sold it to an American businessman, Charles Bass.Now, thanks to the big ticket sales of Last Autumn, Highland Castle has got back its old-time shine and will be opened for visits for the first time. On July 5, 2020, actors from Last Autumn will be there for the opening.Join us!0642-8854【110教育補考】 scene 場景（ ）1. What is the reading for? (A) Selling movie tickets to fans of a famous castle. (B) Getting people to visit a castle that appears in a movie. (C) Finding actors for a movie that will be made in a castle. (D) Inviting people to watch a movie that will play in a castle.（ ）2. What can we learn from the reading? (A) Lady Mary died in the castle. (B) Sir William and Sir Anthony were family. (C) Sir Anthony was killed in a fire. (D) Lady Helen first met Sir Anthony at the castle.（ ）3. What does the reading say about Highland Castle? (A) It does not belong to the Airyman family now. (B) It was a gift from Sir Anthony to Lady Helen. (C) It was not opened for visits until 1801. (D) It has been kept as it was in 1625.
choices: Selling movie tickets to fans of a famous castle.
Getting people to visit a castle that appears in a movie.
Finding actors for a movie that will be made in a castle.
Inviting people to watch a movie that will play in a castle.（ ）2. What can we learn from the reading?
Lady Mary died in the castle.
Sir William and Sir Anthony were family.
Sir Anthony was killed in a fire.
Lady Helen first met Sir Anthony at the castle.（ ）3. What does the reading say about Highland Castle?
It does not belong to the Airyman family now.
It was a gift from Sir Anthony to Lady Helen.
It was not opened for visits until 1801.
It has been kept as it was in 1625.
items.explanation: 1. 文中的前兩句提到，Last Autumn 的粉絲一定不會想錯過 Highland Castle 這個電影製作的場景，末段亦提到該電影演員們會參與第一次對外開放參觀的開幕，可知是在邀請人們前往，故選 (B)。2. 由第一段可知，Lady Mary 是在城堡中的 drawing room（客廳）逝世的，故選 (A)。3. 由第二段最後可知，Airyman 的家族後裔 Lewis 將 Highland Castle 賣給了美國商人 Charles Bass，表示該城堡已不再屬於 Airyman 家族，故選 (A)。

items.prompt: Dear Maggie, I know you won’t be happy but I still have to say this again. It hurts me to think that you’re going to ＿1.＿. I know you’ve always wanted to be like those actresses with big eyes and slim legs, but in fact you are already beautiful. What you are born with makes you special because nobody looks the same as you. It worries me more that ＿2.＿. But sadly, there’s no quick fix to this, not even with the doctor’s help. If you don’t try to like yourself first, no one else will. People like you not because of your face, but because of your heart. You need to understand this first. Until you understand this, nothing is going to be different even if you have this change. I truly hope you think this through again.Love, Linda【108教育會考】（ ）1. (A) change the way you are (B) give up being an actress (C) travel with a theater group (D) run away from your friends（ ）2. (A) you’re too shy to talk with people (B) you just don’t want to be like others (C) you don’t think you’re good enough (D) you don’t know what you’ve missed
choices: you’re too shy to talk with people
you just don’t want to be like others
you don’t think you’re good enough
you don’t know what you’ve missed
items.explanation: 1. 本題關鍵句在下一句「但事實上妳已經很美了」。Linda 認為 Maggie 原本就很美，所以一想到 Maggie 準備要「改變自己原本的模樣」，就很痛心，故選 (A)。2. 第一段指出 Maggie 想要「變得和那些有著大眼和纖細雙腿的女演員一樣」，認為那就是美；再由第二段第三句的內容可推斷，Maggie 應該是希望眾人能喜歡她，但認為「原本的自己不夠好」，才會想要改變，故選 (C)。

Sometimes, we will also need you to help on our Kids’ Fun Day on weekends.But in your free time, you can visit other places around here and enjoy country life. You’ll get meals and a place to stay. And you can eat as much fruit as you like!The shortest stay is one week. You can come here by bus or we can pick you up from the train station. Interested? Call us now.【111教育補考】 chart 圖表（ ）1. (D) Inviting people to visit and pick their own fruit.（ ）2. What do we know about Parkside Farm? (A) It is visited by more people in June than in July. (B) It holds Kids’ Fun Day every Tuesday and Friday. (C) It has the most kinds of fruit for picking in August. (D) It picks kids up from the train station on weekends.

Finding people to help during the fruit season.
Giving people places to grow their own plants.
Inviting people to visit and pick their own fruit.（ ）2. What do we know about Parkside Farm?
It is visited by more people in June than in July.
