items.prompt: You probably have heard Beethoven’s famous piano piece “For Elise,” but do you know who “Elise” was?One story is that Elise was Elisabeth Röckel. She once sang in Beethoven’s opera Fidelio, and the two became very good friends. Beethoven called her “Elise.” When Röckel was leaving the city of Vienna, Beethoven wrote “For Elise” to say goodbye to her. Another story is that Elise was Therese Malfatti. Beethoven was in love with her. He wrote a piece for her and put “For Therese” on the manuscript. Malfatti kept the manuscript and left it to her family when she died. Later, a man copied the manuscript and wrote “For Elise” by mistake. There is another possible Elise: Elise Barensfeld. She learned the piano from Malfatti, the same Malfatti in the second story. To help Malfatti, Beethoven wrote the piece for her to use to teach Barensfeld.These are just some guesses about who Elise was. We may never know the right answer. No one knew about the piece until 1867, when the manuscript was found. This was 40 years after Beethoven’s death, so he wasn’t around to tell us who Elise was. Only one thing is for sure: “For Elise” will always be enjoyed. opera 歌劇 manuscript 手稿【112教育會考】（ ）1. What do the three stories in the reading all talk about? (A) Who Beethoven’s true love was. (B) Who played “For Elise” the best. (C) How “For Elise” became popular. (D) Why Beethoven wrote “For Elise.”（ ）2. What do we know about “For Elise” from the reading? (A) It first appeared in the opera Fidelio. (B) The true “Elise” was Elise Barensfeld. (C) The manuscript was found after Beethoven died. (D) The manuscript is now kept by the city of Vienna.（ ）3. What can we learn about the three women from the stories? (A) They were called “Elise” by their friends. (B) Elisabeth Röckel was a close friend of Beethoven’s. (C) Therese Malfatti changed “For Elise” to “For Therese.” (D) Elise Barensfeld was Beethoven’s student.
choices: Why Beethoven wrote “For Elise.”（ ）2. What do we know about “For Elise” from the reading?
It first appeared in the opera Fidelio.
The manuscript was found after Beethoven died.
The manuscript is now kept by the city of Vienna.（ ）3. What can we learn about the three women from the stories?
They were called “Elise” by their friends.
Elisabeth Röckel was a close friend of Beethoven’s.
Therese Malfatti changed “For Elise” to “For Therese.”
items.explanation: 1. 文章雖然在猜測愛麗絲是誰，但在三個故事中都說明了作曲的理由：與朋友道別、寫給愛人、寫給愛人用來教學生鋼琴，故選 (D)。2. (A) 就算第一個故事為真，也是後來要道別時才寫給有出演歌劇的 Elisabeth Röckel；(B) 真正的愛麗絲是誰仍未知；(D) 文中未提；僅 (C) 正確。3. (A) 第二個故事中的 Therese Malfatti 並未被稱為愛麗絲；(C) 是後來抄寫手稿的人將《給特雷莎》誤植為《給愛麗絲》；(D) Elise Barensfeld 是 Therese Malfatti 的學生；僅 (B) 正確。

items.unit: 114年會考
items.prompt: 【114教育會考】（ ）1. What do we know about Mark from the dialogue? (A) He made Linda unhappy. (B) He is looking for a new job. (C) He did not like Linda’s cake. (D) He is getting married to Jenny.（ ）2. Which is most likely an example of stealing someone’s thunder? (A) Dennis never changes his mind except when his wife tells him to. (B) Melisa tells Tom she’ll go to the party but tells her mom she’ll stay home. (C) Jeff tells everyone he’ll move abroad when Ivy is still telling them about her baby. (D) Alisa says she doesn’t care what we have for lunch but also doesn’t like the restaurant we chose.
choices: He is looking for a new job.
He did not like Linda’s cake.
He is getting married to Jenny.（ ）2. Which is most likely an example of stealing someone’s thunder?
Dennis never changes his mind except when his wife tells him to.
Melisa tells Tom she’ll go to the party but tells her mom she’ll stay home.
Jeff tells everyone he’ll move abroad when Ivy is still telling them about her baby.
Alisa says she doesn’t care what we have for lunch but also doesn’t like the restaurant we chose.
items.explanation: 1. 由對話可知，當 Jenny 說自己要結婚時，Mark 立刻插話說他也有好消息，這讓 Linda 生氣，覺得他在搶 Jenny 的風頭。Linda 甚至大喊他的名字表示不滿。因此可以推斷，Mark 的行為讓 Linda 不開心，故選 (A)。(B) Mark 是說他找到工作，不是正在找；(C) Mark 沒有說他不喜歡 Linda 的蛋糕；(D) Jenny 是說她要結婚，但沒說對象是誰。2. 對話中 Jenny 正在說她要結婚，但 Mark 忽然插話說他找到夢寐以求的工作，這讓 Jenny 的消息不再是焦點，可推知是「在搶 Jenny 的風頭」，因此 stealing someone’s thunder 表示「當別人正在分享他們的重要消息時，插入自己的事讓大家的注意力轉到你身上。」。選項 (C) 的情況和 Mark 的行為一樣，Ivy 還在講她的寶寶的事，Jeff 就突然說他要搬到國外，這讓大家可能不再專心聽 Ivy 的話，而去注意 Jeff 的消息，這就是「搶風頭」，故選 (C)。(A) 是說 Dennis 聽他太太的話，與搶風頭無關；(B) 是說 Melisa 對不同人講不同的話，是在說謊，與搶風頭無關；(D) 是說 Alisa 表面上說午餐吃什麼都可以，其實又挑三揀四，也與搶風頭無關。

items.prompt: I don’t think Katie will read any one of the books you’ve picked out for her: look(s) very boring.【106教育會考】(A) it (B) one (C) some (D) they
items.explanation: you’ve picked out for her 為形容詞子句，省略了當受格的關係代名詞 that / which，所以 the books 為 picked out 的受詞，意思為「你為她選的書」，而「書」為複數，故選 (D)，表示 Katie不會讀你為她選的書，因為「它們」都很無聊。any one of 在此的功用是加強語氣。

items.prompt: Marie Colvin was a world-famous war reporter. She was born in New York, USA, in 1956 and died in Homs, Syria, in 2012. When she was a student at Yale University, Colvin decided that she wanted to be a reporter in the future. She joined the Sunday Times, a UK newspaper, in 1985 and soon became its Middle East reporter. Besides the Middle East, she also reported from other parts of the world: Chechnya, Kosovo and Sri Lanka, for example. When she was reporting on the war in Sri Lanka, she lost her left eye. But that never stopped her. She still went to dangerous places that few reporters wanted to visit and stayed when others left. Colvin showed great empathy in her stories. For her, war reporting was not just some quick interviews and a few photos. She wrote about real people and their real lives. Her writing made you feel so strongly about these people’s stories, just like they were your own. She hoped that through her work the world would understand what really happened in war, and would take action to stop the fighting. On February 22, 2012, the day after she gave her report on the war in Homs, Colvin was killed when the house she was staying in was attacked. She always knew what price a war reporter might have to pay. She already lost an eye before. This time, she gave her life to the work she could not give up—telling the true stories to the world. war 戰爭【112教育會考】（ ）1. What is the reading mostly about? (A) Marie Colvin’s war reports. (B) Marie Colvin’s working life. (C) Marie Colvin’s schooldays at Yale. (D) Marie Colvin’s experiences in Homs.（ ）2.What does it mean when someone has empathy? (A) They are good at taking war photos. (B) They like to read other people’s life stories. (C) They are able to understand how other people feel. (D) They are good at helping people change their own lives.（ ）3.Which is true about Marie Colvin? (A) The chance to study at Yale made her leave her job in the Middle East. (B) The experience in Sri Lanka did not change her way of reporting news. (C) She was killed in Homs when she was interviewing soldiers there for her report. (D) She was not sure what to do in the future until she worked for the Sunday Times.
choices: Marie Colvin’s experiences in Homs.（ ）2.What does it mean when someone has empathy?
They are good at taking war photos.
They like to read other people’s life stories.
They are able to understand how other people feel.
They are good at helping people change their own lives.（ ）3.Which is true about Marie Colvin?
The chance to study at Yale made her leave her job in the Middle East.
The experience in Sri Lanka did not change her way of reporting news.
She was killed in Homs when she was interviewing soldiers there for her report.
She was not sure what to do in the future until she worked for the Sunday Times.
items.explanation: 1. 本文描述了 Marie Colvin 作為 Sunday Times 的記者入行，期間一直致力於報導，直到 2012 年甚至在戰地失去生命，皆為其工作生涯，故選 (B)。2. 根據此段說明可知，對 Marie Colvin 來說，戰地報導應該要讓人強烈感受到那些人的故事，就好像是自己的一樣，可推知 empathy 指的為同理心，故選 (C)。3. (A) 是大學畢業後才開始當記者；(C) 是在她當時待的家中遭受攻擊；(D) 在耶魯大學就讀時就決定要成為記者了；故選 (B)。

items.prompt: Here is the schedule with the notice of the summer school that Tina goes to. schedule 課表【105教育會考】（ ）1. What do we know from the notice? (A) The summer school is three weeks long. (B) Students can order lunch from the school restaurant. (C) There are basketball classes in the gym every week except the third week. (D) Those who need to borrow dancing shoes must tell Mr. Shum the day before.（ ）2. Below is what Tina told her friends about the classes in her summer school schedule.Which day was Tina talking about? (A) Monday. (B) Tuesday. (C) Wednesday. (D) Thursday.
choices: The summer school is three weeks long.
Students can order lunch from the school restaurant.
There are basketball classes in the gym every week except the third week.
Those who need to borrow dancing shoes must tell Mr. Shum the day before.（ ）2. Below is what Tina told her friends about the classes in her summer school schedule.Which day was Tina talking about?
items.explanation: 1. 選項 (A)「暑期學校為期三週」公告中未提；選項 (B)「學生可以從學校餐廳訂午餐」公告第一點指出，學校餐廳屆時關閉不營業（is closed），故不符；選項 (C)「除了第三週外，體育館每週都有籃球課」公告第三點特別指出第三週體育館要被挪用（will be used for…），可推斷一般上籃球課都會在體育館，故相符；選項 (D)「需要借舞鞋的學生得在當天前告訴 Shum 老師」公告第二點未點出借舞鞋時間，故不符。因此本題選 (C)。2. 由 two hours of PE classes in the afternoon（下午兩小時的體育課），可先找出下午有兩小時體育課的週一與週三，再由 draw a picture（畫圖）可推知體育課之前的上午，應該有繪畫課（painting），故選 (C)。

items.prompt: What does the word family mean to you? An American study in 2006 showed that people today 1. . Over 99% of the people who were interviewed agree that a husband, a wife, and a child are a family. At the same time, 94% see a parent with a child as a family, 91% say a husband and a wife, without children, are a family, and 81% think a man and a woman, with a child, but not married, are a family too. The study also found that 2. is very important in the modern thinking on family. Though 81% think a man and a woman, not married, with a child, are a family, the percentage (%) drops to 40% if the couple doesn’t have a child. This is also true with same-sex couples. About 60% see two men, or two women, with a child, as a family, but only 32% think so when the couple doesn’t have a child. In the study, those who see two men or two women that live together as a family often find it OK for same-sex couples to get married. 3. . However, not everyone opens their arms to same-sex couples： the study said 30% have no problem seeing pets as part of one’s family, but they do not think a same-sex couple is a family. couple 伴侶 same-sex 同性【105教育會考】（ ）1. (A) think differently about when to start a family (B) do not find family as important as their parents did (C) want many different things when they start a family (D) have several different ideas about what makes a family（ ）2. (A) whether people are married or not (B) whether people have a child or not (C) whether people live together or not (D) whether people love each other or not（ ）3. (A) This is not surprising (B) This is not possible everywhere (C) It is no good news for everyone (D) It cannot be this way for very long
choices: think differently about when to start a family
do not find family as important as their parents did
want many different things when they start a family
have several different ideas about what makes a family（ ）2.
whether people are married or not
whether people have a child or not
whether people live together or not
whether people love each other or not（ ）3.
It is no good news for everyone
It cannot be this way for very long
items.explanation: 1. 本主旨句之後，列出了四種家庭組成方式：一對夫妻＋一個小孩可以算一個家庭；一個家長＋一個小孩可以算一個家庭；一對夫妻無小孩可以算一個家庭；一男一女未婚＋一個小孩可以算一個家庭。故選 (D)「對於什麼樣的組成算是一個家庭有不同看法」。2. 本句亦為本段主旨句。由關鍵句 …not married, with a child, are a family, the percentage (%) drops to 40% if the couple doesn’t have a child（……未婚但有小孩算是一個家庭，但如果這對伴侶沒有小孩，百分比卻會掉至百分之四十），可推斷本段主要討論是否有小孩才算一個家庭的概念，故選 (B)。3. 下一句出現轉折語 However，可推知此句應該是支持上一句的說法，故選 (A)「這不意外」。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 106年會考
items.prompt: Jerry Stevens has been unhappy these months. He 1. a proud businessman of a successful shaved ice shop. His highest sales numbers were 1,899 plates a week; people called him “Ice King.” But all this changed when the cookie shop across the street started selling ice cream cookies. It took away half of his business. And 2. when Dan, his dead sister’s only son, came to work for him. Dan was a nice young man with a simple mind, too simple, maybe. He always let people try some shaved ice for free, but he never learned to see when “some” became “too much.” Many people came, but few bought. When the sales did not grow with the heat, Jerry started to worry. He wanted to send Dan home. But how could he? Dan had no family except him. Then, one day, 3. . And it was from across the street. The cookie shop 4. a clerk. For Jerry, it was a great chance to get Dan out of his store without sending him home. After taking the shopkeeper to several nice dinners, Jerry got Dan the job.Now Jerry could finally try and save his store. And maybe Dan would help by sending him a few people who are thirsty from eating too many cookies. shaved ice 刨冰【106教育會考】（ ）1. (A) is (B) has been (C) used to be (D) was going to be（ ）2. (A) things didn’t get better (B) he was ready to give up (C) the sales of shaved ice finally started to rise (D) the cookie shop was not successful for long（ ）3. (A) his only hope died (B) good news arrived (C) worse trouble came (D) the hard time passed（ ）4. (A) used to look for (B) has looked for (C) was looking for (D) had looked for
choices: he was ready to give up
the sales of shaved ice finally started to rise
the cookie shop was not successful for long（ ）3.
items.explanation: 1. 關鍵字落在第四句的 But，表示 Jerry「過去曾經是個」驕傲的生意人，「但」因某件事情發生，導致他現在已經不開心了好幾個月。故選 (C)。2. 第三段補充說明了第二小段的意思，Dan 來 Jerry 的店裡工作，反而增加客人佔便宜的機會，卻「沒讓生意更好」，也就是讓 Jerry 的狀況雪上加霜，故選 (A)。3. 由第四、五段文意可知 Jerry 得以將 Dan 送到對街店裡工作，進而專心拯救他自己的店，表示事情出了轉機，而轉機是對街店給的「好消息」，故選 (B)。4. 承上題，Dan 得以到對街店裡工作，表示「當時」該店「正在找」店員，故選 (C) 的 「過去進行式」。

items.prompt: Buses to the airport only come once every hour, and we just missed . Why don’t we take a taxi?【111教育會考】(A) another (B) it (C) one (D) them
items.explanation: 末句說「何不改搭計程車」，表示錯過了一班，用 one 來代稱其中但不特定的一班，故選 (C)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 104年會考
items.prompt: Here is the preface of Nick Foster’s new book Married to Food. PrefaceMy mother was lousy at cooking. To her, cooking was more like an exciting experiment. You put some of this and some of that in a pot, and you wait and see what will happen. “No experiments, no experiences.” is what she would say when her experiment did not turn out good, and I heard that a lot.My father was a good cook, and he loved to cook, too. He often said that he got my mother to marry him with a table of delicious food, not with a beautiful ring. “A family needs only one good cook,” he said.Now I am a cook myself. And I have my own restaurant. I learned how to cook from my father, of course. From him, I learned the art of cooking. But I did learn one thing from my mother. It’s her famous saying： “No experiments, no experiences.” preface 前言 experiment 實驗【104教育會考】（ ）1. What does it mean when someone is lousy at something? (A) They are famous for it. (B) They cannot do it well. (C) They think it is important. (D) They are not interested in it.（ ）2. What can we learn from the preface? (A) How Foster started his own restaurant. (B) When Foster’s father married Foster’s mother. (C) What Foster’s mother taught him about cooking. (D) How Foster learned the art of cooking from his father.
choices: They are not interested in it.（ ）2. What can we learn from the preface?
How Foster started his own restaurant.
When Foster’s father married Foster’s mother.
What Foster’s mother taught him about cooking.
How Foster learned the art of cooking from his father.
items.explanation: 1. 第二段描述 Nick Foster 的父親很會做菜，再加上最後一句 “A family needs only one good cook（一個家庭只需要一個好廚子）” 可判斷，第一段與第二段應該是反差，用來描述 Foster 的母親不會做菜（cannot cook well）。故選 (B)。2. 選項 (A)「Foster 如何開了自己的餐廳」、(B)「Foster 的父親何時與其母親結婚」、選項 (D)「Foster 如何從其父親學到了做菜的藝術」均未提。但第三段有說他的確從母親那學到關於做菜的一件事情—No experiments, no experience.，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: 【111教育補考】 enter 輸入（ ）1. What is the how-to list about? (A) How to join 2ndHandBooks. (B) How to buy books from 2ndHandBooks. (C) How to sell books through 2ndHandBooks. (D) How to send back books that are bought through 2ndHandBooks.（ ）2. What can we know from the how-to list? (A) People need to decide their book prices before they mail them. (B) People can get their books back after three months if no one buys them. (C) People should send an e-mail to 2ndHandBooks after they mail their books. (D) 2ndHandBooks will decide what kinds of books are good for sale after people mail them.
choices: How to send back books that are bought through 2ndHandBooks.（ ）2. What can we know from the how-to list?
People need to decide their book prices before they mail them.
People can get their books back after three months if no one buys them.
People should send an e-mail to 2ndHandBooks after they mail their books.
2ndHandBooks will decide what kinds of books are good for sale after people mail them.
items.explanation: 1. 由第 3.1 步驟「決定每本你想要販賣的書的價格」可知，應是可以透過 2ndHandBooks 網站販賣書籍。2. (A) 決定書籍價格在第 3.1 步驟，而郵寄書本在第 4 步驟，故為正解；(B) 由第 7.2 步驟可知，三個月後沒人買的書籍可以上網更改售價，或是交由 2ndHandBooks 處理；(C) 第 5 步驟可知，2ndHandBooks 會在三天內寄電子郵件通知是否收到書；(D) 由第 2 步驟可知，2ndHandBooks 在一開始就會決定能販賣的書籍。

items.prompt: Students ＿＿＿ to go on the school trip should ask their parents first.【113教育會考】(A) who want(B) want (C) who they want(D) what they want
items.explanation: 由句子結構可知需用關係代名詞修飾先行詞 students，表示「想參加學校旅遊的學生」，且關係代名詞在句中當主詞，不可省略，故選 (A)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 105年會考
items.prompt: It was 11 p.m. and Molly walked out of her bakery. She turned and looked at her store one last time. She wanted to remember what it 1. at the moment. A few hours later, people would come and clean out everything in the store. A young man had bought it. He 2. it into a flower shop. Before it was a bakery, this place 3. a small coffee shop. Molly worked in the shop as a waitress. But taking orders was never Molly’s dream; baking was. When she knew her boss planned to sell the shop, she borrowed money and bought it. Her bakery had been open for thirty years. Thirty very wonderful years. However, it would all come to an end tonight. Molly 4. the bakery to be a family business. But her daughter was never interested in baking. Molly did not want her business in a stranger’s hands, so after some serious thinking, she decided to close it. “Goodbye, my dear old friend,” Molly looked at the store, whispering. whisper 低語【105教育會考】（ ）1. (A) had looked like (B) looked like (C) would look like (D) has looked like（ ）2. (A) had changed (B) changed (C) was going to change (D) has changed（ ）3. (A) used to be (B) would be (C) has been (D) is（ ）4. (A) had wanted (B) has wanted (C) would want (D) will want
items.explanation: 1. at the moment 表「當時」，而「當時」為過去簡單式（wanted to），故選 (B)。2. 承上一題，在過去時間點（at the moment）之前已經買下這店面（had bought it），而在過去時間點之後將要發生的事情，要用過去未來式「was / were going to＋V」，故選 (C)。3. 依上下文可推斷，此句在描述過去既成事實，故選 (A)。4. 由下一句 her daughter was never interested in baking（她女兒對烘焙從未有興趣）可推知，Molly 在那過去的時間點，已經想過這件事情，應用過去完成式表示，故選 (A)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 113年會考
items.prompt: Usually, people visit bookstores to buy books. But those who walk into Cotoha come to see its owner, Chen Bing-Hong. They bring him books with different problems. Some have lost their covers, some are missing a few pages, and some have pages that are falling out. Chen can always fix the books and make them whole again. Chen sees himself as a doctor. He says that books, like people, get sick and need help. In Taiwan, there are not many “doctors” like him, and most of them work for big libraries and museums. If big libraries and museums are hospitals, Chen’s bookstore is a health center. Big libraries and museums fix important old books with serious problems, and Chen helps people with books that have smaller problems. However, the smaller size of the problems doesn’t mean Chen’s job is less important. Chen gave an example of a science book he once worked on. It was very old and half of its cover was lost. Its owner still wanted to keep it because it was a gift from a teacher who helped him follow his dream of studying science. When he got his book back, he was very surprised at the new-old book. He felt he was brought back to the days with his teacher. Seeing the owner’s smile made Chen happy, because smiles like that are what his magic is for.【113教育會考】（ ）1. Why does the writer talk about doctors and a health center in the reading? (A) To explain Chen’s services. (B) To talk about Chen’s future plans. (C) To explain Chen’s love for books. (D) To show why bookstores are important.（ ）2. Why is Chen Bing-Hong’s job important in the example he gave? (A) It allows people to get books as gifts. (B) It saves people money on new books. (C) It gives people hope to follow their dreams. (D) It helps people think of special moments in the past.（ ）3. What is his magic? (A) Fixing books. (B) Making book owners smile. (C) Finding books that are long lost. (D) Changing his bookstore into a library.
choices: To talk about Chen’s future plans.
To explain Chen’s love for books.
To show why bookstores are important.（ ）2. Why is Chen Bing-Hong’s job important in the example he gave?
It allows people to get books as gifts.
It saves people money on new books.
It gives people hope to follow their dreams.
It helps people think of special moments in the past.（ ）3. What is his magic?
Finding books that are long lost.
Changing his bookstore into a library.
items.explanation: 1. 作者透過比喻大型圖書館和博物館是醫院，而 Chen 的書店是健康中心，來解釋 Chen 的服務，故選 (A)。2. 在他舉的例子中，這本書對於它的主人有特殊的意義，因為它讓他想起了和老師在一起的日子。由此可知 Chen 的工作可以幫助人們回憶過去的特殊時刻，故選 (D)。3. 由本段可知，「他的魔法」是 Chen 透過修復書籍，讓書的主人感到高興並回憶過去的時光，故選 (A)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 107年會考
items.prompt: I’ve wanted to read The Diary of a Young Girl for months, today I finally borrowed the book from the library.【107教育會考】(A) and (B) since(C) so (D) until
items.explanation: 想看這本書「有數月之久」，「而」今天終於借到了這本書，故選 (A)。因為「終於」所產生的語氣，使前後兩子句間沒有強烈的因果關係，故不選 (C)。

items.prompt: Sorry, but Ms. Shih can’t talk right now. Could you please call back ?【111教育補考】(A) finally (B) later (C) next (D) slowly
items.explanation: 由現在不能通話可知，應該是請對方「晚點」再致電，故選 (B)。

items.prompt: For Mike, the price is _____ important thing when he shops for jeans. He cares even more about the shape and the size of the pockets. 【109教育會考】(A) the more (B) the most(C) the less (D) the least
items.explanation: 由後句提到 Mike 甚至更在意牛仔褲的口袋形狀跟大小，可知價錢對他而言，是「最不」重要的，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 111年會考
items.prompt: The problem of long working hours is a real headache in our country. It kills many people every year (see Figure 1), and many companies are trying to change that. They have at least one “No Overtime Day” in a week, and it is often Wednesday. On “No Overtime Day,” workers are asked to leave their offices before 8 p.m. At 8 p.m., companies play the song “There’s Always Tomorrow” and turn off all the lights. However, after the workers walk out of their offices, they don’t go home. Some go back later, turn on their table lamps, and keep working, and others find somewhere else to work until very late at night. Restaurants and coffee shops are busier on Wednesday evenings, and they have started selling drinks and meals for these workers. But why do these people keep working? A study shows that workers who work more hours often have a bigger chance to get paid more and rise higher in their companies. This is true for both men and women (see Figure 2). Working long hours has become a way to show that people are hard-working. Clearly, this must be changed before the problem gets any worse. Figure 1 Figure 2【111教育會考】 average 平均（ ）1. There are four important points in the report: a. What “No Overtime Day” is b. Why “No Overtime Day” fails c. Why there is “No Overtime Day” in the countryd. How workers deal with “No Overtime Day” How are they ordered in the report? order 排序 (A) a→c→d→b. (B) a→d→c→b. (C) c→a→b→d. (D) c→a→d→b.（ ）2. What does this mean in the report? (A) The way workers show they are hard-working. (B) Restaurants and coffee shops open until very late at night. (C) Workers do not go home when they walk out of the office. (D) The number of workers who get paid more and rise higher in the company.（ ）3. What can we learn from Figure 1 and Figure 2? (A) Long working hours killed more women than men in 2014. (B) Long working hours kills more and more workers every year. (C) Men usually have a bigger chance to get paid more and rise higher when they work the same hours as women. (D) Men and women have almost the same chance to get paid more and rise higher when they work 2,200 hours.
choices: c→a→d→b.（ ）2. What does this mean in the report?
The way workers show they are hard-working.
Restaurants and coffee shops open until very late at night.
Workers do not go home when they walk out of the office.
The number of workers who get paid more and rise higher in the company.（ ）3. What can we learn from Figure 1 and Figure 2?
Long working hours killed more women than men in 2014.
Long working hours kills more and more workers every year.
Men usually have a bigger chance to get paid more and rise higher when they work the same hours as women.
Men and women have almost the same chance to get paid more and rise higher when they work 2,200 hours.
items.explanation: 1. 第一段首先提到某些公司設立「不加班日」，接著解釋「不加班日」是什麼；第二段提及勞工如何因應「不加班日」，後又闡述因為勞工離開公司後仍繼續工作，「不加班日」沒有達到目的，四個論點被提到的順序為 c→a→d→b，故選 (D)。2. 由文章最後一段敘述可知，工時過長的根本問題是「勞工透過長時間工作來展現自己的勤奮」，因此最末句所說的必須被改變的問題正是前述這一問題，故選 (A)。3. 圖表 2的 X 軸「每年平均工時」落在2200時，男性虛線和女性黑線落在同一點（Y 軸數值相同），由此可推知，當兩個性別都工作 2200 小時時，加薪與升遷機率是一樣的，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 109年會考
items.prompt: NOlympics in Munich 11/11/2013 People in the city of Munich have spoken their mind: they do not want to host the Winter Olympics in 2022. To the cities that fight for this chance, ＿1.＿. The Olympics usually do a lot of good to the host city. The Games bring in jobs, visitors, and, most important of all, money. So why did people in Munich say no? The Olympics ＿2.＿ for people in Munich. For them, the world’s biggest sports festival could invite serious trouble. There would be a lot of building work before the Games, and during the Games, too much traffic and too many visitors. Life would become terrible and nature would be hurt. And ＿3.＿: Munich hosted the 1972 Summer Olympics, and its neighbor, the mountain town Garmisch-Partenkirchen, hosted the 1936 Winter Olympics. Still, the heavy price Munich paid does not worry the cities that are in the race to get the 2022 Winter Olympics. ＿4.＿, they are happy that Munich said no to the Olympics—their chances of getting the Games have become higher. host 舉辦 Olympics 奧運 visitor 遊客【109教育會考】（ ）1. (A) this is surely a surprise (B) this sounds like a good idea (C) this is perhaps a smart answer (D) this is old news they have heard（ ）2. (A) had given hopes (B) are a different story (C) bring a bright future (D) have been a great plan（ ）3. (A) this will not go away; it will stay (B) they are not just saying it; they are going to do it (C) they do not speak for others; they only speak for themselves (D) this is not a guess; it is a lesson they learned from hard experience（ ）4. (A) In fact (B) If so (C) However (D) Finally
choices: this sounds like a good idea
this is perhaps a smart answer
this is old news they have heard（ ）2.
this will not go away; it will stay
they are not just saying it; they are going to do it
they do not speak for others; they only speak for themselves
this is not a guess; it is a lesson they learned from hard experience（ ）4.
items.explanation: 1. 由最後一段句末「他們很高興慕尼黑拒絕舉辦奧運─這表示他們獲得主辦奧運的機會隨之升高」，可推知對爭取主辨奧運的其他城市來說，慕尼黑的退出無疑是個意外之喜，故選 (A)。2. 第一段提到一般主辦奧運能為該城市帶來工作、遊客和金錢，屬於正面的例子，但接著由第二段提到的反例：過多的交通問題與觀光人潮、生活會變得糟糕，自然環境會受到破壞，可推知慕尼黑居民對主辦奧運的想法與其他城市不同，故選 (B)。3. 由後句「1972 年慕尼黑夏季奧運與其鄰鎮曾舉辦 1936 年冬季奧運」可知，交通問題、觀光人潮、自然環境破壞等問題都是「他們從主辦奧運學到的教訓」，故選 (D)。4. in fact 用於補充前文，或是用於舉例強調。最後一段提到慕尼黑付出的沉重代價並未使得爭取 2022 年冬季奧運的其他城市卻步，反而很高興慕尼黑拒絕舉辦奧運，因為他們獲得主辦奧運的機會隨之升高。由此可知後句為補充說明，故選 (A)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 111年會考(補考)
items.prompt: If you visit Spain, you will hear people speaking Spanish most of the time. But if you go north to the Basque Country, you will also hear a language that is only spoken there: Euskara. Nobody knows when people began to speak Euskara, but one thing is for sure: It was already in Europe before any other language arrived. Although Euskara has been around for thousands of years, it experienced its worst time in the 1990s, when it almost died out. From 1939 to 1975, when Spain was in Francisco Franco’s hands, everyone had to use Spanish only. Under this rule, people who were heard speaking other languages would be stopped by the police. And the police were always around, so the Basque people were afraid to speak Euskara in any public places. They felt that even the walls were listening. Over time, the Basque people spoke Euskara less and less, and some families even stopped teaching their children the language. To save Euskara, some people set up language schools to teach Euskara. Because of their hard work, Euskara was not “killed” but lived on long after Franco died. Although Euskara is heard and seen across the Basque Country today, Spanish is still more commonly used in Spain. However, many people who know Euskara still choose to speak Spanish in public places. For this reason, some people have started to worry again about the future of Euskara. How long can it live?【111教育補考】 Basque Country 巴斯克自治區（西班牙境內）（ ）1. Why did the Basque people feel that even the walls were listening? (A) Because the police heard about their language schools. (B) Because they heard people speaking Euskara everywhere. (C) Because they were scared of being heard speaking Euskara. (D) Because they enjoyed listening to people speaking Euskara.（ ）2. What problem does the writer think Euskara has today? (A) Euskara is only spoken in the Basque Country. (B) Euskara is going to be killed by Francisco Franco’s rule. (C) Some families have stopped teaching their children Euskara. (D) Many Euskara speakers choose to speak Spanish in public places.（ ）3. What can we learn about Euskara from the reading? (A) It is the oldest language in Europe. (B) It has borrowed many words from Spanish. (C) It is the second most popular language in Spain. (D) It is more difficult than other languages in Europe.
choices: Because the police heard about their language schools.
Because they heard people speaking Euskara everywhere.
Because they were scared of being heard speaking Euskara.
Because they enjoyed listening to people speaking Euskara.（ ）2. What problem does the writer think Euskara has today?
Euskara is only spoken in the Basque Country.
Euskara is going to be killed by Francisco Franco’s rule.
Some families have stopped teaching their children Euskara.
Many Euskara speakers choose to speak Spanish in public places.（ ）3. What can we learn about Euskara from the reading?
It is the oldest language in Europe.
It has borrowed many words from Spanish.
It is the second most popular language in Spain.
It is more difficult than other languages in Europe.
items.explanation: 1. 由前句可知，四處都有警察，所以「巴斯克人害怕在公共場所說巴斯克語」，故選 (C)。2. 由倒數第三句可知，許多懂巴斯克語的人仍然選擇在公開場合說西班牙語，此為作者擔心巴斯克語是否能繼續保存的原因，故選 (D)。3. (A) 由第一段最後一句可知，在其他語言傳到歐洲前，巴斯克語就已經存在，故選 (A)。

items.prompt: Below is a page from Katie’s diary.Dear Diary, June 7, 2011 I was very sad to hear what happened to Woollie yesterday. Woollie was my favorite sheep. I have a storybook about Woollie. It says when Woollie was four, he ran away from Mr. Armstrong’s farm, and it took Mr. Armstrong six years to find Woollie. But Woollie had grown so much fleece that he didn’t even look like a sheep. Mr. Armstrong decided to cut his fleece on TV so everyone could see. Daddy said this happened on the day I was born. Woollie’s fleece weighed 27 kg, and could make clothes for 20 large men. I asked Daddy if his favorite vest was made from Woollie’s fleece. Daddy said no, because Woollie’s fleece was sold to collect money for sick kids. In the storybook, Woollie was taken to see Ms. Stella Clark, the leader of our city then. They even had tea together. Daddy said Woollie did meet Ms. Clark, but he wasn’t sure if they had tea. Daddy said Woollie was put down because he was too sick and there was no way to help him. I cried. I hope Woollie will be happy up there in the sky.【110教育會考】 fleece 羊毛 weigh 重達（ ）1. What do we know about Woollie from Katie’s diary? (A) Woollie was older than Katie. (B) Woollie was taken to visit sick kids. (C) Woollie was sick when he ran away. (D) Woollie looked strange without his fleece.（ ）2. Which picture of Woollie and Ms. Clark did Katie talk about in her diary?(A) (B) (C) (D)（ ）3. What happened when Woollie was put down? (A) He was sold. (B) He couldn’t be found. (C) He died. (D) He became famous.
choices: Woollie was taken to visit sick kids.
Woollie was sick when he ran away.
Woollie looked strange without his fleece.（ ）2. Which picture of Woollie and Ms. Clark did Katie talk about in her diary?
（ ）3. What happened when Woollie was put down?
items.explanation: 1. Armstrong 先生在 Woollie 走失六年後才找到他，並決定在電視上公開為他剃羊毛，而 Katie 的父親說此事發生時，Katie 才剛出生，可知 Woollie 比 Katie 大，故選 (A)。2. 倒數第五～六句提到，Woollie 與城市領導人 Stella Clark 女士見面，甚至一起喝了茶，故選 (C)。3. 由本句後方可知 Woollie 病得很重，且沒有方法可以幫助他，再由最後兩句 Katie 甚至哭了，並且希望 Woollie 在天空彼端可以過得開心，可知 Woollie 應該是過世了，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: VOF NEWS16 / 01 / 2015 For many people, having a cup of coffee right out of bed is the best way to start a day. But a report from Asap Science says otherwise. It says the worst time for coffee is soon after we get up. When we wake up, our bodies start to make cortisol. Cortisol helps us to think clearly and be quick to understand and act. The cortisol levels rise after we wake up and climb to the highest in about an hour. So there are two problems when we drink coffee during this time：(1) our bodies will make less cortisol, and (2) the cortisol will make coffee less useful. And that’s why some of us drink more and more coffee. Then, when’s the best time to have coffee? When the cortisol levels are going down, the report says. Cortisol levels are usually highest between 8 a.m. and 9 a.m., between noon and 1 p.m., and between 5：30 p.m. and 6：30 p.m. So if you want to have coffee, enjoy it after these times, and this popular drink will help you the most.------------------------------------------------ What do you think?------------------------------------------------【108教育會考】（ ）1. Which idea is talked about in the news? (A) How often we should drink coffee. (B) What happens when we have too much coffee. (C) How to help the body make the cortisol we need. (D) What happens when we have coffee at the wrong time.（ ）2. What does it mean when someone thinks “otherwise” about something? (A) They are serious about it. (B) They have no idea about it. (C) They think differently about it. (D) They do not think it is a problem.（ ）3. The picture below shows how the cortisol levels rise and fall during the day. From the news, which is a good time for coffee? (A) A. (B) B. (C) C. (D) D.（ ）4. Four people read the news and wrote what they thought about it. Mike：The best time to drink coffee is when you want to drink coffee. (Jan 16 8：26 pm) Sarah：I usually wake up AFTER I drink coffee! (Jan 16 8：43 pm) Charlie：The worst time to drink coffee is when you’re DEAD. (Jan 16 8：59 pm) Lisa：If you need someone to tell you when to drink coffee, well, that’s just sad. (Jan 16 9：18 pm) What did they think about the news? (A) They wanted to try what it said. (B) They were sad about what it said. (C) They did not agree with what it said. (D) They were not surprised at what it said.
choices: How often we should drink coffee.
What happens when we have too much coffee.
How to help the body make the cortisol we need.
What happens when we have coffee at the wrong time.（ ）2. What does it mean when someone thinks “otherwise” about something?
They have no idea about it.
They do not think it is a problem.（ ）3. The picture below shows how the cortisol levels rise and fall during the day. From the news, which is a good time for coffee?
They wanted to try what it said.
They were sad about what it said.
They did not agree with what it said.
They were not surprised at what it said.
items.explanation: 1. 第一段前半提出錯誤的喝咖啡時間，後半則解釋若在錯誤的時間喝咖啡會導致的問題；第二段則提出喝咖啡的好時段建議。選項中提到上述內容的只有 (D)，故選之。2. 關鍵在本句的第一個字 But。But 具有「轉折」語氣，常用於引導與前述「不同的」意見，故選 (C)。3. 關鍵句在第二段第一、二句，喝咖啡最好的時段是皮質醇數值「下降」時，曲線圖中只有 D 在「下降」，故選 (D)。4. Mike、Charlie 與 Lisa 的概念是想喝就喝；Sarah 則強調自己得靠喝咖啡才能清醒。由此推知四人均「不認同」此篇新聞報導「依照皮質醇數值高低來喝咖啡才好」的概念，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: You Drink Tea-Rock & We Send You to the USAThank You for Being with Us for Twenty Summers & WintersCut out the picture of the tea cup on a bottle of Tea-Rock tea, collect two of the pictures, and paste them on a postcard. On the postcard, be sure to write down your name, birthday, telephone number, e-mail address, and your favorite Tea-Rock tea. What does Tea-Rock celebrate? (A) Their sales in 20 countries. (B) The coming out of their 20th kind of tea. (C) Their 20th year of business. (D) The opening of their 20th store in the USA.（ ）2. items.explanation: 1. 由廣告第二行「感謝您陪我們走過二十個夏天和冬天」及相關回饋消費者的抽獎活動可知，岩石茶飲應是在慶祝品牌二十週年，故選 (C)。2. 由廣告抽獎辦法可知，明信片須附上兩張茶杯圖樣，並寫上名字、生日、電話號碼、電子信箱和最喜歡的岩石茶飲，而 Jason 已於明信片上貼上兩張茶杯圖樣，並註明名字、電話號碼、電子信箱和最喜歡的岩石茶飲，因此可知 Jason 仍須補充他的生日，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: 【106教育會考】（ ）1. What is the book festival for? (A) Selling second-hand books. (B) Telling people how to choose books. (C) Inviting people to change books with each other. (D) Knowing what kinds of books are the most popular.（ ）2. Sonja is busy packing some books for the book festival. Which is most likely one of them? likely 可能 (A) An old dictionary of medicine. (B) A book of short stories in English. (C) A picture book with her own notes. (D) A workbook she used in her math class.（ ）3. Look at the calendar. If Sean has a book festival card, when can he use it? calendar 月曆 (A) March 3. (B) March 14. (C) March 23. (D) March 29.
choices: Telling people how to choose books.
Inviting people to change books with each other.
Knowing what kinds of books are the most popular.（ ）2. Sonja is busy packing some books for the book festival. Which is most likely one of them? likely 可能
A book of short stories in English.
A picture book with her own notes.
A workbook she used in her math class.（ ）3. Look at the calendar. If Sean has a book festival card, when can he use it? calendar 月曆
items.explanation: 1. 由內文第二至四行可知此項活動是要人拿出不想看的舊書，再從別人那裏換取想看的書，也就是「彼此換書」的活動，故選 (C)。2. 由內文的 What books 可知「學校用書、漫畫書與字典」不可交換，Notice 說「有缺頁或筆記的書」也不可交換，選項中只有「英文短篇故事書」符合可換書的條件，故選 (B)。3. 由內文的 When & How 可知用卡換書的時間為「3 月 16 日到 31 日」，而倒數第二行括弧中指出「週一是休館日」，因此 Sean 能換書的時間只剩下「3 月 23 日」，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: The Way Outby Ming-da Wang$450 → $199 Buy it now!http://www.mingdawangbooks.net/thewayout/Words from readersI couldn’t put the book down after I read some pages at my friend’s home. I borrowed it and read it over that night. I think it can help someone who is afraid to face family problems.—Sam LeeThe book saved my life. It opened a door that led me into a world of true love. I was able to look at the world around me with fresh new eyes.—Candy VigorThe first part of the book really touched my heart and made me want to read on. However, I was getting bored when I came to the second part. In fact, I didn’t finish the book.—Rod GreenThe book helped me forget about my worries. I laughed and cried with those people in the book. With its simple and clear language, people of all ages can enjoy it.—Vivian Lu【103教育會考】（ ）1. Which is NOT said about the book in the reading? (A) It tells a true story. (B) It is cheaper now. (C) A reader thinks it is easy to understand. (D) A reader thinks its second part is boring.（ ）2. What can readers most likely learn from the book? likely 可能 (A) A new way of seeing the world. (B) How to be a comic writer. (C) A smart way to face work problems. (D) How to buy a book on the Internet.
choices: A reader thinks it is easy to understand.
A reader thinks its second part is boring.（ ）2. What can readers most likely learn from the book? likely 可能
A new way of seeing the world.
How to be a comic writer.
A smart way to face work problems.
How to buy a book on the Internet.
items.explanation: 1. 選項 (A)「它是真實的故事。」文章中只有寫 true love（真愛），並沒有說真實的故事；選項 (B)「它現在比較便宜。」文章開始有標出價格的改變，從四百五十元改成一百九十九元，故符合；選項 (C)「有個讀者認為它很容易懂。」與讀者 Vivian Lu 所反映相符；選項 (D)「有個讀者認為它第二部分無聊。」與讀者 Rod Green 所反映相符。故本題選 (A)。 2. 只有選項 (A)「新的方式看世界。」與讀者 Candy Vigor 的評價有相符。故選 (A)。

items.prompt: Since the first case of “Cow Cold” was reported in Kirk State in June, this killer cold has moved up north faster than we thought it would. By July, almost every part of the country had been attacked by Cow Cold. In only two months, the number of dead cows has risen to 5,000. Though Cow Cold started in the south, the east of the country is the worst hit area. By this week, 80% of the farms in Osten State have reported cases of Cow Cold. The sale of milk in Osten State has slumped because of Cow Cold. Before Cow Cold, the sale of milk in Osten State was $2.5 million each week; now it is less than $500,000. Odin State is the only area in the north without cases of Cow Cold. Before we know how to deal with Cow Cold, we can only hope Odin State will be lucky enough not to experience the power of this killer cold.(Elaine Baker, City Post) case 案例 area 區域【105教育會考】（ ）1. What can we learn from the news report? (A) How to deal with Cow Cold. (B) Whether people may catch Cow Cold. (C) How fast Cow Cold has hit the country. (D) How to find out if cows have Cow Cold.（ ）2. Which map will most likely appear with the above news report? likely 可能 (A) (B) (C) (D) （ ）3. If a store’s sales keep slumping, what would the sales chart look like? chart 圖表 (A) (B) (C) (D)
choices: How to deal with Cow Cold.
Whether people may catch Cow Cold.
How fast Cow Cold has hit the country.
How to find out if cows have Cow Cold.（ ）2. Which map will most likely appear with the above news report? likely 可能
（ ）3. If a store’s sales keep slumping, what would the sales chart look like? chart 圖表
items.explanation: 1. 選項 (A)「如何防治牛隻傳染病」與第三段第二句不符；選項 (B)「人類是否會感染牛隻傳染病」、選項 (D)「如何知道牛隻是否得到傳染病」文中未提；選項 (C)「牛隻傳染病如何快速地衝擊全國」與第一段主文相符，故選 (C)。2. 關鍵句為 Though Cow Cold started in the south, the east of the country is the worst hit area.（牛隻傳染病雖然始於南部，東部卻受災最嚴重。）、Odin State is the only area in the north without cases of Cow Cold.（Odin 州是北部唯一沒有牛隻傳染病案例的地區。），故選東部嚴重、北部有一區空白的選項 (A)。3. 過去銷量二百五十萬美金（was $2.5 million），如今低於五十萬美金（is less than $500,000），可推知銷量銳減、下降，故選 (A)。

items.prompt: SHARP WEAR：A T-shirt like no other!First time here? Don’t worry! Here is our quick lesson for you!【107教育會考】（ ）1. What is the quick lesson of SHARP WEAR about? (A) How to get to one of SHARP WEAR’s stores. (B) How to send back a T-shirt to SHARP WEAR. (C) How to shop for a T-shirt from SHARP WEAR. (D) How to take care of a T-shirt from SHARP WEAR.（ ）2. What can we learn about SHARP WEAR? (A) You have to order at least four T-shirts each time. (B) You can choose from sixteen colors for both the T-shirt and the pocket. (C) Some of the T-shirts have pictures on both the front side and the back side. (D) T-shirts in the wrong sizes cannot be sent back if they have pictures or pockets on them.

How to send back a T-shirt to SHARP WEAR.
How to shop for a T-shirt from SHARP WEAR.
How to take care of a T-shirt from SHARP WEAR.（ ）2. What can we learn about SHARP WEAR?
You have to order at least four T-shirts each time.
You can choose from sixteen colors for both the T-shirt and the pocket.
Some of the T-shirts have pictures on both the front side and the back side.
T-shirts in the wrong sizes cannot be sent back if they have pictures or pockets on them.
items.explanation: 1. 由流程圖可知，這是關於如何在 SHARP WEAR 購買 T恤，故選 (C)。2. 由流程圖的步驟 2 和 5 可知，T恤與口袋都有十六種顏色可選擇，故選 (B)。

Use 6 Sunny Sun pictures and pay $100.

items.explanation: 1. 廣告第一段描述，「在 Sunny 市場每消費五十元（除了書本和 CD 之外的任何東西），您將獲得一張 Sunny 陽光圖片。」可知購買書本無法獲得 Sunny 陽光圖片，故選 (D)。2. 由於 Sammy 只有七張 Sunny 陽光圖片，不符合廣告第一點所提及的「蒐集十二張圖片，您可免費獲得一個 Sunny 杯子」。由廣告第三點可知，只要蒐集六張圖片，並付費兩百元，即可獲得一個 Sunny 杯子，故選 (B)。

items.prompt: Buy a White Lake City Card When You’re in the City①With any of the Cards, you can- visit the city by metro, bus, or train as many times as you want. *- take one child under 12 with you for free.- save 20% on tickets to public museums.②The 1-day, 3-day, and 5-day Cards are for trips from Monday to Friday, and the Weekend Card is for trips on weekends and holidays.③Check the map and buy the right Card for the zones you’ll be entering.* The Cards are only for trips inside the three zones.ⓐ White Lake Main Stationⓑ Museum of White Lake City Historyⓒ Museum of Modern Artⓓ White Lakeⓔ White Lake Castleⓕ White Lake Airport zone 區【114教育會考】（ ）1. What can you do with a White Lake City Card? (A) Save 20% on children’s train tickets. (B) Visit any public museum in the city for free. (C) Take a train to places out of the three zones. (D) Move around the city by metro as much as you want.（ ）2. Stacy is going to White Lake City and is staying at a hotel near the White Lake Main Station. She wants to visit the Museum of White Lake City History on Friday and see White Lake on Saturday. If she plans to buy (a) White Lake City Card(s), which of the four choices will be best for her and cost her the least? (A) A 3-day Card for Zone 1. (B) A Weekend Card for Zones 1-3. (C) A 1-day Card for Zone 1 and a Weekend Card for Zones 1-2. (D) A 1-day Card for Zones 1-2 and a Weekend Card for Zones 1-2.
choices: Visit any public museum in the city for free.
Take a train to places out of the three zones.
A 1-day Card for Zone 1 and a Weekend Card for Zones 1-2.
A 1-day Card for Zones 1-2 and a Weekend Card for Zones 1-2.
items.explanation: 1. 由第一點第一項可知，持卡者可以「無限次搭乘地鐵、公車或火車」，而選項 (D) 你可以盡情搭地鐵在城市裡到處走動，與文中敘述相近，as much as you want 跟文中的 as many times as you want 皆可陳述「你想搭幾次就搭幾次」，故選 (D)。2. Stacy 週五要造訪：ⓑ「白湖城市歷史博物館」，位於區域 1；週六要造訪：ⓓ「白湖」，位於區域 2。因此她需要：週五的區域 1 的市卡＋週六的區域 2 的市卡（至少區域 1–2）。而選項 (C) 提供了：區域 1 的 1 日卡（$20），適用週五，區域 1–2 的週末卡（$50），適用週六，總共 $70，是符合需求且最便宜的組合，故選 (C)。選項 (A) 只能進區域1；選項 (B) 週末卡不能在週五使用；選項 (D) 雖也符合需求，但費用為40+50＝90，比選項 (C) 貴，故不選。

items.prompt: Below is how four students answered their teacher’s question in class.Lily：I like shopping and talking to people. I think I can learn how to do business. Maybe selling clothes is a good business for me.Ryan：My hobbies are playing computer games and making friends online. We often share our funny stories by e-mail. I guess I will learn more about computers and make super-smart computer programs.Bill：My parents have kept lots of pets since I was little. We’ve experienced many things together, good and bad, happy and sad. Those stories have always stayed in my mind. One day, I will share them with people by drawing and writing books.Anna：Though my mom and two sisters are all doctors, I’m sure I will stay as far away from a hospital as I can. I hate being sick, and I’m afraid of seeing sick people looking weak and sad. I’ll keep strong by playing my favorite sport, tennis, every day. One day I’ll join the national team and be another Lu Yen-Hsun.【104教育會考】（ ）1. What question did the teacher most likely ask in class? likely 可能 (A) “What do you want to do in the future?” (B) “What’s your plan for the coming vacation?” (C) “What do you like to talk about with your friends?” (D) “What’s your favorite thing to do with your family?”（ ）2. What do we know from the reading? (A) Lily is good at making clothes. (B) One of Bill’s parents is an animal doctor. (C) Ryan enjoys meeting people on the Internet. (D) Anna was once very sick and stayed in the hospital for a long time.（ ）3. What does them mean? (A) Pets. (B) Books. (C) Stories. (D) Parents.
choices: “What do you want to do in the future?”
“What’s your plan for the coming vacation?”
“What do you like to talk about with your friends?”
“What’s your favorite thing to do with your family?”（ ）2. What do we know from the reading?
Lily is good at making clothes.
One of Bill’s parents is an animal doctor.
Ryan enjoys meeting people on the Internet.
Anna was once very sick and stayed in the hospital for a long time.（ ）3. What does them mean?
items.explanation: 1. 關鍵句為 Anna 的前兩句：Anna 的母親與姐姐們都是「醫生（doctors）」，而她確定自己「將會（I will...）」盡可能的遠離醫院，可判斷 Anna 被問的問題應該是跟自己的將來（future）有關。故選 (A)。 2. 選項 (A) 的 Lily 選擇的是販售衣服（selling clothes），並未提她擅長製衣（making clothes），故不符；選項 (B) 的 Bill 只有提到父母親養了許多寵物（kept lots of pets），並未提父母職業，故不符；選項 (C) 的 Ryan 有提喜歡網上交友（making friends online），相符；選項 (D) 的 Anna 並未提自己曾經住院很常一段時間，故不符。故本題選 (C)。3. them 代替前一句提到的 Those stories。故選 (C)。

items.prompt: In the past, people thought it was a idea to send e-mails and read news online, but now it is part of our everyday life.【106教育會考】(A) simple (B) popular (C) good (D) fresh
items.explanation: 關鍵詞為 In the past 與 but now，表示在做「過去」與「現在」的比較，且具有轉折意味；因此若對「現在」而言已成為是生活的一部分時，即表示不再同「過去」剛出爐般「新鮮（fresh）」了，故選 (D)。

items.unit: 111年會考
items.prompt: English words are made of 26 letters, and palindromes and anagrams are two kinds of word games about spelling. A palindrome is a word or a sentence that reads the same from left to right or from right to left, 1. , “eye,” “Bob,” “my gym,” and “Was it a car or a cat I saw?” An anagram of a word or words is made by putting the letters of the word or words in a different way. Look at the words and their anagrams below. Can you think of other possible anagrams of these words?Anagrams are often longer words that don’t really mean anything but are fun to say. Sometimes they can even mean something 3. , like when a common word, “restaurant,” becomes “Eat rats, run!”Actually, palindromes and anagrams are 4. . Palindromes can be used to learn mathematics and make music. Anagrams are also a good way to hide something. In history, people often hid their important studies in anagrams. Can you think of any other way to use them?【111教育會考】（ ）1. (A) in fact (B) at first (C) of course (D) for example（ ）2. (A) take sit (B) Ms Easy (C) it makes (D) me steak（ ）3. (A) strange (B) difficult (C) delicious (D) important（ ）4. (A) more than just games (B) often played in public (C) not so popular as before (D) not first used to learn words
choices: not first used to learn words
items.explanation: 1. 由後方的 eye、Bob 等可看出是「由左至右、由右至左讀起來相同」的「例子」，應用「舉例來說」引導，故選 (D)。2. 由異位構詞的說明可知，必須用跟 m、i、s、t、a、k、e 完全相同的字母去重新排列，故選 (C)。3. 從「餐廳」變成「吃老鼠，跑！」，可推知是很「奇怪的」，故選 (A)。4. 由本段的說明可知迴文跟異位構詞有很多實際的用途，例如學數學、創作音樂、隱藏研究，可推知它們「不只是遊戲」，故選 (A)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 111年會考(補考)
items.prompt: Welcome to Thompson’s Story Corner. Today, our story is about a magic hat.A long time ago, the world was all dark except for one piece of land. This land was ruled by a queen who always wore a hat. The hat gave her the magic power to keep the land warm, bright, and beautiful. Everyone was happy about their lives there.But Henry, the queen’s cousin, wasn’t happy. He wanted to have the hat and become the king. One day, ＿1.＿ . The queen became very sick, and Henry went to the castle to visit her. The next day, news came from the castle: The queen was dead and Henry would become king.The new king put on the hat and tried to use its magic power. “Money!” he said to the hat, but nothing happened. “A beautiful wife,” he said, but nothing appeared. “Make me young!” he shouted, but nothing changed. He became angrier and angrier. ＿2.＿. Without the power of the hat, the land got darker and colder day by day. Plants didn’t grow, food wasn’t enough, and people weren’t happy. They kept asking the king to do something to save the land, but Henry was too afraid to even appear before them. They became so mad that ＿3.＿. Inside the castle, they were surprised to find the queen in a small room. She told them that, when she was sick, Henry took her hat and hid her in the room.In the end, the queen got the hat back, and everything was as wonderful as before. But what about Henry? Well, the queen used the magic power of the hat to change him into a rat and then kicked him out of the land. From then on, he could only live in the dark.【111教育補考】 rule 統治（ ）1. (A) his plan failed (B) his chance came (C) he made a mistake (D) he changed his mind（ ）2. (A) He didn’t look good in the hat (B) The magic only made things worse (C) The hat he took away wasn’t the real one (D) He just wasn’t able to use the power of the hat（ ）3. (A) they planned to build their own castle (B) they decided to move out of the castle (C) they burned the castle and killed Henry (D) they attacked the castle and caught Henry
choices: He didn’t look good in the hat
The magic only made things worse
The hat he took away wasn’t the real one
He just wasn’t able to use the power of the hat（ ）3.
they planned to build their own castle
they decided to move out of the castle
they burned the castle and killed Henry
they attacked the castle and caught Henry
items.explanation: 1. 由前句說 Henry 想要得到魔法帽並成為國王，與本段最後一句提到在他探訪皇后的隔天便有消息傳出皇后死了，而他將成為新王，可知皇后生重病一事讓「Henry（成為國王）的機會到來了」。2. 由 Henry 不管是想要金錢、美麗的妻子或是讓自己變年輕，全部都沒有發生，可知「他就是無法使用這頂帽子的力量」，也因為失去了帽子的力量，大陸日漸變得更加黑暗與冰冷。3. 由人們在城堡內找到了皇后，後續 Henry 被施法變成老鼠並逐出大陸，可知「人們攻擊城堡並抓住了 Henry」最符合上下文語意。

items.prompt: Christmas ＿＿＿ and I want to visit my aunt abroad. Do you have any plans yet?【114教育會考】(A) came(B) comes(C) is coming(D) was coming
items.explanation: 由「我想拜訪在國外的姑姑」及現在式的問句，可知是說「聖誕節快到了」，來去動詞可用現在進行式表未來，故選 (C)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 114年會考
items.prompt: Rex is a dog that lives at the bakery next to our school. He is cute and friendly. Every morning, he stands in front of the school to welcome everybody. We all see Rex as one of us. But one Monday morning, I was surprised that Rex was not there to say hello to us. “Rex is in the hospital. He was hit by a car last night,” my classmate told me. We went to see Rex in the hospital that day after school. Two weeks later, Rex was much better, and we decided to take him for a walk every evening. Because of the exercise, Rex became healthier and stronger. Soon he could happily run and jump again. He is now as handsome and strong as before!【114教育會考】（ ）1. What happened to Rex? (A) He got lost. (B) He got hurt. (C) He bit people. (D) He ate too much.（ ）2. How did the writer help Rex? (A) By calling the police. (B) By making him exercise. (C) By taking him to see a doctor. (D) By looking for a new home for him.
choices: He ate too much.（ ）2. How did the writer help Rex?
By taking him to see a doctor.
By looking for a new home for him.
items.explanation: 1. 由同學說「Rex住院了。他昨晚被車撞到。」，可知 Rex「受傷了」，故選 (B)。2. 文章倒數第三、四句提到「兩個星期後，Rex 好多了，我們決定每天傍晚帶他去散步。因為有運動，Rex變得更健康強壯。」，可知作者是透過帶 Rex「運動」來幫助他恢復健康，故選 (B)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 104年會考
items.prompt: No one thought James would appear at Katie’s party. So when he ＿＿＿, everyone was surprised and could not believe their eyes.【104教育會考】(A) would (B) was (C) had (D) did
items.explanation: when 用來引導兩件同時發生的事情。由上下文可知，when 引導的附屬子句缺過去簡單式動詞 appeared (at Katie’s party)，寫作時為避免重複，可以過去簡單式助動詞 did 代替，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 110年會考
items.prompt: Nora：Can I check your drawer for some tools we can use?Matt：Sure. Take a look. See if you can find in there.【110教育會考】(A) any (B) it (C) others (D) those
items.explanation: 要找 some tools，即「未指定」工具，因此不會選有指定意思的 (B)、(C)、(D)。而 any 可做代名詞，故選 (A)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 106年會考
items.prompt: Excuse me. I really need to go now. My kids for me at school.【106教育會考】(A) are waiting (B) were waiting (C) wait (D) waited
items.explanation: 關鍵字為 now，表達「現在」必須走，表示孩子們目前「正等著（are waiting）」他 / 她，故須選「現在進行式」。

items.unit: 109年會考
items.prompt: Alison doesn’t like what to do. She only does things she wants to do. 【109教育會考】(A) told (B) to tell(C) be told (D) to be told
items.explanation: 由後句可知，Alison 只做自己想做的事，可知她不喜歡「被告知」該做什麼，故用被動式 be told，而 like 後可接 to V，故選 (D)。

items.unit: 103年會考
items.prompt: Oliver with joy when he saw his favorite band. He kept saying loudly, “I love you guys!”【103教育會考】(A) waited (B) shouted (C) listened (D) agreed
items.explanation: 第二句用來補充說明第一句內容，而與第二句 saying loudly（大聲說）相關的動詞為只有選項 (B)「大聲喊叫」。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 103年會考
items.prompt: I’m not sure if Kevin this morning, but if he does, I’ll tell him that you called.【103教育會考】(A) will come in (B) comes in (C) has come in (D) came in
items.explanation: 第一個 if 為 whether / if 引導名詞子句的用法，子句中的時態依事實表示；第二個 if 為條件句，子句中的時態以現在式表示未來；再由上下文判斷，說話者並不知道 Kevin 是否會來，表示 Kevin 尚未出現，故選表示未來時態的 (A)。

items.prompt: Business at Jane’s shop has not been good these days. And the new supermarket across the street only makes things .【112教育會考】(A) easier(B) worse(C) more boring(D) more convenient
items.explanation: 由前句「這些日子生意本來就不好了」，可推知對面新開的超級市場只會讓事情變得「更糟」；worse 為 bad 的比較級，故選 (B)。

items.prompt: I’m glad that my school has students wear . I don’t have to worry about what clothes to wear to school.【106教育會考】(A) belts (B) caps (C) gloves (D) uniforms
items.explanation: 關鍵詞為 what clothes to wear，不用擔心「穿什麼衣服」去學校，是因為學校規定學生要穿「制服（uniforms）」，故選 (D)。

items.prompt: We are surprised that Sally and Ray decided to get married. No one knows . They often fight with each other and are unhappy together.【106教育會考】(A) why (B) where (C) when (D) how
items.explanation: 關鍵字為 surprised，會「驚訝」表示對 Sally 與 Ray 兩人決定結婚的「原因」不明，與「原因、理由」相關的疑問詞為 why，故選 (A)。

items.prompt: oven 烤爐【113教育會考】（ ）1. Kevin is going to buy some fresh bread at Baker’s Kitchen. He loves white bread, his mom likes farm bread, his father enjoys bagels, and his sister eats only challah. Which is the earliest possible time for him to get all these breads for his family? (A) 11:00 a.m. (B) 4:00 p.m. (C) 5:00 p.m. (D) 7:00 p.m.（ ）2. What do we know about Baker’s Kitchen? (A) It is open five days a week. (B) Its breads are half price one hour before closing. (C) Its croissants and pretzels are sold on weekends. (D) Its members can save $100 when they shop on Fridays.
choices: 7:00 p.m.（ ）2. What do we know about Baker’s Kitchen?
It is open five days a week.
Its breads are half price one hour before closing.
Its croissants and pretzels are sold on weekends.
Its members can save $100 when they shop on Fridays.
items.explanation: 1. 要同時買到 white bread、farm bread、bagels 和 challah，最早的時間是等所有麵包都出爐後。white bread 在早上 10:30 出爐，bagels 在早上11:30 出爐，challah 在下午 3:30 出爐，而 farm bread 在下午 4:30 出爐。因此最早可以在下午 4:30 之後買到所有麵包，故選 (C)。2. (A) 選項錯誤，每日皆有營業；(C) 選項錯誤，可頌麵包和椒鹽脆餅只有在週五才有販售；(D) 選項錯誤，成為會員需要支付 100 元，但每次購物可以節省 10%，而不是每週五節省 100 元。故選 (B)。

items.prompt: When we get wet, we need a towel to get ourselves dry. When a dog gets wet, all it needs is to shake its body. A study in 2010 showed that a wet dog can throw off half the water on its body by shaking for less than a second. In fact, this common act of dogs works better than a washing machine. The study found that animal shaking begins with the head and ends with the tail. During a shake, the animal’s head, body and skin all move. Smaller animals must shake faster than bigger animals to get water off. For example, in one second, a rat can shake 18 times, a dog 6 times, and a bear 4 times. Bigger animals can get their bodies dry with fewer shakes. For animals, shaking is not just about getting themselves dry. It is also about saving their lives. Being wet makes animals heavier, and that makes it harder to run. In the animal world, how fast an animal can run often decides whether it will live or not. Maybe that’s why the “wet-dog shake” has become a common habit of many animals. skin 皮膚【107教育會考】（ ）1. What does the reading say about shaking? (A) Different animals’ shaking begins with different body parts. (B) Shaking is a way that animals use to make other animals scared. (C) Animals that are not kept as pets do the shaking better than those that are. (D) Shaking themselves dry may help animals run faster in dangerous moments.（ ）2. What can we learn from the reading? (A) The animal’s tail can help it run more quickly and easily. (B) Some animals shake more than they need to get water off. (C) The idea of washing machines came from the shaking of dogs. (D) Larger animals get themselves drier at each shake than smaller animals.（ ）3. The four pictures below show how fast tigers, cats and mice can shake. From the reading, which picture is most likely correct? likely 可能 (A) (B) (C) (D)
choices: Different animals’ shaking begins with different body parts.
Shaking is a way that animals use to make other animals scared.
Animals that are not kept as pets do the shaking better than those that are.
Shaking themselves dry may help animals run faster in dangerous moments.（ ）2. What can we learn from the reading?
The animal’s tail can help it run more quickly and easily.
Some animals shake more than they need to get water off.
The idea of washing machines came from the shaking of dogs.

Larger animals get themselves drier at each shake than smaller animals.（ ）3. The four pictures below show how fast tigers, cats and mice can shake. From the reading, which picture is most likely correct? likely 可能
items.explanation: 1. 第三段第二句指出抖水這個動作除了可讓身體乾燥，也「攸關著拯救牠們的生命」，因為濕漉漉的會變笨重而跑得慢，故選 (D)。2. 第二段最後一句指出動物體型越大，抖動次數不用太多便可使身體乾燥，可推斷大型動物比小型動物抖動一次甩掉的水分多，「身體也變得較乾」，故選 (D)。3. 第二段第三行指出動物體型越小甩動速度越快，也就是一秒內甩動次數越多。三隻動物中，老鼠最小、老虎最大，所以老鼠甩動次數最多，老虎最少，故選 (B)。

items.prompt: Patty spent several days planning to invite Charlie to dinner, ＿＿＿ she couldn’t say a word when they met.【113教育會考】(A) but(B) if (C) or(D) so
items.explanation: 由前後句的對比關係可知，雖然計畫了好幾天，但見面時卻說不出話來，用 but 連接表示轉折，故選 (A)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb

items.unit: 114年會考
items.prompt: Most kids want gifts from their parents on their birthdays, but Cameron doesn’t. On his birthday, he gives his mom a gift. He ＿1.＿ doing this in his first year of junior high school. That year, during one class, he watched a video about how a baby is pushed from its mother’s body. After class, ＿2.＿. How brave a woman is to have a baby! Thank God I’ll never have to do that!When Cameron came home that day, he held his mom in his arms for a long time. He decided that his birthday ＿3.＿. During those nine months inside his mom, he just ate and slept while his mom was doing all the hard work. So why should he get a birthday gift for doing nothing? If anyone should get a gift on his birthday, it should be his mom.The ＿4.＿ “birthday gift” Cameron prepared was a bag of cookies he baked. The cookies tasted so bad, but his mom said they were the best thing she ever got. Hearing that ＿5.＿. It was so much better than getting a gift. Now, on his birthday every year, Cameron makes a gift for his mother to thank her for giving him life.This year, Cameron ＿6.＿ his mom a nice dress. A few months ago, he learned to make dresses at school and decided to make one for his mom. Now the dress is finished and hanging behind Cameron’s bedroom door. He believes the gift will tell his mother how much he loves her.【114教育會考】（ ）1. (A) starts (B) started (C) has started (D) will start（ ）2. (A) he got quite scared of two things (B) he still couldn’t understand two things (C) he couldn’t stop thinking about two things (D) he did two things that would change his life（ ）3. (A) should be spent helping his mom (B) should be a time of welcoming a new start (C) should not be about him, but about his mom (D) should not be celebrated for just one day, but for nine months（ ）4. (A) first (B) last (C) only (D) other（ ）5. (A) made his head hurt (B) made his heart sing (C) made him change his mind (D) made him give up baking（ ）6. (A) is going to give (B) gives (C) has given (D) gave
choices: he got quite scared of two things
he still couldn’t understand two things
he couldn’t stop thinking about two things
he did two things that would change his life（ ）3.
should be spent helping his mom
should be a time of welcoming a new start
should not be about him, but about his mom
should not be celebrated for just one day, but for nine months（ ）4.
items.explanation: 1. 由「國中一年級」可知描述的是過去發生的事，應用過去簡單式，故選 (B)。2. 由後文說「女人生孩子有多勇敢啊！」、「謝天謝地，我永遠都不需要經歷那種事！」，可知「他忍不住一直想著兩件事」，故選 (C)。3. 由後文描述，可知 Cameron 認為媽媽才值得得到禮物，因此他決定他的生日「不應該是關於他自己的，而應該是關於他媽媽的」，故選 (C)。4. 這是他開始每年做禮物給媽媽的第一年，故用 first（第一的）；(B) last 表「最後一個」，不合邏輯；(C) only 表「唯一」，但後面說明他每年都做；(D) other 表「另一個」，不符合文意，故選 (A)。5. 由「媽媽說那是她收過最棒的東西」，可知讓 Cameron 很開心，make one’s heart sing 表示「讓人內心感到欣喜、快樂」，就像心裡在唱歌一樣，故選 (B)。6. 由後文描述可知今年要送媽媽洋裝但還沒送，應用未來式 be going to，故選 (A)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 110年會考(補考)
items.prompt: In 1971, Sophia found a bottle on the beach. There was a letter in the bottle.-------------------------------------------------------------- June 6, 1970Dear Mason, You didn’t show up that Friday when I waited at your school gate as usual. You’ve been lost to me since. Everyone’s been telling me fifteen years is enough and that it’s time to let you go. But I know you are somewhere in this world. I just haven’t found out where you are. I’ll keep looking for you, even though it may take another 15years. I will never give up. I believe we’ll see each other again someday. Love, Dad--------------------------------------------------------------- After reading the letter, Sophia felt sad for the father and wanted to find him. With very few clues to start with, Sophia worked hard for years to learn what had happened. However, she could not put the broken pieces together to get a clear picture. Six years later, Sophia decided to write about the whole story of looking for the father. Her book came out in 1977, and, to her surprise, it sold thousands of copies.【110教育補考】 gate 大門 clue 線索（ ）1. What do Sophia’s book and the letter she found have in common? have... in common 有……共同點 (A) Both tell the sad stories of the writers’ families. (B) Both tell people to forget about the past and move on. (C) Both show how much the writers want to find somebody. (D) Both show why the writers care about a stranger they once met.（ ）2. Many people called soon after Sophia’s book came out. Which call is most likely true? likely 可能 (A) “I’m Judy, Mason’s aunt. Sorry to tell you that Noah, Mason’s father, died yesterday. As a father who had lost his son for over twenty years, Noah wanted to thank you for making sure that Mason was not forgotten....” (B) “I’m Mason’s father. Thanks to your book, Mason finally came home. He has grown into a teenager. I can’t believe I can have Mason back after years of....” (C) “This is Mason calling. Thanks for everything. A bad guy took me away from our house fifteen years ago. A nice woman saved me, but I was too little to tell her where my home was....” (D) “I’m Adam, Mason’s best friend. We both celebrated our fiftieth birthday this week. I wanted to tell you that in fact, we ran away together at the age of fifteen to see the big world. Now we own a factory....”
choices: Both tell the sad stories of the writers’ families.
Both tell people to forget about the past and move on.
Both show how much the writers want to find somebody.
Both show why the writers care about a stranger they once met.（ ）2. Many people called soon after Sophia’s book came out. Which call is most likely true? likely 可能

“I’m Judy, Mason’s aunt. Sorry to tell you that Noah, Mason’s father, died yesterday. As a father who had lost his son for over twenty years, Noah wanted to thank you for making sure that Mason was not forgotten....”
“I’m Mason’s father. Thanks to your book, Mason finally came home. He has grown into a teenager. I can’t believe I can have Mason back after years of....”
“This is Mason calling. Thanks for everything. A bad guy took me away from our house fifteen years ago. A nice woman saved me, but I was too little to tell her where my home was....”

“I’m Adam, Mason’s best friend. We both celebrated our fiftieth birthday this week. I wanted to tell you that in fact, we ran away together at the age of fifteen to see the big world. Now we own a factory....”
items.explanation: 1. 信中所述是父親尋找兒子 Mason 的事，而 Sophia 的書說的是她尋找這個悲傷的父親的故事，故兩者的共同點為 (C)。2. 由 1970 年父親寫的信可知 Mason 已失蹤 15 年，Sophia 出書時則是 1977 年，表示 Mason 至該時已失蹤了 20 多年，故 (A) 很有可能為真。(B) 有誤，經過了 20 多年，Mason 不可能才剛只是青少年；(C) Mason 已失蹤超過 20 年，敘述說 15 年前被抓走，不可能為真；(D) 父親去學校接 Mason 卻沒接到，可知 Mason 失蹤時還是學生，而失蹤了 20 多年，現在不可能已經 50 歲，(D) 也不可能為真。

One can never get to Light Church at the first turn.
The cards can be used to decide where to start the game.
items.explanation: 1. 走一步，走二步，走三步，走四步。Anna 取完三張卡後的位置在 Gate Watchdog；Kate 取完三張卡後的位置也在 Gate Watchdog；Billy 取完三張卡後成功抵達 Dreamland；Ivan 取完三張卡後的位置在 Candy House。故選 (C)。2. 選項 (A)「沒有人能從 Lion King 開始」，因為每抵達 Lion King 時就必須倒退三步，故相符；選項 (B)「卡片可以用來決定誰先開始」、選項 (D)「卡片可以用來決定從哪裡開始遊戲」，由上方敘述可知，卡片只能決定走幾步，故不符；選項 (C)「沒有人能在第一輪走到 Light Church」，因為抽到可以走四步抵達 Golden Bear ，到那裏就可以直接走到 Light Church，故不符。故本題選 (A)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 113年會考
items.prompt: A HISTORY LESSON ON THE PANDEMIC2020.10.29 Since the Covid-19 pandemic started, people have begun “social distancing” — keeping a safe space between you and anyone you don’t live with. Though it has been a very popular topic this year, social distancing ＿1.＿. In fact, it was widely used in the U.S. in the flu pandemic in 1918. But how well did it work? The Americans’ experience can tell us whether it really saved lives.----------------------------------------------------- From the picture, we can see that ＿2.＿ started social distancing earlier than the other three cities. This helped the city keep the number of deaths down. Besides taking early action, keeping the action long enough was also important in fighting the pandemic. The picture shows that Portland and Denver did well in the first few weeks. However, both cities ＿3.＿, and the numbers of deaths climbed again. But there was one thing Portland did right. The city used several ways of social distancing at the same time to deal with the pandemic. ＿4.＿, sick people were kept away from healthy ones; schools were closed; public activities were not allowed. All these were useful in keeping people safe. The lessons of the 1918 pandemic bring us hope. While we are still learning to fight Covid-19, social distancing may be the best way to get us through the dark days, at least for now. pandemic（疾病的）大流行 per 每(一)【113教育會考】（ ）1. (A) is not a new idea (B) has not been very useful (C) may bring some problems (D) is not welcomed by everyone（ ）2. (A) Portland (B) New York (C) Denver (D) Pittsburgh（ ）3. (A) had higher numbers of deaths (B) stopped social distancing too soon (C) began social distancing a second time (D) had the most days of social distancing（ ）4. (A) Also (B) At first (C) However (D) For example
choices: began social distancing a second time
had the most days of social distancing（ ）4.
items.explanation: 1. 後句提到「在 1918 年的流感大流行中，美國就廣泛使用了社交距離」，推知「社交距離並不是一個新的概念」，故選 (A)。2. 由圖表鋪灰底部分，可知四個城市中最早實施社交距離的城市是 New York，故選 (B)。3. 圖表顯示實施社交距離和死亡人數的關係，空格後提到死亡人數再次攀升，推知應是「太快停止了社交距離」，故選 (B)。4. 由後面可知都是如何採取不同的社交距離方式的例子，因此用 for example，故選 (D)。

items.prompt: ◎ OPENING HOURS High Season (April to September)： 9：00–18：00 every day Low Season (October to March)： 9：00–17：00 every day ◎ TICKET PRICES Line A（……）：$20 each person Line B（− − −）：$18 each person◎ THINGS YOU SHOULD KNOW Buses for both lines leave every hour from Central Station. Line A takes one hour; Line B takes 50 minutes. If you are taking your pet with you, please buy a seat for it at half price. Save 10% if you buy tickets on the Internet. Save 10% if you buy tickets for both lines. Go to www.citysightbus.org for more information.【108教育會考】（ ）1. Which is true about City Sight Bus tickets? (A) It costs less to buy tickets on the Internet. (B) People must pay the full ticket price for a pet. (C) Tickets are more expensive in the high season. (D) People save 10% if they buy two tickets for the same line. （ ）2. Which is true about the bus lines? (A) Line B takes more time. (B) Both lines cross Farmers’ Bridge. (C) Both lines leave from Central Station. (D) There are more gardens to see on Line A.

People must pay the full ticket price for a pet.
Tickets are more expensive in the high season.

(D) When is the best time to visit Woodshire.（ ）2. What do we know from the reading? (A) The museum gives free mask-making classes. (B) There is more than one tea house in the town. (C) The castle is a good place to look out over the whole town. (D) The ticket to the castle is cheaper if one does not visit the castle garden.（ ）3. Which picture best shows Woodshire?(A) (B) (C) (D)

(A) 文中未提及；(B) 由第三段第二句可知，Woodshire Church Square 附近有一條茶街；(C) 由第三段第四、五句可知，可以俯瞰全鎮的地點在 White Gate；(D) 由第一段最後一句可知，城堡花園可免費參觀。3. 由第一段第三句可知 Woodshire Castle 在火車站對面，由第二段前兩句可知 Woodshire Mask Museum 在城鎮中心，由第三段第四句可知 White Gate 在城鎮的南方。

items.prompt: Look at the street map of Rainbow City and answer the questions.【110教育補考】（ ）1. Here is the road sign Peyton saw when she was riding a bike to the train station. Where did she most likely see it? likely 可能 (A) A. (B) B. (C) C. (D) D.（ ）2. Aprille was going home after buying some bread. Out of the bakery, she turned left, went straight, and then turned right on White Street. She walked down one block and then turned left on Gray Road. At the end of Gray Road, she turned right and walked until she saw the theater. She turned at the corner across from the theater and got to her apartment in a few minutes. Where did Aprille NOT pass by on her way home? (A) The café. (B) The CD shop. (C) The bookstore. (D) The post office.
choices: D.（ ）2. Aprille was going home after buying some bread. Out of the bakery, she turned left, went straight, and then turned right on White Street. She walked down one block and then turned left on Gray Road. At the end of Gray Road, she turned right and walked until she saw the theater. She turned at the corner across from the theater and got to her apartment in a few minutes. Where did Aprille NOT pass by on her way home?
items.explanation: 1. 由 Peyton 看到的路標可知，Yellow Road、Orange Road、Gray Road 都在她前方，圖中符合條件的只有 (C)。2. 由敘述可知，Aprille 走出烘焙坊左轉之後，右轉 White Road，會經過 Café，再左轉 Gray Road 會經過 bookstore，走到底之後右轉繼續走到電影院，會經過 CD shop，其中唯一不會經過的是 Post Office，故選 (D)。

items.prompt: Mona：Honey, can you go to the photo shop and print out two more sets of these photos for my parents?Chad：But it looks like rain now! Why don’t you just call Easy-Snap? It takes them only five minutes to get here from Gemmy Road.Mona：But that’ll be very expensive!! Chad：OK, OK. Then I’ll go to the photo shop next to the café. I heard it’s having a sale.Mona：You mean Nice-Shoot? Too late. Yesterday was the last day. There’s a new shop called Plus-Pic across from the station. I’ve checked the photo shops in town. It costs the least to print out two sets of photos at Plus-Pic.Chad：But it’s the farthest from us! How about Quick-Foto? It’s a lot nearer, and not that expensive!Mona：It’s closed today. Come on! You don’t have anything important to do this afternoon, do you?Chad：I... all right. You win.【111教育補考】 print 沖印 set 組（ ）1. What can we learn from the reading? (A) Mona did not call Easy-Snap. (B) Mona did not know where Nice-Shoot was. (C) Chad decided to go to Quick-Foto. (D) Chad would drive Mona to a photo shop. （ ）2. Here are the ads of the photo shops Mona and Chad talked about. Which is the ad of Plus-Pic? ad 廣告 (A) (B) (C) (D) （ ）3. Here is the map that shows the photo shops Mona and Chad talked about. Where is Mona and Chad’s house? (A) A. (B) B. (C) C. (D) D.
choices: Mona did not know where Nice-Shoot was.
Chad decided to go to Quick-Foto.
Chad would drive Mona to a photo shop. （ ）2. Here are the ads of the photo shops Mona and Chad talked about. Which is the ad of Plus-Pic? ad 廣告
（ ）3. Here is the map that shows the photo shops Mona and Chad talked about. Where is Mona and Chad’s house?
items.explanation: 1. 由第二個 Mona 的對話「但是會很貴！！」，可知她沒有打電話給 Easy-Snap，故選 (A)。2. 對話中 Mona 提到「在 Plus-Pic 沖印兩組照片最便宜。」，而選項中沖印兩組照片最便宜的為 (B)。3. 由對話中提到「Easy-Snap 從 Gemmy Road 到 Mona 和 Chad 家只要花五分鐘。」、「車站對面的 Plus-Pic 照相館離他們最遠」等資訊，推知 Mona 和 Chad 的家最有可能位置是在 A，故選 (A)。

items.prompt: Do you eat meat? Well, if you do, then you might find our next news interesting. A study says that the world has a 1. need for meat. In 1960, the world ate 64 million tonnes of meat, about 21 kg for each person. In 2007, the number rose to 268 million tonnes, about 40 kg for each person. At the same time, 2. . In the 1960s, beef was high on the menu. Of the meat that was eaten, 40% was beef. In 2007, pork became the star. Poultry also became popular, going up from 12% to 32%, thanks to people’s worries about their health these years. And 3. ? You’re guessing the U.S.A., right? The answer is Luxembourg! In 2007, each Luxembourger ate about 137 kg of meat! Second to Luxembourgers are Americans. In 2007, each American ate about 126 kg! Now, enough with the numbers. I’m playing you a song called Currywurst. The singer sings about his love for the meat dish of the same name. Enjoy! tonne 公噸 poultry 家禽（肉）【103教育會考】（ ）1. (A) falling (B) special (C) growing (D) common（ ）2. (A) we have changed our way of cooking meat (B) new kinds of meat have come on the market (C) there have been changes in the list of favorite meats (D) doctors have been worried that we eat too much meat（ ）3. (A) where does the world’s best meat come from (B) which country is the world’s biggest meat maker (C) where can you eat the world’s most delicious meat (D) which country uses up the most meat for each person
choices: we have changed our way of cooking meat
new kinds of meat have come on the market
there have been changes in the list of favorite meats
doctors have been worried that we eat too much meat（ ）3.
where does the world’s best meat come from
which country is the world’s biggest meat maker
where can you eat the world’s most delicious meat
which country uses up the most meat for each person
items.explanation: 1. 後面兩句指出兩個年份肉類消耗量變多，因此本句應表示對肉的需求是成長的（growing），故選 (C)。 2. 後面幾句，說明了肉類喜好由牛肉變成豬肉，家禽類也跟著成長，故選 (C)「最受喜愛的肉的名單也有所改變」。 3. 後面句子給了兩個國名—美國與盧森堡，同時指出這兩國人民單人單年消耗肉類的量，故可判斷是詢問選項 (D)「哪一個國家單人消耗掉最多的肉」。
