items.prompt: THE SOUTHEND TRAIL has been popular with nature lovers for years. The 120-km trail passes beautiful lakes, crosses rivers, and goes through mountains and hills. This gives bird lovers some of the best places for birdwatching. The trail also takes you to the Southend Museum and to two famous castles, Edward Castle and Sloan Castle.It’s best to plan one day for one part of the trail and start your hike early in the morning, because each part takes at least seven hours. If you don’t want to walk, you can bike, but make sure you stay on the main trail, because the side trails are not wide enough for biking. There are two types of lodging for visitors. Camping is popular in summer, but it is only allowed on a few campgrounds (see the map). A more comfortable one is to stay at a hotel in one of the towns. You can find some very nice ones that also have breakfast.【111教育會考】 trail 步道（ ）1. What is recommended to people who are visiting the Southend Trail? (A) Camping on the side trails. (B) Biking along the side trails. (C) Hiking one part of the trail a day. (D) Visiting the museum in the morning（ ）2. What does lodging mean in the reading? (A) A meal to have. (B) A place to stay in. (C) A time for visiting. (D) A way of moving around.（ ）3. Kaylen will start his trip from Cove. He plans to visit one of the old castles. He also wants to go birdwatching near the river. Which parts of the trail should Kaylen go on? (A) Parts 1 and 2. (B) Parts 1 and 2a. (C) Parts 2 and 3. (D) Parts 4 and 4a.
choices: Hiking one part of the trail a day.
Visiting the museum in the morning（ ）2. What does lodging mean in the reading?

A way of moving around.（ ）3. Kaylen will start his trip from Cove. He plans to visit one of the old castles. He also wants to go birdwatching near the river. Which parts of the trail should Kaylen go on?
items.explanation: 1. 第二段提到每段步道都會花費至少七個小時，因此推薦人們一天只爬一段步道，故選 (C)。2. 第三段提到「露營」和「住在城鎮的旅館」兩種寄宿地，可知 lodging 指的是「寄宿的地方」，故選 (B)。3. 步道 Part 1 會穿越河流，滿足 Kaylen 在河邊賞鳥的要求；步道 Part 2 則會經過斯隆城堡，和 Kaylen 預計造訪一座古老城堡的計畫相符，故選 (A)。

items.subject: 英文

items.prompt: Ms. Lee： did you get this beautiful card?Mr. Wang：One of my students made it for me. She sends me a card every year.【110教育補考】(A) Who (B) Where (C) When (D) What

items.prompt: Josh：Do you know about “pay it forward coffee” at Flora Café?Eric：You mean you pay for a cup of coffee for someone poor to have it later?Josh：Yeah. A cup of coffee is not much, but on cold winter days like today, it might warm them up a little. And maybe their hearts too.Eric：But will Flora Café really give this cup of coffee to someone later?Josh：Come on. I’ve known the shopkeeper well. He’s an honest man. He’s got a blackboard in the shop that says how many cups are paid for and how many have been given out.Eric：But how will they know who to give? Anyone can ask for it, even if they’re not poor.Josh：True, but then I guess they’ll just have to believe in people.Eric：Perhaps. But will poor people go and ask for a free coffee? Won’t they worry about losing face?Josh：Why do you always say things like that?Eric：Well, it may happen.Josh：Yeah, I know, but I still think it’s a good thing to do, and it gets people to care about others.【107教育會考】（ ）1. What does “things like that” mean? (A) Problems about the free coffee plan. (B) Trouble for people who go to Flora Café. (C) Ways to make the free coffee plan successful. (D) Good things free coffee will bring to Flora Café.（ ）2. What can we learn about Josh and Eric? (A) Josh was not able to change Eric’s mind about free coffee. (B) Eric has more hope for the free coffee plan than Josh does. (C) They found a way to make people feel OK to take free coffee. (D) They do not know whether Flora Café will do business honestly.（ ）3. What do we know about Flora Café from the dialogue? (A) It has a way to know who really is poor. (B) Free coffee has brought it more business. (C) People pay less for free coffee than other coffee. (D) Its blackboard shows if there are free coffees to be taken.
choices: Problems about the free coffee plan.
Trouble for people who go to Flora Café.
Ways to make the free coffee plan successful.
Good things free coffee will bring to Flora Café.（ ）2. What can we learn about Josh and Eric?
Josh was not able to change Eric’s mind about free coffee.
Eric has more hope for the free coffee plan than Josh does.
They found a way to make people feel OK to take free coffee.
They do not know whether Flora Café will do business honestly.（ ）3. What do we know about Flora Café from the dialogue?
It has a way to know who really is poor.
Free coffee has brought it more business.
People pay less for free coffee than other coffee.
Its blackboard shows if there are free coffees to be taken.
items.explanation: 1. that 用於指之前提過的事物，而本句在回應上一個 Eric 對「免費咖啡計畫所提出的疑問」，也就是質疑—貧困之人是否會願意前往領取免費咖啡，故選 (A)。2. Josh 對免費咖啡計畫一直持正面態度，Eric 則相反，由最後兩個 Eric 對話可知，他一直心存質疑，這也表示 Josh 始終不能改變 Eric 的想法，故選 (A)。3. 答案在第三個 Josh 對話的最後一句，咖啡館有個黑板公告「有多少杯咖啡已付費」、多少杯咖啡已被送出，故選 (D)。

items.prompt: My dear friends, My family and I moved into our country house one month ago. The kids are planning to give a party at our new house. I hope all of you can come. The party will begin at 11:00 a.m. on Saturday. There will be lots of food and drinks. Together with this letter is a map to our house. After you get off the train, take the road in front of the station. Follow it and you’ll see a chicken farm. Don’t make any turns. Keep going and you’ll see a bridge. Cross the bridge and there will be a big tree on you left. Walk past the tree, take the first right turn, and then walk for five more minutes. You’ll see several houses. My house is at the end of the road, next to the river.Angelica【103教育會考】（ ）1. Why did Angelica invite her friends? (A) To see her new home. (B) To visit the chicken farm. (C) To take a train trip. (D) To have a picnic.（ ）2. Look at the map. Where does Angelica live? (A) At A. (B) At B. (C) At C. (D) At D.
choices: To have a picnic.（ ）2. Look at the map. Where does Angelica live?
items.explanation: 1. 由信件第二句 give a party at our new house（在新家辦個派對）可判斷 Angelica 邀請朋友的目的是參觀她的新家。 2. B、C、D 的房子都在路的盡頭的河邊，關鍵句為 Walk past the tree, take the first right turn.（過了樹第一條路右轉），故選 (D)。

items.prompt: The sky is turning bright and clear.The earth is wearing red and green.Winter is gone; spring has come.The air smells fresh and sweet.The summer heat is not yet here;A little fox comes out to play.A bird is busy in a tree Waking a daisy from her sleep. Little daisy, little daisy, People call the flower the “day’s eye.” When she opens her eye, The springtime brings us cheer.【107教育會考】（ ）1. Which season is this poem about? poem 詩 (A) Spring. (B) Summer. (C) Autumn. (D) Winter.（ ）2. What is a “daisy”? (A) A body part. (B) A kind of bird. (C) A kind of flower. (D) A kind of smell.
items.explanation: 1. 第一段第三行指出「冬天遠去；春天已到來」，第二段第一行亦指出「夏季暑氣尚未來臨」可推知，此詩在講「春天」，故選 (A)。2. 由第三段第二句「此花」可知，daisy 為「一種花」，故選 (C)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 105年會考
items.prompt: Alec：So, what do you think about it?Ellie：It’s…interesting.Alec：Oh, no, don’t say that.Ellie：The first thing you should know about Olivia is that she’s scared of anything with six legs. I don’t think she’ll be able to walk past the gate of Buzzing World.Alec：But she loves butterflies! Well, she loved the photos of butterflies I took last time I was there.Ellie：Only when they’re not moving.Alec：Fine. I’ll just take her somewhere else, and that’d be OK. Right?Ellie：Umm, you’re taking her to Wavelength for dinner?Alec：What’s wrong with that?!Ellie：I wouldn’t say a dead fish is really her idea of a nice dinner, and this restaurant sells seafood…Alec：Now you’re wrong about this one. She loved my mom’s fish balls. She had several last time!Ellie：OK, let’s ask someone else. Oh, there’s Lori. Hey, Lori, could you look at Alec’s plan? He’s taking Olivia out.Lori：Wow! Everything’s written down on paper! Hmmm… I thought you wanted her to be your girlfriend.Alec：I do!Lori：If you follow this plan, I’m sure it’ll be your only date with her. seafood 海鮮【105教育會考】（ ）1. What does it in the first line mean? (A) The gate of Buzzing World. (B) Alec’s butterfly photo. (C) Alec’s plan for his date. (D) Anything with six legs.（ ）2. What does this one mean in the dialogue? (A) What food Wavelength sells. (B) Why Olivia does not like seafood. (C) What Alec thinks about Wavelength. (D) What food Olivia does not like to eat.（ ）3. What can we learn about Alec? (A) He was told that Olivia likes nice surprises. (B) He decided to cook Olivia a nice seafood dinner. (C) He was happy that Olivia was finally his girlfriend. (D) He gave up the idea of taking Olivia to Buzzing World.（ ）4. Emily is a friend of Olivia’s. If she agrees with Lori, what would she most likely say to Alec? likely 可能 (A) “This is just what Olivia would want!” (B) “You never know what a girl like Olivia would want.” (C) “Make a different plan or have a date with a different girl!” (D) “She never cares what she does on a date; she cares who she has a date with.”
choices: Anything with six legs.（ ）2. What does this one mean in the dialogue?
Why Olivia does not like seafood.
What food Olivia does not like to eat.（ ）3. What can we learn about Alec?
He was told that Olivia likes nice surprises.
He decided to cook Olivia a nice seafood dinner.
He was happy that Olivia was finally his girlfriend.
He gave up the idea of taking Olivia to Buzzing World.（ ）4. Emily is a friend of Olivia’s. If she agrees with Lori, what would she most likely say to Alec? likely 可能
“This is just what Olivia would want!”
“You never know what a girl like Olivia would want.”
“Make a different plan or have a date with a different girl!”
“She never cares what she does on a date; she cares who she has a date with.”
items.explanation: 1. 代名詞 it 通常指提過，或對話者相互已知的事、物。而由整個對話可推知，Alec 與 Ellie 兩人是在討論 Alec 的約會計畫，故選 (C)。2. this one 是指上一句 Ellie 認為 Olivia 不會喜歡吃海鮮這件事，故選 (D)。3. 選項 (A)「他被告知 Olivia 喜歡不錯的驚喜」、選項 (B)「他決定為 Olivia 煮一頓豐盛的海鮮晚餐」文中未提；選項 (C)「他很高興 Olivia 終於成為他的女朋友」由 Lori 所說 I thought you wanted her to be your girlfriend. 可推知 Olivia 尚未成為 Alec 的女朋友，故不符；選項 (D)「他放棄帶 Olivia 去Buzzing World」與第四個 Alec 所說相符。因此本題選 (D)。4. 由 Lori 最後一句可知，Alec 的計畫很爛，可推知 Alec 應該要換計畫；而整個對話都顯示出 Alec 似乎完全不了解 Olivia，可推斷 Olivia 與 Alec 可能不適合，故選 (C)「要不換個不同的計畫，要不換個約會對象吧！」。

items.unit: 109年會考
items.prompt: This is a letter by Selena Bieber to the students in her school. Later Is Better! Selena Bieber Northville High SchoolDo you feel it’s hard to get up early for school and even harder to listen well in the first class at 8 a.m.? Well, this happens to most of us and is not helpful for our learning!Some studies show that teenagers’ brains make melatonin, the hormone that helps sleep, between 11 p.m. and 8 a.m. So it’s better for us to sleep during these nine hours. But here comes the problem. We’re asked to get to school by 7:30 a.m. That means we have to get up before 7, when our brains should still be sleeping. That’s why we’re always so tired and can’t think clearly in early morning classes. No clear head, no good learning, right?If we can’t change how our body works, why can’t school start later? In this way, we can not only sleep more but also learn better!Want to help us make it happen?Visit www.nvhsstudsup.org/later-better to learn more. brain 大腦 hormone 荷爾蒙【109教育會考】（ ）1. What problem is Selena Bieber trying to fix? (A) High school lessons are too difficult. (B) Classes start too early in the morning. (C) Too many students are late for school. (D) Lunch break is too short for taking a rest.（ ）2. What can we learn from the letter? (A) Too much melatonin can hurt teenagers’ brain. (B) The brain stops making melatonin after 11 p.m. (C) Sleeping longer helps the body make more melatonin. (D) It is easier to fall asleep when the brain is making melatonin.（ ）3. Below is some information from another study.We studied 48 high school students and found that the students who went to bed earlier did better on their school tests. This is not only true for those who slept nine hours, but also true for those who slept less. And some of them agreed that they learned better in early morning classes.Do the ideas in Selena Bieber’s letter agree with the information? (A) Yes, because her letter says it is better to sleep from 11 p.m. to 8 a.m. (B) Yes, because her letter says getting up early is not helpful for learning. (C) No, because her letter says students are asked to get to school by 7:30 a.m. (D) No, because her letter says teenagers’ brains do not work well in early morning classes.
choices: High school lessons are too difficult.
Classes start too early in the morning.
Too many students are late for school.
Lunch break is too short for taking a rest.（ ）2. What can we learn from the letter?
Too much melatonin can hurt teenagers’ brain.
The brain stops making melatonin after 11 p.m.
Sleeping longer helps the body make more melatonin.

It is easier to fall asleep when the brain is making melatonin.（ ）3. Below is some information from another study.We studied 48 high school students and found that the students who went to bed earlier did better on their school tests. This is not only true for those who slept nine hours, but also true for those who slept less. And some of them agreed that they learned better in early morning classes.Do the ideas in Selena Bieber’s letter agree with the information?
Yes, because her letter says it is better to sleep from 11 p.m. to 8 a.m.
Yes, because her letter says getting up early is not helpful for learning.
No, because her letter says students are asked to get to school by 7:30 a.m.
No, because her letter says teenagers’ brains do not work well in early morning classes.
items.explanation: 1. 文章提到學校要求學生早上七點半前到學校，但那個時間大腦應該還在睡覺，所以學習效果不好。可知想解決的問題應該是「早上的課太早開始」，故選 (B)。2. 第二段提到褪黑激素是一種能幫助睡眠的賀爾蒙，故選 (D)。3. 題目的資訊提到不一定要睡滿九個小時，只要早一點睡，學生就能有較佳的課業表現，甚至有些人認為他們在早上的課堂有較好的學習效果。但 Selena Bieber 信中的觀點認為在晚上十一點到早上八點間因為大腦會分泌褪黑激素，所以應該要睡覺，且不認同學生早起去上課會有好的成效，故選 (D)。

items.prompt: From：Mia Loren <mloren@qmail.com>To：Dave Doddo <dd1225@qmail.com>Date：Tue, Oct 24, 2017 at 10：01 AMSubject：Daniel’s 5th Birthday Party – This Saturday!-------------------------------------------------------Hello Dave,We’re happy to invite you and your family to Daniel’s fifth birthday party this Saturday.We know we told you that the party would be in 1. . However, we just moved to Carlton City last month, so the party won’t be in Pattersons Town. It’ll be at Mosman Garden right next to Victor Zoo, just across from our new apartment. Please don’t go to Northbank Park next to our old house.The weather report said that it may be rainy this weekend, but 2. . If it rains, we’ll move the party inside our home. However, if we’re 3. and it is fine, we’ll still have the party at the garden. Again, we’re all very happy and excited to welcome you to join us for some fun this weekend!Best,Mia, Sam & Daniel【110教育會考】（ ）1. (A) Victor Zoo (B) Carlton City (C) Mosman Garden (D) Northbank Park（ ）2. (A) we have a plan if this happens (B) we could just wait for the rain to stop (C) we should be fine if the rain isn’t too heavy (D) we will let you know if we’ll still have the party（ ）3. (A) crazy (B) good (C) lucky (D) strong
choices: we have a plan if this happens
we could just wait for the rain to stop
we should be fine if the rain isn’t too heavy
we will let you know if we’ll still have the party（ ）3.
items.explanation: 1. 由轉折語 However 可知，空格要填的是「舊地點」，而線索可從 However 後面尋找──剛搬到 Carlton 市，故不選 (B)；會在 Victor 動物園旁的 Mosman 花園舉行，故不選 (A) 與 (C)；並由第一段最後一句請求受邀者別去舊家旁的 Northbank 公園，可推斷原先地點就是 Northbank 公園，故選 (D)。2. 下一句指出若下雨，派對便移至室內，由此可知，邀請者已經準備好雨天方案，故選 (A)。3. 由轉折語 However 可推斷，下一句是用來指出與雨天相反時的狀況，也就是「運氣好」，沒有下雨（天氣不錯），派對仍將在花園舉行，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: 【111教育補考】（ ）1. What is the club trying to tell us? (A) We need a world without science. (B) Taking a trip helps learn about the earth. (C) Some actions have to be taken for the earth. (D) The earth is the most beautiful of all planets.（ ）2. What do we know from the letter? (A) Many people die of colds. (B) The spring is getting shorter. (C) The weather is hotter than before. (D) There is not enough food in some places.（ ）3. What does this mean? (A) Living in a better place. (B) Sending e-mails to the club. (C) Changing our ways of living. (D) Making a wish list for the earth.
choices: We need a world without science.
Taking a trip helps learn about the earth.
Some actions have to be taken for the earth.
The earth is the most beautiful of all planets.（ ）2. What do we know from the letter?
The weather is hotter than before.

Making a wish list for the earth.
items.explanation: 1. 由最後一段倒數兩句可知，the 3-W Club 在呼籲大家「拯救地球」，故選 (C)。2. 由第二段末的 the winter is losing its bite「冬天威力減弱」，可推知「天氣變熱了」，故選 (C)。3. 此處 this 應指前面提過的事，而前句提到「請將周遭發生改變的照片以電子郵件寄給我們」，故選 (B)。

items.unit: 114年會考
items.prompt: You may have a long drive because of the terrible ＿＿＿. There are usually a lot of cars and buses during this time.【114教育會考】(A) experience(B) machine(C) service(D) traffic
items.explanation: 由「很多車跟巴士」，可知會開很久是因為糟糕的「交通」，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 110年會考(補考)
items.prompt: www.freshstart.com.tw/Let the words speak!Fay：I was worried though this was my second time moving. But great job again! With your help, my move to the south of the country was great. And I saved 10% for moving with you again!Susan：You were very friendly to me although I was just getting information for my sister. I was surprised that you helped people move somewhere as far as Botswana. Some people don’t even know it’s a country! Anyone would choose you just like my sister did.Joe：When my family planned to move to Fiji, you were our only hope because all the others only sent things to countries near Taiwan. I was also very happy with your price. Your workers packed my things carefully. Everything arrived safely. Thank you!Gary：Our office had to move across the country in a day, and I thought this was not possible. But you did it! You only charged us a little more for moving in such a short time. And you were serious about each of my phone calls. You’re surely the best on the market.【110教育補考】 charge 收費（ ）1. From the reading, what are about? (A) Problems Fresh Start needs to fix. (B) Questions about Fresh Start’s prices. (C) Words from Fresh Start’s best workers. (D) People’s good experiences with Fresh Start.（ ）2. What can we know about Fresh Start from the reading? (A) It helps people move abroad. (B) It does not help with packing. (C) Its office is in the south of Taiwan. (D) It charges half price for moving a second time.（ ）3. What does it mean in the reading? (A) Paying a little more for moving in a short time. (B) Moving across the country in a day. (C) Being serious about phone calls. (D) Being the best on the market.
choices: Problems Fresh Start needs to fix.
Words from Fresh Start’s best workers.
People’s good experiences with Fresh Start.（ ）2. What can we know about Fresh Start from the reading?
It does not help with packing.
Its office is in the south of Taiwan.
It charges half price for moving a second time.（ ）3. What does it mean in the reading?
Paying a little more for moving in a short time.
Moving across the country in a day.
Being the best on the market.
items.explanation: 1. 四人皆描述了自己在 Fresh Start 得到的優良諮詢服務及消費體驗，故選 (D)。2. 由 Susan 說搬到 Botswana 這個鮮為人知的國家，以及 Joe 說搬到 Fiji 這個不在臺灣周圍的國家，可知 Fresh Start 提供海外搬家的服務，故選 (A)。(B) Joe 提到 Fresh Start 的員工打包很仔細；(C) 文中未提；(D) 由 Fay 所說可知第二次搬家是九折，不是半價。3. Fresh Start 真的做到了「這件事」，it 代指前句所提 move across the country in a day 之事，故選 (B)。

items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 111年會考(補考)
items.prompt: Mary has two brothers. One is ten, and is twelve.【111教育補考】(A) another (B) other (C) others (D) the other
items.explanation: 總數為兩個時，表達「一個……而另一個……」應使用One..., and the other…，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 109年會考
items.prompt: After a lot of tests and interviews, you finally got into a good school or got a good job. But there’s a problem: it’s a long way from home. “Well, I can take the bus or drive,” you might think. But before you decide whether it’s OK to have such a long commute, it’s best to know ＿1.＿. Having a long commute means you’ll get fewer hours of sleep, and that’ll make you feel tired easily. You’ll also have less time for friends and family, for exercise, or for a nice meal. A long commute not only eats up your time but also ＿2.＿. Studies show that people who have a long commute get fat easily and often have neck or back problems. It’s easier for them to have heart problems too. ＿3.＿. Studies find that these people get angry more often, feel less happy with their lives, and do less well at work. Now, does that good school or that good job still sound good to you?【109教育會考】（ ）1. (A) what else you can do (B) how you can enjoy it more (C) how it will change your life (D) what is the best way of commute for you（ ）2. (A) costs you money (B) hurts your health (C) makes traffic terrible (D) kills the planet slowly（ ）3. (A) And that’s why (B) But that’s not all (C) And here’s an example (D) But that can be stopped
choices: how you can enjoy it more
how it will change your life
what is the best way of commute for you（ ）2.
items.explanation: 1. 由第二段提到的都是長時間通勤會帶來的生活變化，可知本題應選「它將如何改變你的生活」，故選 (C)。2. 由後兩句提到「易發胖」、「經常有頸部或背部問題」及「易有心臟問題」，可知會「損害你的健康」，故選 (B)。3. 由下一句提到情緒或工作表現的變化，可知前面所述的健康問題「不是全部」，故選 (B)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 110年會考(補考)
items.prompt: A Picture of My Own CityHow will our city look in 100 years’ time?What kind of city will our children, grandchildren or great grandchildren be living in?Now paint your very own idea about our city & you’ll have a chance to win 5,000 dollars!What：① The idea of your painting must be your own. ② Write down the idea behind your painting in 100 words. ③ Paintings that have appeared before in a book, newspaper, or on the Internet cannot be used. ④ Your painting should be done by hand.Where：Send your painting to A Picture of My Own City9F, No. 168, Swan Road, Swan CityWhen：Send your painting before June 30, 2012.Prize：1st Prize：$ 5,000 (1 winner) 2nd Prize：$ 2,500 (2 winners) 3rd Prize：$ 1,000 (3 winners) 4th Prize：$ 500 (5 winners) 5th Prize：Colby Lane’s new picture book Corners of My City (10 winners)To learn more, please visit：http：//picturemyowncity.swancity.gov/【110教育補考】（ ）1. What does Swan City want people to paint? (A) Places in the city that children love. (B) What the city will be like in the future. (C) Places in the city that few people know. (D) What the city was like in their grandparents’ time.（ ）2. What can we learn from the reading? (A) The paintings cannot be made on the computer. (B) The winners cannot sell the paintings to any newspapers. (C) The winning paintings will be collected in a picture book. (D) Colby Lane will help the city choose the ten best paintings.
choices: Places in the city that children love.
What the city will be like in the future.
Places in the city that few people know.
What the city was like in their grandparents’ time.（ ）2. What can we learn from the reading?
The paintings cannot be made on the computer.
The winners cannot sell the paintings to any newspapers.
The winning paintings will be collected in a picture book.
Colby Lane will help the city choose the ten best paintings.
items.explanation: 1. 由第一句所問「我們的城市 100 年後看起來會是如何？」，可推知要畫的是「未來的城市看起來怎麼樣」，故選 (B)。2. 由 What 的第四點可知，參賽作品必須要手繪，故選 (A)，其他三個選項文中並未提及。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 111年會考(補考)
items.prompt: Please send postcards to me when you are on your trip so I can the fun with you.【111教育補考】(A) bring (B) miss (C) share (D) show
items.explanation: 「share sth with sb」表示「和某人分享某物」，此處表「和你分享樂趣」，故選 (C)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 110年會考
items.prompt: Our teacher Ms. Wu seldom laughs, but when she , everyone in the same building can hear her.【110教育會考】(A) can (B) does (C) has (D) will
items.explanation: 助動詞的功用之一，是避免重複某一動詞；此處要避免重複的動詞為現在簡單式的 laughs，因此，助動詞要選現在簡單式第三人稱單數的 does，故選 (B)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 110年會考(補考)
items.prompt: When Cindy cleaning her room, she looked around and felt proud of herself.【110教育補考】(A) finished (B) liked (C) minded (D) missed
items.explanation: 應該是因為「完成」打掃房間這件事，才會看看周圍並以自己為傲。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 111年會考
items.prompt: The movie starts at two o’clock, let’s meet at the theater at one forty-five.【111教育會考】(A) so (B) or (C) if (D) because
items.explanation: 後半句說「要一點四十五在戲院碰面」是前句「電影兩點開始」的結果，故用 so（所以）連接，故選 (A)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 109年會考
items.prompt: Can you your feet a little off the floor? I want to see if my keys are under the sofa. 【109教育會考】(A) check (B) kick (C) raise (D) show
items.explanation: 由後句說要看看鑰匙是否在沙發下，可推知是要對方將腳「舉起」一下，故選 (C)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 104年會考
items.prompt: On Children’s Day, Ms. Lee, a famous storybook writer, ＿＿＿ to Molly’s Bookstore to talk about her new book. My two little kids can’t wait to see her.【104教育會考】(A) came (B) was coming (C) has come (D) is going to come
items.explanation: 關鍵詞 can’t wait to see her （等不及要見她）表示前述事情尚未發生，但即將發生，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 107年會考
items.prompt: Anyone who reads Loren’s business plan will quickly see some serious problems in it, or feel something is not right.【107教育會考】(A) at least (B) even(C) in fact (D) still
items.explanation: 連接詞「或者」為二者擇一；從語意上「看出某些嚴重問題」與「感到某事不對勁」意思相近，但前者情況較後者強烈，故選 (A)，表示若沒這麼強烈，「至少」會感覺事情有異。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 113年會考
items.prompt: It was around eight o’clock on Saturday night. Philip was at home with his little brother, Jason. Jason was hungry and kept crying. But Philip couldn’t cook and their father was not home yet because he was working late in the office. So Philip decided to take Jason out for some food. Half an hour later, when they came back home, Philip was surprised to find that their father was talking to the police and a woman outside their house. He didn’t know who the woman was. She looked scared and stood behind the police. Philip’s father was very angry and kept shouting, “I didn’t do anything wrong! I forgot my keys and was just trying to get into MY OWN HOUSE!” But the police didn’t believe him until Philip ran to them and explained everything. The police told Philip that the woman called 110 when she saw Philip’s father trying to get into a house through a window. That was how it all happened.【113教育會考】（ ）1. Why did Philip go out? (A) To meet a woman. (B) To look for his father. (C) To ask the police for help. (D) To buy food for his brother.（ ）2. Why was Philip’s father angry? (A) He forgot his keys. (B) The woman was hiding from him. (C) The police didn’t believe what he said. (D) Philip and his brother went out at night.
choices: To ask the police for help.
To buy food for his brother.（ ）2. Why was Philip’s father angry?
The woman was hiding from him.
The police didn’t believe what he said.
Philip and his brother went out at night.
items.explanation: 1. 由第一段可知，因為 Jason 餓了且一直在哭，而 Philip 又不會做飯，所以 Philip 決定帶 Jason 出去吃點東西，故選 (D)。2. 由第二段可知，Philip 的父親非常生氣是因為警方直到 Philip 出面解釋為止都不相信他所說的話，故選 (C)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 113年會考
items.prompt: Your refrigerator shouldn’t be making loud noises now, but if it ＿＿＿ does, just give me a call and I’ll come check it again.【113教育會考】(A) already(B) even(C) finally(D) still
items.explanation: 由前句「冰箱現在不應該會發出很大的聲音了」及後句「再打電話給我，我會再次檢查」，推知是如果「仍然」有聲音，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 106年會考
items.prompt: Jim always forgets my birthday. He has asked me many times and still can’t it.【106教育會考】(A) answer (B) celebrate (C) remember (D) understand
items.explanation: 關鍵字為 forgets，第二句為補充說明 Jim 的這種「健忘」狀況是問了許多次，但仍然「記不得（can’t remember）」，故選 (C)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 113年會考
items.prompt: I want to find another dentist because ＿＿＿ pulled out a good tooth last time I went to him.【113教育會考】(A) I(B) me (C) mine(D) myself
items.explanation: 本句用所有格代名詞「mine」表「my dentist（我的牙醫）」，故選 (C)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 107年會考
items.prompt: You need not only good luck but also hard work to become a baseball player.【107教育會考】(A) young (B) successful(C) happy (D) friendly
items.explanation: 由「你不只需要好運氣還需要十分努力」可知，這是要成為一位「成功的」棒球選手的要件，故選 (B)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 113年會考
items.prompt: Chris loves walking with Anna on snowy days, but Anna hates ＿＿＿ very much.【113教育會考】(A) them(B) so(C) one(D) it
items.explanation: 本句用代名詞 it 代替前句提到「下雪天去散步」這件事，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 110年會考
items.prompt: Darayya’s LibraryJohn Edwards, July 21 2016 In Darayya, a city in Syria, there’s a library, and it has 15,000 books on almost every subject you can think of. However, it is different from any libraries you know：It is a secret underground library, and only people in Darayya know where it is. Over the years, war has shaken Darayya badly. Every day, houses are bombed and people are killed. Stores are closed one after another, and so are schools. To help the kids in Darayya with their learning, Anas Ahmad, a 19-year-old student, and his friends decided to build a library. They built the library under the ground to keep it safe from bombing. But it is dangerous to collect books for the library. Often, Ahmad and his friends look for books in houses that were bombed. They need to be careful because they may be killed in another bombing. You may ask, “In a place like Darayya, would people be interested in books?” “Just like the body needs food, the mind needs books,” says one library user. In the library, people enjoy their time of reading and forget about the terrible world above, so their life doesn’t seem so hard. Through reading, they are able to dream of a better life after war.【110教育會考】 war 戰爭 bomb 轟炸 seem 彷彿（ ）1. Below are the ideas that are talked about in the reading.a. The problems Darayya has.b. How Darayya’s library was started.c. What makes Darayya’s library special.d. How Darayya’s library helps people there.In what order does the writer put his ideas in the reading? order 順序 (A) c→b→a→d. (B) b→a→d→c.(C) a→c→b→d. (D) c→a→b→d.（ ）2. Why do people in Darayya go to the library even during the war? (A) They can get free food. (B) They find joy and hope in reading. (C) They want to learn how to win the war. (D) Their school teachers give lessons there.（ ）3. What do we know about Darayya’s library? (A) It was built during the war. (B) It has been bombed many times. (C) It was built to remember people who died in the war. (D) Most of its books are collected from outside of Darayya.
choices: c→a→b→d.（ ）2. Why do people in Darayya go to the library even during the war?
They find joy and hope in reading.
They want to learn how to win the war.
Their school teachers give lessons there.（ ）3. What do we know about Darayya’s library?
It was built during the war.
It has been bombed many times.
It was built to remember people who died in the war.
Most of its books are collected from outside of Darayya.
items.explanation: 1. 報導先是提到德拉雅圖書館之所以特別是因為它在地下，接著說明圖書館建於地下是因為德拉雅發生戰爭、每天都有轟炸，而後，報導提及 Anas Ahmad 發起建造圖書館的過程，最後以圖書館帶給當地居民的慰藉作結，故選 (D)。2. 由第三段可知，德拉雅居民很享受閱讀，且閱讀可以讓他們暫時遺忘痛苦並對未來抱持希望，故選 (B)。3. 第二段提及發生在德拉雅的戰爭導致商店和學校都被轟炸殆盡了，德拉雅的孩童無法上學，Anas Ahmad 為了幫助孩童學習才發起建造圖書館，由此可推知圖書館是建於戰爭期間，故選 (A)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 114年會考
items.prompt: It is hard for trees to ＿＿＿ along this beach because of the strong winds from the sea.【114教育會考】(A) blow(B) build (C) follow(D) grow
items.explanation: 由「強風」可推知是樹「很難生長」，應用 grow 表「生長」，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 112年會考
items.prompt: Mrs. Johnson can’t hear very well. If you need to talk to her, you must .【112教育會考】(A) explain (B) hurry (C) listen (D) shout
items.explanation: 由前句「聽不清楚」，可推知若和 Johnson 太太講話必須「大聲說」，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 108年會考
items.prompt: Here are two pieces of news that Annie collected for her report.[A] Papier-mâché is works of art that are made of paper. In Taiwan, it is known as zhizha and is usually burned as a gift for dead people. Taiwan’s papier-mâché is dying because it is not much needed now. However, this dying art won a Frenchman’s heart when he visited the island. He then invited one of the papier-mâché shops, Hsin Hsin Paper Offering Store, to show their beautiful works in France. The shop owner’s son also used papier- mâché in a way that no one ever thought of—making a movie with it.[B] Stan Lai is very important in Taiwan’s theater. He brought changes to Chinese theater art of the old days to make it closer to our life experiences and easier to understand. One of his most famous works is That Evening, We Performed Crosstalk (1985). It was such a smash hit that people became interested again in xiangsheng, a show of funny talk between two actors. This art used to be a hobby that only a few people shared, but Lai has opened a bigger market for it. Now it has fans across all ages. work 作品【108教育會考】（ ）1. What idea is talked about in both pieces of news? (A) More young people need to join in making art. (B) People’s ways of enjoying art change with time. (C) Bringing important art works to Taiwan from abroad. (D) Giving new life to old arts that were almost forgotten. （ ）2. What does it mean when something is a smash hit? (A) It is old. (B) It is successful. (C) It is foreign. (D) It is useful.（ ）3. What do we know from the news? (A) Lai has taught xiangsheng in many schools. (B) Lai often puts his own life stories into his art works. (C) The owner of Hsin Hsin Paper Offering Store is a Frenchman. (D) People do not burn papier-mâché for dead people as often as before.
choices: More young people need to join in making art.
People’s ways of enjoying art change with time.
Bringing important art works to Taiwan from abroad.
Giving new life to old arts that were almost forgotten. （ ）2. What does it mean when something is a smash hit?
It is useful.（ ）3. What do we know from the news?
Lai has taught xiangsheng in many schools.
Lai often puts his own life stories into his art works.
The owner of Hsin Hsin Paper Offering Store is a Frenchman.
People do not burn papier-mâché for dead people as often as before.
items.explanation: 1. 由全文可知這兩則新聞都是在描述臺灣舊時藝術因為某些人而有了新生命，故選 (D)。 2. 由句子後半「人們因為賴聲川的作品《那一夜，我們說相聲》而又再次對於相聲感到有興趣」可知，smash hit 指的是「成功的作品」，故選 (B)。 3. 由第一則新聞「臺灣的紙紮藝術因為現在已經沒有很多需求，正逐漸沒落」可知，臺灣現在已經沒有很多人燒紙紮給往生者了，故選 (D)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 111年會考
items.prompt: Kevin has only enough money for the bag or the shoes. That is a hard to make because he likes them both.【111教育會考】(A) choice (B) gift (C) rule (D) trick
items.explanation: 錢不夠買兩種，但又兩種都喜歡，可推知會是一個很難的「選擇」，故選 (A)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb
items.subject: 英文
items.unit: 110年會考
items.prompt: We’ve prepared many wonderful surprises for you at e-BeautiMed, BeautiMed’s online store!Surprise 1Join “BeautiMed Friend” online for free and get 2000 BeautiMed points!Surprise 2Already a “BeautiMed Friend”? Come collect your free gift by entering your “BeautiMed Friend” card number at e-BeautiMed before 8/31.Surprise 3Get 500 BeautiMed points by shopping at e-BeautiMed and you’ll get 500 more points if you spend more than $1,000.Surprise 4Shop at e-BeautiMed during 7/1-8/31 and you may win $5,000 or free movie tickets!Surprise 5Invite a friend to join “BeautiMed Friend” and you both can get 1000 points each!【110教育會考】 enter 輸入（ ）1. What is this ad for? (A) Teaching people how to use their BeautiMed points. (B) Telling people they can shop at BeautiMed on the Internet now. (C) Inviting people to share their shopping experience at e-BeautiMed. (D) Letting people know what is on sale at e-BeautiMed from 7/1 to 8/31.（ ）2. What will NOT get you BeautiMed points? (A) Shopping at e-BeautiMed. (B) Joining “BeautiMed Friend” online. (C) Inviting a friend to join “BeautiMed Friend.” (D) Entering the “BeautiMed Friend” card number.
choices: Teaching people how to use their BeautiMed points.
Telling people they can shop at BeautiMed on the Internet now.
Inviting people to share their shopping experience at e-BeautiMed.
Letting people know what is on sale at e-BeautiMed from 7/1 to 8/31.（ ）2. What will NOT get you BeautiMed points?
Inviting a friend to join “BeautiMed Friend.”
items.explanation: 1. 由廣告的標題 We’re online now! 可知是要告訴顧客「本店上線了」，故選 (B)。2. (A) 由「驚喜三」可知購物可獲得 500 點；(B) 由「驚喜一」可知加入會員就可獲得 2000 點；(C) 由「驚喜五」可知邀請朋友加入會員可各得 1000 點；(D) 由「驚喜二」可知輸入卡號會得到免費禮物，而非點數，故選 (D)。

items.prompt: Now I’m going to show you how to work with chocolate. I’ll do it in a “bain-marie,” or, well, some people call it “water bath.” I myself love the name “bain-marie.” To make a “bain-marie,” you need two pots, one bigger than the other. First, break the chocolate into small pieces and put them in the smaller pot. Usually when making chocolate desserts, you’ll need to mix chocolate with butter and sugar. So if you do, put them in the pot too. Now, half fill the bigger pot with warm water. Put the smaller pot over the bigger one, and start to slowly mix the chocolate, the butter, and the sugar together. Keep the water under 50ºC, or the chocolate may lose its shine. And make sure that no water goes in the smaller pot, or the chocolate will become hard and cannot be used. Keep mixing for about five to ten minutes, and the job is done. Easy, right? mix 混合【109教育會考】（ ）1. From the reading, which picture best shows the “bain-marie” way of working with chocolate? (A) (B) (C) (D) （ ）2. What does them mean in the reading? (A) Bains-marie. (B) Butter and sugar. (C) Chocolate desserts. (D) Small pieces of chocolate.（ ）3. From the reading, which is true about working with chocolate? (A) It is better to use a “bain-marie” than a “water bath.” (B) The water in the pot should not be warmer than 50ºC. (C) It is better to finish mixing it in less than five minutes. (D) We should not mix butter and sugar together at the same time.
choices: （ ）2. What does them mean in the reading?
Small pieces of chocolate.（ ）3. From the reading, which is true about working with chocolate?
It is better to use a “bain-marie” than a “water bath.”
The water in the pot should not be warmer than 50ºC.
It is better to finish mixing it in less than five minutes.
We should not mix butter and sugar together at the same time.
items.explanation: 1. 文章第三段描述，隔水加熱時，須將較小的鍋子放在較大的上面，且不要讓水跑到較小的鍋子裡，故選 (B)。2. 由前句「通常都需要將奶油和糖與巧克力混合在一起」可知 them 是指奶油和糖，故選 (B)。3. 文章第三段第三句描述，隔水加熱巧克力時，水溫須保持在 50 度以下，故選 (B)。

items.prompt: Sarah：You’re VERY popular today. I’ve had seventeen calls asking for you.Mike：Finally! After all these years of kicking and running, I’ve got my own fans!So what did they want? My photos? Do I need to sign my name? Are they starting a fan club for me?Sarah：Well, let me ask you this：What day was yesterday?Mike：Friday… Why?Sarah：Did you forget something?Mike：Did I forget… OH, NO! I didn’t pick up my soccer team’s sport shirts from the shop! And we’re having this big game tomorrow!Sarah：Yeah. And from what I’ve heard, it’s your team’s most important game this season.Mike：OK. I have to go fix this now.Sarah：Too late. They’ve tried. It’s not open on the weekend. And if you want to know, they are Johnny, Ricky, Archie, Freddie…Mike：I know, I know, everyone on my team. Oh, I’m a dead man now.Sarah：Yeah, that was what they said on the phone, seventeen times.【108教育會考】（ ）1. Why were there seventeen calls asking for Mike? (A) His team was angry at him. (B) He is a popular soccer player. (C) He did not show up for the game on Friday. (D) His name did not appear on the list of players.（ ）2. What does “It” mean in the dialogue? (A) The shop. (B) The fan club. (C) The soccer game. (D) The soccer season.（ ）3. What can we learn about Mike? (A) He is nice to people from his fan club. (B) He plays soccer with Johnny and Ricky. (C) He found a way to fix the trouble he made. (D) He decided not to go to the game on Sunday.
choices: His team was angry at him.
He is a popular soccer player.
He did not show up for the game on Friday.
His name did not appear on the list of players.（ ）2. What does “It” mean in the dialogue?
The soccer season.（ ）3. What can we learn about Mike?
He is nice to people from his fan club.
He plays soccer with Johnny and Ricky.
He found a way to fix the trouble he made.
He decided not to go to the game on Sunday.
items.explanation: 1. 由 Mike 的第三段話可知他有十七個人打電話給他的原因是他昨天忘記去拿他足球隊隊員的運動服，以至於他的隊員們都很生氣打給他，故選 (A)。2. 由句子的後半段可知，週末沒有開門的是「那家商店」，故選 (A)。3. 由 Sarah 的倒數第二段話可知，Johnny 和 Ricky 都有打電話給 Mike，可推知他們是和 Mike 一起踢足球的隊員，故選 (B)。

On the order list, Ginny ordered a sandwich with cheese, a fruit milk shake, and a fruit drink without ice. How much did she have to pay for her food? (A) $300. (B) $320. (C) $385. (D) $410.（ ）2. items.prompt: Sometimes when the rain falls hard and fast on you, it might hurt a little. But what happens when it hits a mosquito? A 2012 study says when a raindrop falls on a mosquito, it’s like when a bus hits a person. Besides, the little insect is hit by a raindrop about once every 20 seconds. So why don’t we see many dead mosquitoes after it rains?A mosquito is as big as a raindrop, but it is much lighter—0.002 g only. This saves its life in raindrop attacks. Because the mosquito is so light, when it is hit by a raindrop, it won’t experience a force that is strong enough to kill it.The study also found that when a mosquito is hit by a raindrop, the insect is pushed by the raindrop and falls together with it. But the mosquito doesn’t get wet easily because it is covered with hairs which keep off water. After dropping about 6 cm, it will roll off the raindrop and fly away.However, this trick isn’t always successful. If the mosquito flies too low when it is hit by the raindrop, it won’t have time to fly off. Then it will hit the ground and meet its death. force 力量【112教育會考】（ ）1. What is the trick that the mosquito uses in rain? (A) It shakes its body fast enough to get water off. (B) It drops with the raindrop and then rolls off it. (C) It flies behind the raindrop and pushes it away. (D) It rides on the raindrop and lands on the ground.（ ）2. What keeps a mosquito safe in the rain? (A) It is very light. (B) It has no body hairs. (C) It is as big as a raindrop. (D) It is strong enough to fight the force of a raindrop.（ ）3. When would it be dangerous for a mosquito in the rain? (A) When it flies too close to the ground. (B) When the rain falls too hard and too fast. (C) When it is hit by raindrops too many times. (D) When it drops for more than 6 cm in the rain.
choices: It shakes its body fast enough to get water off.
It drops with the raindrop and then rolls off it.
It flies behind the raindrop and pushes it away.
It rides on the raindrop and lands on the ground.（ ）2. What keeps a mosquito safe in the rain?
It is as big as a raindrop.
It is strong enough to fight the force of a raindrop.（ ）3. When would it be dangerous for a mosquito in the rain?
When it flies too close to the ground.
When the rain falls too hard and too fast.
When it is hit by raindrops too many times.
When it drops for more than 6 cm in the rain.
items.explanation: 1. trick 指的即是蚊子應對雨滴的方法，也就是第三段提到的 falls together with it（與其一起落下）、roll off the raindrop（滾掉雨滴），故選 (B)。2. 由第二段的第一～二句可知，蚊子很輕，而這在雨滴攻擊時救了牠的命，故選 (A)。3. 最後一段提到，如果蚊子被雨滴擊中時飛得太低，牠就沒有時間飛走，而是會直接撞到地面而死去，可推知飛太靠近地面是很危險的，故選 (A)。

items.unit: 104年會考
items.prompt: The Metro TimesOct. 1. 2020 These years churches are in a calamitous state. To start with, the number of church-goers is dropping sharply (see Figure 1). Many say they do not belong to any church, and those who do go less often than they used to. Going to church appears less and less on people’s to-do list. Another worrying fact is that fewer and fewer young people go to church, which leads to an older church (see Figure 2). And there is also the problem with money. Keeping a church door open is not cheap. Fewer people going to church means little money coming in. This makes it harder to keep a church open.When the time comes for a church to close, there is little to do but to sell it. Churches that were lucky enough to find a buyer were put to other uses. Some were changed into restaurants or school gyms, and some even became nightclubs, for example. Churches that had little luck were knocked down in the end. Just like a store that keeps losing business needs to think of ways to save itself, it is perhaps time for the church to try to win people’s hearts back and play an important part in people’s lives again. This is not something that one can simply pray to get an answer to. figure 圖 average 平均【104教育會考】（ ）1. What does it mean when someone is in a calamitous state? (A) They have serious trouble. (B) They try to change themselves. (C) They are looking for a second chance. (D) They lost interest in the outside world.（ ）2. What can we learn about the church-goers from the report? (A) Between 1980 and 2005, few church-goers were younger than 50. (B) In 2010, only 6% of church-goers were younger than 50 years old. (C) In 2020, the percentage (%) of church-goers drops to lower than half that in 1980. (D) Between 1980 and 2020, the rising number of old church-goers has led to an old church.（ ）3. What is talked about in the report? (A) Where the church’s money goes. (B) How people decide to join a church. (C) What happens to churches that are closed. (D) Why people have stopped going to church.（ ）4. Below are four findings from other reports. Which does NOT agree with the idea of the report? (A) “Reports show over 90% of church-goers go to church because their fathers do. In the last 20 years, 49% of men under 30 have left the church. That means there’s a 90% chance that their children won’t go to church. This is hard for the church to take in.” (B) “Between 2003 and 2010, over 1,000 new churches were built in the country. This may sound like good news. During the same years, however, more than 2,000 were closed.” (C) “In the report, 33% of the people that were interviewed say they never go to church and another 33% say they used to. Only 15% go to church at least once a month.” (D) “Of the 15 countries in the report, the percentage (%) of church-goers in some countries, like Denmark, is lower than 10%; in others, like Poland, the percentage is higher than 70%.”
choices: They are looking for a second chance.
They lost interest in the outside world.（ ）2. What can we learn about the church-goers from the report?
Between 1980 and 2005, few church-goers were younger than 50.
In 2010, only 6% of church-goers were younger than 50 years old.
Between 1980 and 2020, the rising number of old church-goers has led to an old church.（ ）3. What is talked about in the report?
How people decide to join a church.
What happens to churches that are closed.
Why people have stopped going to church.（ ）4. Below are four findings from other reports. Which does NOT agree with the idea of the report?

“Reports show over 90% of church-goers go to church because their fathers do. In the last 20 years, 49% of men under 30 have left the church. That means there’s a 90% chance that their children won’t go to church. This is hard for the church to take in.”
“Between 2003 and 2010, over 1,000 new churches were built in the country. This may sound like good news. During the same years, however, more than 2,000 were closed.”
“In the report, 33% of the people that were interviewed say they never go to church and another 33% say they used to. Only 15% go to church at least once a month.”
items.explanation: 1. 第一段說明上教堂的人數逐年減少，第二段接著指出另一個問題—錢（there is also the problem with money），可判斷 calamitous state 應該與問題、麻煩（trouble）有關，故選 (A)。2. 選項 (A)「1980 到 2005 年之間，幾乎沒有五十歲以下的人上教堂」，由圖表 2 可知，2005 年之前上教堂年齡平均值仍在五十歲以下，故不符；選項 (B)「2010 年，五十歲以下上教堂的人只佔總人數百分之六」，由兩張圖表均看不出來，故不符；選項 (C)「2020 年，上教堂人數的百分比會掉到 1980 年的一半以下」，由圖表 1 看，1980年百分比為 11，2020 年預測為 4.4 ，故相符；選項 (D)「1980到 2020 年間，長者上教堂的人數上升，導致教堂年齡層老化」，由第一段的最後一句可知主因是年輕人變少，故不符。故選 (C)。3. 僅有選項 (C)「關閉的教堂下場如何」在第三段提到：變成 restaurants、school gyms、nightclubs（夜店），甚至 knocked down（拆除），故選 (C)。4. 報導最後一段為結論，當中的 the church 是泛指所有教堂，而本篇文章從頭到尾都在說教堂邁入老化與沒落，甚至關閉，因此與選項 (D)「報導中的十五個國家，有些國家，像是 Denmark，上教堂的人數百分比低於十；其他的國家，像是 Poland，則高於百分之七十」後半段所描述有高百分比人口上教堂的現象不符，故選 (D)。

items.prompt: GNB NewsForever Takes a Bow Actor Nathan Lang, 78 years old, died in his sleep last night in his house. Nathan Lang started his acting life in the 1970s. He was most known for playing Justin Maud in Young Hours. The movie made the world swoon over him. Women wanted a husband like him; men wanted a brother like him. Forever Justin, his fans called him. After Young Hours, Nathan Lang was seen in several big movies： Fallen, After Tonight, and Killing Jules. The last one won him a best actor award. In the 1980s, Nathan Lang lost his shine on the big screen. During this time, his movies never entered the top 20 list. Nathan Lang’s last movie was Dreams. Though the movie won him two best actor awards, it did not bring his fans back to the theater. This Saturday morning, 10 o’clock at St. Peter’s Church, there will be a “movie party,” as Lang wished. Friends and family will get together and enjoy once again the good times he brought to the world. award 獎項【103教育會考】（ ）1. What is this reading mostly about? (A) Nathan Lang’s love and hate for his family. (B) The good and bad about Nathan Lang’s movies. (C) The rise and fall of Nathan Lang in show business. (D) Nathan Lang’s life before and after he became an actor.（ ）2. What does swoon over mean in the reading? (A) Close the door on. (B) Go crazy about. (C) Share the joy with. (D) Try hard to deal with.（ ）3. Here are reviews about Nathan Lang’s movies. From the reading, which is most likely a review for Dreams? review 評論 likely 可能 (A) …nothing new in the story; Nathan Lang clearly didn’t do enough homework about his part in the movie. It was no surprise that the movie didn’t make it into the top 10 list the first week it was out… (B) …it became Nathan Lang’s second best-selling movie and also this year’s third best-selling movie in the country and may even get him another best actor award… (C) …see him not as the actor Nathan Lang anymore but as the poor old man in the movie. However, good acting does not always help with the ticket sales… (D) …the story is fresh and interesting, but the acting is not. However, it has been the country’s best-selling movie for the past three weeks. Clearly Nathan Lang’s fans cared less about his acting than his handsome face…
choices: Nathan Lang’s love and hate for his family.
The good and bad about Nathan Lang’s movies.
The rise and fall of Nathan Lang in show business.
Nathan Lang’s life before and after he became an actor.（ ）2. What does swoon over mean in the reading?
Try hard to deal with.（ ）3. Here are reviews about Nathan Lang’s movies. From the reading, which is most likely a review for Dreams? review 評論 likely 可能
…nothing new in the story; Nathan Lang clearly didn’t do enough homework about his part in the movie. It was no surprise that the movie didn’t make it into the top 10 list the first week it was out…
…it became Nathan Lang’s second best-selling movie and also this year’s third best-selling movie in the country and may even get him another best actor award…
…see him not as the actor Nathan Lang anymore but as the poor old man in the movie. However, good acting does not always help with the ticket sales…

…the story is fresh and interesting, but the acting is not. However, it has been the country’s best-selling movie for the past three weeks. Clearly Nathan Lang’s fans cared less about his acting than his handsome face…
items.explanation: 1. 文中主要提到 Nathan Lang 何時（in the 1970s）開始他的演藝生涯、哪部片讓他成名（Young Hours）、何時（in the 1980s）開始不再受歡迎等。與選項 (C)「Nathan Lang 演藝生涯的起落」敘述最相符，故選之。 2. 下一句即補充說明 swoon over 的現象，Women wanted a husband like him; men wanted a brother like him.（女人想要一個像他的丈夫；男人想要一個像他的兄弟。），表示人們為 Nathan Lang 瘋狂。故本題選 (B)。 3. 第一段最後兩句說明電影 Dreams 的狀況：Nathan Lang 演得好而得獎、但票房不佳。與選項 (C)「……電影裡 Nathan Lang 不再是個演員，而是那可憐的老人。然而，好的演技不總是票房的保證……」相符，故選之。

items.explanation: 我的叔叔 Jim 不太說話。當他在家的時候，他總是在畫畫。他會在下班後及週末作畫。繪畫是他的生命與最好的朋友。Jim 叔叔不是為了錢而畫畫，他從來沒有把他的作品拿去賣錢。他的畫裡面沒有人物。他只畫樹木與山丘，不過它們與我們平常所看到的不太一樣。它們有著奇特的形狀與顏色。我不是很了解 Jim 叔叔的畫，而且他也從來沒告訴我們他想藉由那些畫來表達什麼。不過，我還是很喜歡那些畫。對我來說，Jim 叔叔創造了一個與眾不同卻有趣的世界。1. 作者認為 Jim 叔叔是怎樣的一個人？(A) 聰明但懶惰。(B) 富有且自豪。(C) 寧靜但特別。(D) 年輕且英俊。依據第一句話「我的叔叔 Jim 不太說話。」，及第二段對他叔叔作畫的描述可以得知，作者的叔叔是個安靜而且特別的人，故答案應選 (C)。2. 繪畫對 Jim 叔叔來說有什麼涵義？(A) 它是一個能使他快樂的嗜好。(B) 它是一個能使他成名的機會。(C) 它是一個能賺錢的生意。(D) 它是一個能忘記健康狀況不好的方法。文章中第一段提到Jim叔叔很喜歡畫畫，那是他的生命與最好的朋友；第二段一開始也說他不是為了錢而作畫。所以可推斷出Jim叔叔把繪畫當成一種可以樂在其中的嗜好，故答案應選 (A)。3. 文中它們是指什麼？(A) 形狀與顏色。(B) 作者的家庭。(C) Jim 叔叔的朋友。(D) 樹木與山丘。在文中第二段第二行 He only draws trees and mountains, but they…，此句前半部提過的樹木與山丘，後半句還要再多加說明時，可用代名詞 they 來替代。所以答案應選 (D)。

They were in a hurry, talking about buying tickets or something.”Peter, the shopkeeper：“Amy? She bought some snacks and drinks around seven in the evening. With a red-haired boy called… Ray. ”Rachel, Ray’s sister：“Ray? Ray went out to meet his girlfriend. They were going to a party in the park next to Best Buy Supermarket. The party started at eight, I think. ” Now Mr. Bronte knows what happened. He is angry and waits for Amy to come home.（ ）1. Where does Mr. Bronte think Amy is now? (A) In a park. (B) At Pam’s house. (D) Mr. Bronte went out to find Amy.（ ）3. Who did NOT see Amy today? (A) Ray. (B) Peter. (C) Tony. (D) Rachel.

items.prompt: Here is what Matt said about his life changes in an interview.“It’s like getting a new life, I mean, living with the Tragers. Being the oldest kid in Rosario Landing isn’t something you’d be proud of. People who go there usually want younger kids, babies even, because babies remember little about their real parents, and it’s easier for them to become close to their new parents. I felt happy for those who left with their new families. I really did. But it got harder to be happy for them when you were never the one to go. I never thought Nicole and Thomas would pick me. They said they felt like they had known me for many years. After spending a few afternoons with me, they decided to take me home. It’s never easy to have a stranger in your life. Lori is nice, but she’s too polite, like I was just one of her parents’ friends. We talk, but not very warmly. Sean deals with it better than his older sister. I slept in his room before I had my own, and we got to play tricks on each other three nights later, like real brothers. If there’s anything I can do to make them feel easier with me, I’ll try. I want to, because, for the first in my life, I feel that I belong somewhere.”（ ）1. From the interview, what do we know about the children at Rosario Landing? (A) They do not live with their parents. (B) They are not treated kindly. (C) They have serious learning problems. (D) They were born there.（ ）2. What can we learn about Matt from the interview? (A) He shares a room with Sean now. (B) He hopes to get close to Lori and Sean. (C) He misses his friends in Rosario Landing. (D) He finds his new life is easier than he thought.（ ）3. Which is true about the Tragers? (A) Sean is the oldest child in the family. (B) There were two children in the family before. (C) Nicole and Thomas decided to have another baby. (D) Thomas thinks Matt looks just like him at a young age.（ ）4. What does it in the fourth paragraph mean? (A) Living with a stranger. (B) Being polite to a stranger. (C) Playing tricks on one’s brother. (D) Talking to one’s parents’ friends.
choices: They do not live with their parents.
They were born there.（ ）2. What can we learn about Matt from the interview?
He shares a room with Sean now.
He hopes to get close to Lori and Sean.
He misses his friends in Rosario Landing.
He finds his new life is easier than he thought.（ ）3. Which is true about the Tragers?
Sean is the oldest child in the family.
There were two children in the family before.
Nicole and Thomas decided to have another baby.
Thomas thinks Matt looks just like him at a young age.（ ）4. What does it in the fourth paragraph mean?
items.explanation: 1. 本題詢孩子們在 Rosario Landing 的情況。由第二段描述可知，在 Rosario Landing 的孩子有機會跟新的家人離開，故那裡應該是個孤兒院。而選項 (B)「孩子們未被善待」、(C)「孩子們有嚴重的學習問題」均未被提到；選項 (D)「孩子們在那裏出生」與文章不符，故選 (A)「孩子們沒有跟他們的父母住一起」。2. 選項 (A)「Matt 現在與 Sean 共用一個房間」，由文章第四段可判斷那是過去的事情；選項 (B)「Matt 希望與 Lori 和 Sean 親近」與文章最後一段相符；選項 (C)「Matt 想念在 Rosario Landing 的朋友」與選項 (D)「Matt 發現他的新生活比他想得容易」均未在文章中提到。故選 (B)。3. 題詢問 Tragers 一家的狀況。選項 (A)「Sean 是家中最年長的孩子」，應該是最小的孩子；選項 (B)「這家人以前只有兩個小孩」，在Matt 來之前的確是；選項 (C)「Nicole 與 Thomas 決定要另一個嬰兒」與選項 (D)「Thomas 認為 Matt 像年輕時候的他」則不在訪談中提到。故選 (B)。4. 句子中的代名詞通常是指涉前面提過的事物。由文中可追溯，it 之前的句子中有提到「接納一個陌生人到你的生命裡並不容易」，Lori 便是以很有禮貌的態度面對 Matt 這個剛來的陌生人，跟 Matt 說話就像在跟她父母親的朋友在說話一樣。而 it 後面又說出了 Sean 處理同樣一件事情的不同態度，他很能適應有個陌生人跟他們一起同住。故選 (A)「與陌生人一起住（這件事）」。

(A) 湖泊大飯店 (B) 玫瑰園 (C) 喬伊的廚房 (D) 祖母的博物館。Lake Road 上有很多地方，但是按照 Brown 先生最後一個指示「經過芬尼學校時，你就會看到了。」可推斷出 Angela 要問的地方就是「喬伊的廚房」。

items.prompt: Dear Jean, How have you been? I’m writing this to say I’m sorry that 21. your birthday. These days I felt there was something wrong, but I just couldn’t think of what it was. Yesterday afternoon on the bus, I 22. remembered what it was. Your birthday is this month, and it was two weeks ago! I feel so bad. I picked out a gift for you. I hope you like it. By the way, 23. a great time on your birthday? I can’t wait to hear about it.Love,Linda by the way 順便一提（ ）1. (A) I forget (B) I forgot (C) I’m forgetting (D) I’ve forgotten（ ）2. (A) also (B) finally (C) only (D) still（ ）3. (A) have you had (B) are you having (C) would you have (D) did you have
items.explanation: 1. 由文章全篇內容可知是 Linda 忘記 Jean的生日，但她現在想起來了，表達以前忘記的時態須用過去式；且 forget（忘記）的過去式為 forgot，故選 (B)。 2. 本句是在說明雖然 Linda 忘了 Jean 的生日，但在昨天下午她「終於」想起來了，故只有 finally 符合句意，故選 (B)。 3. 由文章內容可知 Jean 的生日是在兩星期前，所以 Linda 問 Jean 在她生日當天是否過得愉快，時態須用過去式，故選 (D)。

(A) Crazy_P was not happy about Goodies’ prices. (B) Jane.TW has not been to Goodies before. (C) Awe’s is a new restaurant. (D) Awe’s is next to Goodies.（ ）3. choices: Crazy_P thinks of Goodies as her favorite.

Do you want to join us?Carl： When are you going?Billy： Saturday.Carl： I’d like to, but my sister and I are going biking in Rose Park this Saturday. Maybe next time.Billy： Oh, OK. What’s that?Carl： It’s a bag of chocolate balls with butter inside, and it tastes good with tea.Billy： It sounds great. I can’t wait for Saturday to come.（ ）1. Which is true about Silver Hut? (A) It is inside a park. (B) It is a bicycle shop. (C) It is closed on Sundays. (D) It is popular with teenagers.（ ）2. What is nomisini? (A) A song. (B) A drink. (C) A game. (D) A snack.（ ）3. A snack.（ ）3. Why isn’t Carl going to Silver Hut?
He does not like the place.
He has never heard of the place.
He and his sister already have plans.

items.explanation: Billy：Roger和我要去Silver Hut吃晚餐。你要不要跟我們一起去？Carl：你們什麼時候要去？Billy：星期六。Carl：我想去，但我和我妹妹這禮拜六要去Rose Park騎腳踏車。下次吧。Billy：喔！好吧。但你有去過Silver Hut，是吧？我總是聽人家說那裡很棒。真的那麼讚嗎？Carl：喔！是啊！他們的茶、點心和音樂都很讚。很多高中生都很喜歡去那裡。喔！別忘了點 nomisini。Billy：Nomisini？那是什麼？Carl：那是一袋巧克力球，裡面是奶油，配著茶吃滋味不錯。Billy：聽起來不錯。我已經等不及星期六快點來了。1. 關於Silver Hut哪一個敘述正確？(A) 它在公園裡面。 (B) 它是一個腳踏車店。(C) 它在星期天不營業。 (D) 它很受青少年歡迎。由文章第八行Carl所說的話Lots of high school students like to go there.（很多高中生喜歡去那裡。）可知Silver Hut很受青少年歡迎，答案應選(D)。2. nomisini是什麼？(A) 一首歌。 (B) 一種飲料。(C) 一種遊戲。 (D) 一種點心。由文章倒數第二行 Carl 所形容的nomisini is a bag of chocolate... 可知它是一種點心。答案因此選 (D)。3. 為什麼 Carl 不能去 Silver Hut？(A) 他不喜歡那個地方。 (B) 他從沒聽過那個地方。(C) 他和他妹妹早已有計畫了。 (D) 他不想和Billy去那裡。由文章第四行 Carl 所說的 I’d like to, but my sister and I... 可知 Carl 早已和他妹妹約好星期六要去騎腳踏車了。因此答案選 (C)。

items.prompt: In the art world, many artists with “weak” bodies have shown us a “strong” power in their great works of art. Take Frida Kahlo for example. She was a healthy girl until she was knocked down by a bus at the age of twelve. Much of her body was seriously hurt, but her mind wasn’t. In her paintings, we can feel her strong love of art and life. Another example is Christy Brown. He was born in bad health, and the only part of his body that could move was his left foot. However, using his only foot, he still was able to write and draw wonderfully. In his autobiography, Brown wrote what happened in his life and how he began to draw pictures with his left foot. And don’t forget Stevie Wonder. He became blind soon after he was born, but he is now a popular singer and songwriter. These artists with “weak” bodies bring us many good things and much hope with their “strong” minds. Their stories tell us that the most important thing in life is not what we have, but what we make of it.（ ）1. What is the writer trying to say? (A) History always repeats itself. (B) Art is the best medicine for a weak mind. (C) We should try to make the best use of our lives. (D) It takes more than hard work to make a great artist.（ ）2. What does autobiography mean? (A) A movie about great writers’ lives. (B) A book of a person’s life by that person. (C) A videotape that teaches how to write stories. (D) A picture with the painter’s name on the bottom.（ ）3. Which is true about the three artists in the reading? (A) They all died at a young age. (B) They are all famous painters. (C) They all had problems with their bodies. (D) They were all in bad health when they were born.
choices: Art is the best medicine for a weak mind.
We should try to make the best use of our lives.
It takes more than hard work to make a great artist.（ ）2. What does autobiography mean?
A movie about great writers’ lives.
A book of a person’s life by that person.
A videotape that teaches how to write stories.
A picture with the painter’s name on the bottom.（ ）3. Which is true about the three artists in the reading?
They all died at a young age.
They all had problems with their bodies.
They were all in bad health when they were born.
items.explanation: 1. 本題詢問文章的作者想要說甚麼。通常在文章最後一段為結論，也會透露作者想要傳達的意念。本文最後一段指出「生命中最重要的事，不是我們擁有甚麼，而是我們能用生命創造甚麼」，與選項 (C)「我們應該要試著善用我們的生命」符合。2. 通常在難字後面的句子會解釋或說明該難字的意思，故由「Brown 寫出他人生中所發生的事，以及如何開始用他的左腳畫畫」可知，autobiography 是「一本由當事人自己寫的有關自己人生的書」，故選 (B)。3. 選項 (A)「他們都在年輕的時候去世」，第一段最後一句指出其中一人現在還活著，故不符；選項 (B)「他們都是有名的畫家」，Stevie Wonder 是個歌手與作曲家，故不符；選項 (C)「他們都有身體的問題」與文章相符；選項 (D)「他們都在出生時健康狀況就不好」，Frida Kahlo 是在十二歲車禍後身體才有狀況的，故不符。本題應選 (C)。

I came very early.Ted：Aren’t we meeting each other at the Toy Store, next to Gate C？Ben：No, at the 1. , near Gate B.Ted：Oh, no. I made a mistake. How can I get to you now?Ben：I’m on the other side. Just 2. . You’ll see me next to the Internet Café.Ted：OK, but I want to 3. first. Do you know where to go?Ben：Yes. Walk past the Music Shop and the Key Store. items.prompt: Six people are talking about two pie shops in a TV program.Lily：I’ve been going to Pie House for twenty years. Now Marie’s son is taking care of the business, and he makes pies as good as his mother’s.Olive：I went to Pie Corner once. Their pies were great, too. But I feel more comfortable at Pie House.Ned：Uncle Roy used to work for my mom. Later he opened Pie Corner on the next block after he got married.Marie：Roy was already quite avant-garde when working with me. I mean he had different, sometimes even strange, ideas about pies. There were times I thought his pies wouldn’t taste good, but they turned out magically delicious.Lee：Ned has done quite well with Pie House. His pies make you feel warm. But if you want to try something interesting, you should go to Pie Corner.Chuck：If eating Roy’s pies is like taking an exciting trip, then Ned’s pies are just like a sweet home you go back to after a long trip.（ ）1. What do we know about the six people? (A) They all have been to both pie shops. (B) They all talked about what the pies taste like. (C) Some of them are the shopkeepers of the pie shops. (D) Some of them talked about how the shopkeepers treated their workers.（ ）2. Which is true about the pie shops? (A) Pie House is a family business. (B) Pie Corner is next to Pie House. (C) Pie Corner has a longer history than Pie House. (D) Pie House gives people a place to stay for the night.（ ）3. What does avant-garde mean in the reading? (A) Having a new and surprising way of thinking. (B) Trying to find out where the problems come from. (C) Trying to act like someone who knows everything. (D) Having many exciting and eye-opening life experiences.
choices: They all have been to both pie shops.
They all talked about what the pies taste like.
Some of them are the shopkeepers of the pie shops.
Some of them talked about how the shopkeepers treated their workers.（ ）2. Which is true about the pie shops?
Pie House is a family business.
Pie Corner is next to Pie House.
Pie Corner has a longer history than Pie House.
Pie House gives people a place to stay for the night.（ ）3. What does avant-garde mean in the reading?
Having a new and surprising way of thinking.
Trying to find out where the problems come from.
Trying to act like someone who knows everything.
Having many exciting and eye-opening life experiences.
items.explanation: 1. 由文中可知，Lily 只有提到有關她去 Pie House 的感想，故不確定她是否有去吃過 Pie Corner，故選項 (A) 敘述錯誤；由文中可知 Ned 並沒有講述到他對於這兩家派店的口味的感想，故選項 (B) 敘述錯誤；由 Lily 說現在 Pie House 的生意是由 Marie 的兒子掌管，Ned 說 Pie Corner 的老闆 Roy 以前是跟他的媽媽一起工作，和 Marie 說 Roy 以前是和她一起工作可推知本文中說話的 Marie 就是 Pie House 的老闆，且 Ned 是她的兒子，故選項 (C) 敘述正確；文中並沒有提到這兩家店的老闆是如何對待他們的員工的，所以選項 (D) 不可選。 2. 由 Lily 說「Marie 的兒子現在接管了 Pie House 的生意。」可推知 Pie House 是家族事業，故選項 (A) 正確；由 Ned 說「Roy 叔叔在結婚後就到隔壁街區開了 Pie Corner。」，可推知 Pie Corner 和 Pie House 並不是在隔壁，故選項 (B) 錯誤；由文中可知 Pie Corner 的老闆 Roy 以前是跟 Pie House 的老闆 Marie 一起工作的，Roy 是在結婚後才自己出來開 Pie Corner，故可知選項 (C)「Pie Corner 比 Pie House 的歷史更久遠。」有誤；本文中沒有提到 Pie House 有提供客人留宿過夜的服務，故選項 (D) 錯誤。 3. 由 Marie 說的後句 I mean he had different, sometimes even strange, ideas about pies.（我是指關於派，他有不同的想法，甚至有時可以說是奇怪的想法。），可以推知 avant-garde 可以指一個人有很新奇，很有趣的想法，故選 (A)。

items.explanation: Louis Black 正在市立藝術中心展出一段深入年輕農人心中的旅程 會說話的雞？會跳舞的牛？他們都在 Louis Black 的漫畫書中。 Louis Black 生於農家。這個恬靜的年青人花了大半輩子在田裡幫忙他的父母。當他九歲的時候，他開始畫起農場上的動物。後來，他用他獨特詼諧的方式把牠們融入自己的漫畫書裡。漫畫書僅供家人欣賞，從未讓農場以外的人們看過。 這位害羞農人的漫畫書在他死後才出名。他在三年前一場火災中喪生，當時年僅三十五歲。為了紀念他，家人將他的漫畫書展示於城裡的博物館，那些漫畫書深受人們喜愛。現在Louis Black農場動物的漫畫原稿將在市立藝術中心展出，為期一個月。快來參觀Louis Black 的美麗世界吧！1. 這篇文章目的為何？(A) 計劃一場農村之旅。 (B) 告訴人們一場美術展覽。(C) 博物館的開幕誌慶。 (D) 畫漫畫的心得分享。根據文意可知，此為告知人們美術展覽的通知廣告，故答案選 (B)。2.文中的 them 指的是什麼？(A) 農場上的動物。 (B) Louis Black的家人。(C) 農場外的人。 (D) Louis Black的漫畫書。由上下文可知，此處的代名詞代替前面出現過的名詞，即為農場上的動物。3. passed on 是什麼意思？(A) 死亡。 (B) 長大。 (C) 結婚。 (D) 變成農夫。文中說明Louis Black死後才出名，因此該片語的意思為「死亡」。

When you bought it, you told me you’d take care of it, remember?Lin-hua：But now I want it to live free.Mom：I think you’re just tired of keeping it. Also, if your pet fish comes from another country, it may bring some problems for the living things in our country after you put it into our river. Haven’t you heard about the fire ants from South America? Since they were brought to Taiwan, they’ve made lots of trouble for the animals and plants here.Lin-hua：But I read a newspaper report which said that in New Zealand, animals and plants from other countries aren’t always trouble-makers. With these new friends, New Zealand has become a country with many different kinds of animals and plants.Mom：Well, I just want you to think twice before you do anything. Now, the floor is dirty because of your jumping fish. Please go mop the floor.（ ）1. What is talked in the newspaper report? (A) Some animals and plants from abroad grow better in New Zealand. (C) Check where her fish comes from. (D) Find out whether the report is true.
choices: Some animals and plants from abroad grow better in New Zealand.
Some animals and plants from New Zealand are very popular in Taiwan.
In Taiwan, some animals and plants from New Zealand do not grow well.

items.explanation: 當 Marcy 還是個小女孩的時候，她的父母總是擔心沒有足夠的錢。他們憂愁的臉使得 Marcy 決定要幫忙分擔家計。所以她十五歲那年輟學並開始工作。從那時開始，她做了許多不同的工作。大部分的工作薪水都不是很多，但她都很努力工作並學到很多東西。Marcy 現在三十歲，她家的生活已經比以前好多了。但是 Marcy 的朋友告訴她應該學習賺更多的錢。他們教了她許多方法，不過她都沒有嘗試。她對有風險的事不感興趣。她現在最想做的事就是回到學校讀書。她知道如果重新再當學生將會是她最快樂的事。1. 由整個句子（第一段第二句）來看，都在描述過去的事情，整句時態應一致，因此動詞應為過去式，答案為 (B)。2. 從文章的第二段第三句可知，but 連接前後兩個對等的句子時態應一致，須用現在完成式，故答案應選 (C) have taught。3. 由文章的最後一句來看，if 後面的子句是未來有可能發生的狀況，所以前面子句為推測她應該會很快樂。由於情況還沒有發生，所以時態應該用未來式，答案選 (D)。

items.prompt: We’re soon going back to Taiwan, and have to say goodbye to Mr. Brown, the excellent helper for our family since we came to the U.S. Mr. Brown helps us clean the house, prepare dinner and take care of our two little girls. The girls call him “Uncle Bill” and have a good time with him. Mr. Brown lives near the train station with his wife. If you need somebody to help around your house, he can work for you from 1：00-6：00 p.m., from Monday to Friday. Please call him at 388-5566. If you need him to stay later, feel free to talk to him. items.unit: 100年度第一次聯測(北北基)
items.prompt: One hot summer afternoon, a rabbit went down to a river to drink some water. He saw himself in the river when he was drinking. “Look at my beautiful long ears!” the rabbit said to himself. “I’m so proud of them. But my legs! They’re short and make me look stupid.” When the rabbit finished drinking, he raised his head and found a tiger was jumping on him. With his short legs, the rabbit began to run as fast as the wind. The tiger could not catch up with him. “I’m so lucky,” said the rabbit happily when he stopped running. Five minutes later, the tiger appeared again. Just at the moment when the rabbit saw the tiger, the tiger caught him by his long ears. That was the end of the rabbit.（ ）1. Which idea is NOT implied in the reading? imply 隱喻；暗示 (A) Beautiful things may bring trouble. (B) Even things we do not like can be useful. (C) Ask others’ ideas before taking any action. (D) People often fail to understand what may be important.（ ）2. What do we know from the story? (A) The tiger was proud of running fast. (B) The rabbit was finally killed in his sleep. (C) The tiger caught the rabbit’s tail in the end. (D) The rabbit was able to run away the first time.
choices: Even things we do not like can be useful.
Ask others’ ideas before taking any action.
People often fail to understand what may be important.（ ）2. What do we know from the story?
The tiger was proud of running fast.
The rabbit was finally killed in his sleep.
The tiger caught the rabbit’s tail in the end.
The rabbit was able to run away the first time.
items.explanation: 1. 選項 (A) 美麗的事物可能會帶來麻煩；選項 (B) 即使是我們不喜歡的東西也可能是有用的；選項 (C) 在採取行動之前，先問別人的意見；選項 (D) 人們時常都不曉得什麼東西對自己而言可能是重要的。兔子因為自己討厭但疾如風的短腿而獲救，最後卻因為自己喜歡卻礙事的長耳朵而被老虎捉到，可知選項 (C) 並非本文所欲傳達給讀者的。 2. 選項 (A)「老虎對於跑得很快感到驕傲。」，故事中並未提到；選項 (B)「兔子最後在他的睡覺時被殺死。」，兔子有看到老虎，但卻因耳朵被捉到喪命；選項 (C)「最後兔子被老虎捉到尾巴。」，兔子被捉到的地方是長耳朵；選項 (D)「那隻兔子第一次能夠逃走」，由兔子說：「我很幸運」，可知他一開始成功逃離老虎的獵捕。故選項 (D) 為正解。

Now my family lives in the city. Last Sunday my daughter asked me to take her to see the beautiful river I was always talking about. "I want so much to go fishing there with you and Grandma," she said. When we went to the river, we only saw a factory and a mountain of garbage. My mom was surprised, my daughter was disappointed, and I was sad-the river was my best friend; I grew up with it. Now there are no fish in it; the birds are gone, too. I hear it crying for help. items.prompt: Dear Aunt Tara, I have a problem with my homework. We have to do it in a group. It has to be finished this Friday, but Gary, the boy in our group, has done nothing helpful. He just keeps rocking the boat. Every time we talk about the work with him, he always says, “Don’t worry. I’ll do it later.” But he seldom does his job. And when he does, he does it the wrong way. Someone has to do it for him again. What’s worse is when Ms. Lin asks about our group, Gary always tells her that we others don’t work hard enough. I’m really mad at Gary about this. We’re in the same group. Shouldn’t we help each other to do a better job?Kate────────────────────────Dear Kate, It is important for students to learn how to work together in a group. Maybe you should talk to Gary about the problem and tell him you all need his help. If he still doesn’t change, go talk to your teacher. I believe she can make Gary do his job.Aunt Tara（ ）1. What does rocking the boat most likely mean in Kate’s letter? likely 可能 (A) Doing easy jobs. (B) Telling people what to do. (C) Working without thinking. (D) Stopping things going well.（ ）2. What does “this” mean? (A) Speaking at the wrong time. (B) Talking too much about himself. (C) Saying something bad about the group. (D) Making excuses for being late for group meetings.（ ）3. What do we know from Aunt Tara’s letter? (A) Gary has decided to change himself. (B) Kate is the leader of Ms. Lin’s class. (C) Gary should be put in another group. (D) Kate should let Gary know how she feels.
choices: Stopping things going well.（ ）2. What does “this” mean?
Saying something bad about the group.
Making excuses for being late for group meetings.（ ）3. What do we know from Aunt Tara’s letter?
Gary has decided to change himself.
Kate is the leader of Ms. Lin’s class.
Gary should be put in another group.
Kate should let Gary know how she feels.
items.explanation: 1. 本題詢問 rocking the boat 最可能的意思。文章中，這種狀況通常會在下一句開始舉例說明。由文中可知，Gary 很少做事，即使做了也沒做對，害大家得幫他重做，與選項 (D)「不讓事情順利」相符，故選 (D)。2. 在文章中的代名詞，通常是指之前提過的事物。由文中可知，Kate 氣的是Gary 跟林老師說隊上的壞話，故選 (C)。3. 四個選項分別為 (A)「Gary 已經決定要改變自己」、(B)「Kate 是林老師班的班長」、(C)「Gary 應被放到其他組」、(D)「Kate 應該讓 Gary 知道她的感受」。本題詢問可以從 Tara 阿姨的信中得到甚麼訊息，由信的第二句開始可知，Tara 阿姨是建議 Kate 先讓 Gary 知道他們的難處，若Gary 不改再告訴老師，故選 (D)。

items.explanation: 淑芬正在讀國中三年級。她每天有很多的考試，但她完全不想看書。淑芬以前不是這樣子的。事實上，她在一、二年級時很喜歡念書而且總是在考試時得高分。她那時過得很開心。 但是最近淑芬總是覺得累而且感到無趣。她有太多考試以致於她無法放輕鬆做她喜歡的事。但是她能怎麼辦呢？她只能告訴自己等到她上高中後事情會好轉的。1. 由文章第二行Shu-fen was not like this before（淑芬以前不是這樣的）可知之後句子是在講過去的事，因此動詞須用過去式，答案為(B)。2. 因文章第二段第一句But these days...（但是最近幾天……）在講最近淑芬的狀況，因此時態回到「現在式」來陳述現在的事實。故答案選現在式 (A)。3. 由句意可知淑芬試著告訴自己「在上高中後事情將會好轉」，是在講未來的事，時態須用未來式，答案應選 (D)。get better表示「好轉」。

items.prompt: Ron：Excuse me, sir, but I missed your words because I was asking Amy about the coming quiz.Mr. Lin：Well, I said, “I have to finish this lesson by the end of this class, so stop asking questions from now on. ” Got it? Now turn to page 53….Ron：What kind of question?Mr. Lin：Any question. Now turn to page 53….Ron：And stop asking who? You or the classmates?Mr. Lin：Just stop talking when I’m busy teaching, Ron. From now on, anyone who moves his lips will come sit in the front. Now turn to page 53….Ron：Are you serious? Where in the front?(Mr. Lin moves Ron’s chair next to the blackboard.)Mr. Lin：Now you’ve got the answers, Ron.（ ）1. What do we know from the reading? (A) Mr. Lin thinks Ron is lazy. (B) Ron does not like going to school. (C) Ron has missed Mr. Lin’s classes several times. (D) Mr. Lin does not think Ron took his words seriously.（ ）2. What does the reading say about Ron? (A) He did not study for the quiz. (B) He did not take notes in class. (C) He kept asking questions in class. (D) He moved Amy’s chair next to him.
choices: Mr. Lin thinks Ron is lazy.
Ron does not like going to school.
Ron has missed Mr. Lin’s classes several times.
Mr. Lin does not think Ron took his words seriously.（ ）2. What does the reading say about Ron?
He did not study for the quiz.
He did not take notes in class.
He kept asking questions in class.
He moved Amy’s chair next to him.
items.explanation: 1. 由林老師重覆「不要提問、不要講話」，但 Ron 還是不斷提問，可知 Ron 並沒有把林老師的話當真，也沒有遵守老師的規定。故選 (D) 。 2. 即使林老師已說明這堂課禁止提問，但 Ron 還是不斷的發問，故選 (C)。

items.unit: 100年度第一次聯測(北北基)
items.prompt: Marcel Proust (1871-1922) is one of the greatest French writers. He is famous for his great book À la Recherche du Temps Perdu, which means “remembering the past.” In this book, Proust writes many stories of rich but unhappy people. These rich people think they should be well liked or loved. When they learn that they are not as popular as they think, they feel sad and try hard to be important in the eyes of others. That is why they always feel troubled and can never really enjoy their lives. In contrast to the lives of those people in his book, the last fifteen years of Proust’s life shows one can still find joy in hard times. During those years, he was very sick and had to stay in bed most of the time. But in his sickroom he found most joy in writing À la Recherche du Temps Perdu and ended up being a great writer because of the book.（ ）1. What can we learn about Proust from this reading? (A) He became poor and sick because of writing. (B) He got a lot of pleasure from writing in his later life. (C) He often wrote about how people get stronger in hard times. (D) He started writing À la Recherche du Temps Perdu when he was fifteen.（ ）2. Which is said about the rich people in Proust’s book? (A) They try to forget their past. (B) They try to get what they do not have. (C) They are sick and stay in bed most of the time. (D) They are rich enough to have their stories written.（ ）3. What does In contrast to mean? (A) Ahead of. (B) Worse than. (C) Important to. (D) Different from.
choices: He became poor and sick because of writing.
He got a lot of pleasure from writing in his later life.
He often wrote about how people get stronger in hard times.
He started writing À la Recherche du Temps Perdu when he was fifteen.（ ）2. Which is said about the rich people in Proust’s book?
They try to forget their past.
They try to get what they do not have.
They are sick and stay in bed most of the time.
They are rich enough to have their stories written.（ ）3. What does In contrast to mean?
items.explanation: 1. 由第三段第三句中的「But in his sickroom he found most joy in writing...」（但在他的病房中，他因寫作而找到極大的樂趣），故可推測 Proust 在晚年從寫作中獲得快樂，故選 (B)。 2. 由第二段第三句，當有錢人發現自己並不如想像中受人愛戴，他們覺得很難過，所以就想盡辦法要讓別人重視他們，故可推測他們試圖獲得他們所未擁有的東西，故選 (B)。 3. 第二段提到有錢人的種種不快樂，而第三段提到 Proust 因寫作而得到喜悅，根據上下文，可知片語 in contrast to 有「與某事相反、相對」之意，與 different from（與……不同）語意相似，故選 (D)。
