items.prompt: Weight control is very popular these days. People hope to become thin quickly. Some even take medicine without a doctor's prescription. But reports show that although many of them do lose weight, they soon gain it back or gain even more. So how can you safely control your weight? Diet and exercise are the answers. Eat only when you are hungry and eat only food that is good for your health. Never just stop eating; doing so can make you feel even hungrier, and you will eat more. Also, it is better to prepare your own food instead of eating out. And think about changing your lifestyle. For example, turn off the TV and the computer and get some exercise every day. But remember： Don't be too strict with yourself. Give yourself some time to find the best way to control your weight. although 雖然 instead of 而不要 lifestyle 生活方式( ) 1. Which is the best title for the reading? (A) Medicine for Losing Weight. (B) Tips for Losing Weight Quickly. (C) Why People Need Weight Control. (D) Safe Ways to Control One's Weight. title 標題( ) 2. According to the writer, what happens to people who take medicine to lose weight? (A) They feel unhappy about eating. (B) Many of them put on weight again. (C) They cannot concentrate on their work. (D) Most of them lose too much weight and get sick. according to 根據( ) 3. What does Don't be too strict with yourself mean in the reading? (A) Eat anything you like when you feel unhappy. (B) Never try to lose weight in a way that is too difficult. (C) Try to relax by watching TV or playing computer games. (D) Don't feel bad if you have spent a lot of money trying to lose weight.
choices: Many of them put on weight again.
They cannot concentrate on their work.
Eat anything you like when you feel unhappy.
Never try to lose weight in a way that is too difficult.

Don't feel bad if you have spent a lot of money trying to lose weight.

items.prompt: Nov. 12, 1993 I saw this picture in this week’s Time magazine. A photographer named Gregory Heisler sent the picture to Time. The boys in the picture are all wearing different clothes, but they all share the same face. They do not just look like each other. In fact, they are the same person. Heisler “made” this funny picture on the computer. But in the future, with the science of ‘cloning’ (copying living things), a picture like this one may not just be a computer trick. The idea of cloning began a long time ago. It became real when some animals like frogs were successfully cloned. At first, I didn’t care much about these studies. However, when some studies showed that even “people” could be cloned, I felt the studies had gone too far. I don’t know much about science, but I do know I would hate to live on a planet full of copies of me. I found myself scared by the smiles of the copied boys when I looked at the picture again. To me, a world of cloned people is a world where the rules of nature are broken, which may bring a lot of problems we’ve never thought of. magazine 雜誌 photographer 攝影師（ ）1. What is the writer trying to say? (A) Good simple things bring us the same joy. (B) Science and art can both help us look better. (C) A world of people with the same face is terrible. (D) People will share the same health problems some day.（ ）2. Which is said about cloning? (A) It will make our living space smaller. (B) Many rules have been made for its use. (C) It has been talked about for a long time. (D) Most people do not think it is a good idea.（ ）3. Which is said about the picture? (A) It is an example of computer tricks. (B) It was taken of Gregory Heisler’s family. (C) It first appeared in Gregory Heisler’s picture book. (D) The parents in it are in fact worried about their children.
choices: Good simple things bring us the same joy.
Science and art can both help us look better.
A world of people with the same face is terrible.
People will share the same health problems some day.（ ）2. Which is said about cloning?
It will make our living space smaller.
Many rules have been made for its use.
It has been talked about for a long time.
Most people do not think it is a good idea.（ ）3. Which is said about the picture?
It is an example of computer tricks.
It was taken of Gregory Heisler’s family.
It first appeared in Gregory Heisler’s picture book.
The parents in it are in fact worried about their children.
items.explanation: 1. 由文中第二段最後一句「我覺得這研究已經太超過了」，以及第三段第一句「我將會很討厭活在一個充滿我自己複製品的星球上」可知，作者對複製人的看法是負面的，故選 (C)。 2. 由文中第二段第一句「複製的概念很早就開始。」可知「複製」的話題已經被討論多時，故選 (C)。 3. 文中第一段第一到第六句說明這張照片，其中第六句說明「Heisler 用電腦「製作」了這張有趣的照片。」故選 (A)。

items.prompt: I had a dream – a strange dream that has helped me to understand Eric much better. In the dream, Eric looked angry and said, “Melissa, I have something to tell you.” I’ve lived with Eric for more than five years. He is the cutest thing I’ve ever seen. I buy him fish and milk and lots of toy mice once a week. I even bought a small house for him, because he sometimes likes to be left only by himself. I love him with all my heart, and give him all I love. But what has gone wrong? In the dream Eric said angrily, “I don’t like fish. I don’t like milk. And toy mice? Are you crazy? I’m not a cat. And I don’t want to be a cat, either!” Then he ran back to his small house. After the dream, I know better： dogs don’t like fish or milk. And surely they do not like toy mice. Most important of all, they will let you know when they are really angry!（ ）1. What can we learn about Eric in the reading? (A) He likes cats. (B) He is Melissa’s pet. (C) He is four years old. (D) He enjoys talking with Melissa.（ ）2. Why was Eric angry in the dream? (A) He did not have many friends. (B) Melissa loved him the wrong way. (C) Melissa did not take him out for a long time. (D) There were too many mice in Melissa’s house.（ ）3. Why did Melissa buy a house for Eric? (A) Eric did not sleep well in her room. (B) Eric needed more space for his toys. (C) Eric was too big to share a bed with her. (D) Eric did not always like to be with others.
choices: He enjoys talking with Melissa.（ ）2. Why was Eric angry in the dream?
He did not have many friends.
Melissa loved him the wrong way.
Melissa did not take him out for a long time.
There were too many mice in Melissa’s house.（ ）3. Why did Melissa buy a house for Eric?
Eric did not sleep well in her room.
Eric needed more space for his toys.
Eric was too big to share a bed with her.
Eric did not always like to be with others.
items.explanation: 1. 由第四段可知，Eric 不喜歡貓，故選項 (A) 不正確；由第三段可知，Melissa和 Eric 一起住了超過五年，可推測 Eric 至少五歲，故選項 (C) 不正確；文中並未提及 Eric 喜歡和 Melissa 說話，故選項 (D) 不正確。故選 (B)。2. 由第四、第五段可知，Eric 是一隻狗，不是一隻貓。但是 Melissa卻買魚、牛奶和玩具老鼠給牠，把牠當成一隻貓在養，可知是用錯方式。故選 (B)。3. 文中未提及 Eric 是否在 Melissa 的房間裡睡不好，故選項 (A) 不正確；文中未提及 Eric 是否需要更多空間來放牠的玩具，故選項 (B) 不正確；文中未提及 Eric 是否太大隻而無法和 Melissa 共享一張床，故選項 (C) 不正確；而由第三段第三行可知，Eric 有時會想要獨處，所以 Melissa 才會買一間小房子給 Eric。故選 (D)。

items.explanation: Katie寫了封信給他的英語老師，而老師也回信給她。閱讀它們的信件並回答問題。親愛的Mr. Hu： 我們家三個月前從英格蘭搬到這裡。我的中文說的不好，而且大家都聽不太懂我在說什麼。我快要沒有信心了。 請您告訴我該怎麼辦？ Katie親愛的 Katie： 我很高興你讓我知道你的問題。下面幾種方法你可以試試：1. 你們班這個月會有「說故事時間」。每個人都要說一個故事。你也可以參與。我相信你一定會從中學到很多。2. 試著跟你的老師與同學練習中文；不用害怕。3. 可以跟 Nanako 與 Yu-kim 聊聊。Nanako 來自日本，而 Yu-kim來自韓國。它們或許可以給你一些建議。4. 一些外籍學生告訴我說看電視「快樂時光」這個節目蠻有幫助的；內容很簡單。 試試看這些方法是否對你有幫助；別擔心太多，我對你有信心。 Mr. Hu1. Katie 的問題是什麼？(A) 她修太多的課。 (B) 她想念在英格蘭的父母。(C) 她還無法熟悉新的語言。 (D) 她覺得老師太嚴肅了。Katie 寫給 Mr. Hu 的信中提到，她的中文說的不好，大家都聽不太懂她說的中文，故答案應選 (C)。2. Mr. Hu 試著提供許多方法幫助 Katie。下面哪一個在他的信裡沒有提到？(A) 每天寫一封信。 (B) 看電視節目。(C) 在課堂中講故事。 (D) 與其他外籍學生聊聊。Mr. Hu 在回信中提供了四種方法供 Katie 參考。但是其中並沒有「每天寫信」這個方法，因此答案應選 (A)。3. 「快樂時光」這個節目是說哪一種語言？(A) 中文。(B) 英語。(C) 日語。(D) 韓語。Mr. Hu 建議 Katie 可以看「快樂時光」這個節目來練習中文，所以可以推測這個節目是說「中文」，答案選 (A)。

items.prompt: （Robert and Danny are talking in their office.）Robert: I’m going on a vacation this summer.Danny: Where do you plan to go?Robert: Well, Jenny would like to go to Hawawa.Danny: It’s a great place for a family trip! And you’re taking the dogs on the trip again?Robert: Sure, that’s much more fun, isn’t it? Doris and David go everywhere with us. We’ve had great times together.Danny: How about the hotel? Do you have any idea of where to stay?Robert: We’ll stay at Hawawa Hotel. It opened this spring, and my parents went there once. It has many large rooms, but it’s not very expensive. And there are beautiful beaches around it. The best thing is that they allow dogs in the room.Danny: It sounds wonderful. Don’t forget to show me some pictures when you come back.Robert: No problem! everywhere 到處 allow 允許（ ）1. Which is true about Hawawa Hotel? (A) It is new and expensive. (B) It is a hotel with hot springs. (C) It is a hotel with nice beaches. (D) Its rooms are small but comfortable.（ ）2. Who are Doris and David? (A) Robert’s dogs. (B) Robert’s parents. (C) Robert’s children. (D) Robert’s friends in Hawawa.
choices: It is a hotel with hot springs.
It is a hotel with nice beaches.
Its rooms are small but comfortable.（ ）2. Who are Doris and David?
items.explanation: Robert 和 Danny 正在辦公室裡交談。Robert：我這個夏天要去度假。Danny：你打算要去哪裡？Robert：嗯，Jenny 想要去 Hawawa。Danny：那裡是家庭旅遊的一個好地方。那你們這次又會帶狗狗一起去玩囉？Robert：當然，這樣比較有趣，不是嗎？我們去哪都會帶著 Doris and David。之前我們玩的都很開心。Danny：那旅館呢？你們打算住哪裡？Robert：我們打算住 Hawawa 旅館。它是今年春天新開幕的，我父母去過那裡一次。有很多大房間，但不會很貴；而且附近還有漂亮的沙灘。最棒的是它可以允許帶狗進房間。Danny：聽起來真是太棒了。玩完回來後要記得給我看你的照片。Robert：沒問題！1. 關於 Hawawa 旅館的敘述哪個是正確的？(A) 它很新而且很貴。(B) 它是溫泉旅館。(C) 它是有沙灘的旅館。(D) 它的房間很小但是很舒服。對話中 Robert 曾提到 Hawawa 旅館附近有漂亮的沙灘（倒數第四行），所以答案應選 (C)。2. Doris and David 是誰？(A) Robert 的狗。(B) Robert 的父母。(C) Robert 的小孩。(D) Robert 在 Hawawa 的朋友。對話中 Danny 問 Robert 這次是否要帶狗一起去度假，Robert 回答「是，且 Doris and David 跟著他們去每個地方。」因此可推斷出 Doris and David 應是 Robert 所養的狗。

items.prompt: Daddy, When I told you I want to marry Mike, you said a 22-year-old girl is too young to get married. You also think it’s dangerous to marry a man I’ve known for only one year. But I don’t think so. I’m smart and old enough to know Mike loves me, and we’ve known each other well enough to start a family. Mike used to smoke a lot and wear long hair. But he stopped smoking because I hate the smell. He also cut his hair short because I don’t like men with long hair. Isn’t it great to marry a man who changes himself for me?Amy………………………………………………………………Amy, I think you’ve known Mike long enough as a friend, but maybe not long enough to marry him. You’re still young, and I hope you can take more time to understand him better. Mike’s changes show he cares about you. But you both should know love doesn’t really mean changing or even losing oneself. I’m worried about you because I love you. I never thought my little girl might leave me so early. But if you think you’re ready for a new life, I will see you off with smiles and best wishes.Daddy（ ）1. What is Amy trying to tell her father? (A) Mike is the right person for her. (B) Mike cares a lot about her family. (C) She feels sorry about breaking her father’s heart. (D) She thanks her father for what he has done for her.（ ）2. What can we learn about Amy’s father? (A) He has known Mike for over one year. (B) He will not let Amy leave him so early. (C) He thinks love means changing for another person. (D) He is afraid Amy has not thought carefully enough.（ ）3. What do we know from the reading? (A) Mike is too young for Amy. (B) Mike does not like a girl who smokes. (C) Amy thinks she is ready for a new life. (D) Amy loves Mike the way he used to be.
choices: Mike is the right person for her.
Mike cares a lot about her family.
She feels sorry about breaking her father’s heart.
She thanks her father for what he has done for her.（ ）2. What can we learn about Amy’s father?
He has known Mike for over one year.
He will not let Amy leave him so early.
He thinks love means changing for another person.
He is afraid Amy has not thought carefully enough.（ ）3. What do we know from the reading?
Mike is too young for Amy.
Mike does not like a girl who smokes.
Amy thinks she is ready for a new life.
Amy loves Mike the way he used to be.
items.explanation: 1. 由 Amy 寫給她爸爸的信可知，Amy 認為她可以和 Mike 共組一個新家庭了。這封信主要是要說服她爸爸，讓他認同 Mike 是適合她的人，故選 (A)。 2. 由爸爸回信的第二句，他覺得 Amy 還年輕，希望她可以再花多點時間了解 Mike，可推知爸爸擔心 Amy 可能考慮的還不夠仔細。故選 (D)。 3. 由 Amy 的信可知，Amy 認為她準備好組成一個新家庭，她認為自己已準備好展開新的生活，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: If you enjoy reading, don’t miss Shakespeare and Company when you visit the city of Paris. It is a famous English-language bookstore on the left bank of the river Seine. The first Shakespeare and Company in history was opened in 1919 by an American, Sylvia Beach. Ms. Beach did more than sell books. Her bookstore was also a library, and she even prepared beds for writers visiting there. Ms. Beach was not only kind to people but also good at choosing books, so her bookstore was often visited by writers like Ernest Hemingway and James Joyce. But in 1941, after the Germans took power in Paris, Ms. Beach was told to close her bookstore. In 1951, another American, George Whitman, opened in Paris another English-language bookstore, Librairie Mistral. Since then, just as Ms. Beach did, Mr. Whitman has also made his bookstore a library for people to borrow books, and a free hotel for writers to stay in. To remember Ms. Beach, Mr. Whitman changed the name of his bookstore to Shakespeare and Company in 1964, two years after Ms. Beach died. Next time when you are in Paris, don’t forget to visit this friendly bookstore, and see if you can spend a night there!（ ）1. About Shakespeare and Company, which is NOT talked about in the reading? (A) It sells books. (B) It prepares beds for writers. (C) It lends books. (D) It reads books to children.（ ）2. What do we know about Mr. Whitman? (A) He was Ms. Beach’s neighbor. (B) He used to work at Ms. Beach’s bookstore. (C) He has followed Ms. Beach’s ways of doing business. (D) He opened a bookstore in 1951 to remember Ms. Beach.（ ）3. Why was Ms. Beach’s business closed? (A) She was asked to leave Paris. (B) The Germans made her give it up. (C) Her business went from bad to worse. (D) She died.
choices: It reads books to children.（ ）2. What do we know about Mr. Whitman?
He used to work at Ms. Beach’s bookstore.
He has followed Ms. Beach’s ways of doing business.
He opened a bookstore in 1951 to remember Ms. Beach.（ ）3. Why was Ms. Beach’s business closed?
She was asked to leave Paris.
The Germans made her give it up.
Her business went from bad to worse.
items.explanation: 1. 由文章中提到 Ms. Beach did more than sell books. Her bookstore was also a library, and she even prepared beds for writers visiting there.（Beach 女士除了賣書之外還做了許多事，她的書店也是座圖書館，她甚至還幫造訪的作家準備床以便休息。），因此可以在莎士比亞書店裡買書、借書或休息，但是文中沒有提到唸書給小孩聽的服務，故選 (D)。 2. 文章中提到 Whitman 先生就像 Beach 女士一樣，也將他的書店經營成一座提供借書服務的圖書館，也是一間供作家們免費休息的旅館，可知 Whitman 先生的經營方式和 Beach 女士一樣，故選 (C)。 3. 由文中提到在一九四一年，德國人接掌巴黎政權之後，Beach 女士就被告知必須要關店，可知是德國人要Beach 女士放棄書店的，故選 (B)。

items.explanation: A-hui 下班回家，看到他的母親站在門口。A-hui：嘿，媽。你看起來好像在擔心什麼，發生什麼事了？Mrs. Liu：你妹妹還沒回來。她從來沒有超過五點半後還沒回家。A-hui：現在五點五十分了。你打電話到學校去問了嗎？Mrs. Liu：我打了。他們說Mei-ling四點半就走了。A-hui：那她的同學呢？我們應該打電話問他們。Mrs. Liu：我已經打給她五個同學了。他們都不知道她去哪裡。A-hui：我去拿腳踏車。我騎車出去找找看。Mrs. Liu：你今天晚上不是要跟女朋友吃飯嗎？你可能會遲到喔。A-hui：別擔心，媽。我等一下會打電話給她。找到 Mei-ling 比較重要。為什麼你不進屋子裡等呢？Mei-ling 可能隨時會打電話回家。Mrs. Liu：你說的對。我應該打給她其他的同學再問問看。騎車小心一點，好嗎？A-hui：我會的，媽。1. Mrs. Liu 在擔心什麼？(A) 她兒子在騎腳踏車。(B) 她女兒還沒回家。(C) 她兒子沒找到工作。(D) 她女兒在學校表現不好。在對話的第六行，Mrs. Liu 說她已打了五通電話問她女兒的同學知不知道 Mei-ling 的下落。因此答案應選 (D)。2. items.explanation: 1. 選項 (A)「Danny 豆植物的花朵為黃色」，文中僅提生病的葉子變成黃色；選項 (B)「Danny 起初是要栽種向日葵」，文中僅提他拿母親過去用來栽種向日葵的花盆來種豆植物；選項 (D)「有些 Danny 豆植物的花朵被蟲吃了」文中僅提蟲子到處飛舞。選項 (C)「Danny 第一次的種植失敗」，與七月六日的敘述相符，故選 (C)。2. 由七月一日的敘述「我在媽過去用來栽培向日葵的花盆裡種了一些豆子」 與八月一日的敘述「爸幫我把豆植物移到我家後院花床上」可知，花盆是老家，後院的花床是新家。故選 (B)。3. 七月二十日僅提到一棵生病的豆植物，七月二十八這棵豆植物死了，所以選項 (C) 有兩棵豆植物枯死是不對的。

items.prompt: http：//www.wordmuseum.comWord Museum Did you know the meaning of a word may change over time? Many English words we know now had different meanings a long time ago. One example is the word nice. Around the year 1300, nice was first used in English to mean ‘stupid.’ Two hundred years later, nice began to carry a “better” meaning. If people said a book was written nicely, they meant the book was written ‘clearly’ or ‘carefully,’ not ‘stupidly.’ After 1800, nice began to take its modern meanings like ‘kind’ or ‘friendly.’ Since then, people have thought of nice as a word with “good” meanings. A “good” change of a word’s meaning like this example of nice is called AMELIORATION. Though we don’t use nice to mean ‘stupid’ anymore, it is fun to know how much a word’s meaning can change from its start!※ For more examples of AMELIORATION, see next page. meaning 意思；意義（ ）1. Here are four sentences from the Word Museum. Which is most likely to appear on the next page? likely 可能 (A) The word silly used to mean ‘happy,’ but now it means ‘stupid.’ (B) The word terrific used to mean ‘terrible,’ but now it means ‘excellent.’ (C) The word girl used to mean ‘a young person,’ but now it means ‘a young woman.’ (D) The word telephone is cut short to phone, but the two words mean the same thing.（ ）2. What can we learn about the word nice? (A) It started to mean ‘clear’ around 1500. (B) It was first used in English around 1100. (C) It still keeps its old meaning that was used around 1300. (D) It was used to talk about an important person around 1800.
choices: The word silly used to mean ‘happy,’ but now it means ‘stupid.’
The word terrific used to mean ‘terrible,’ but now it means ‘excellent.’
The word girl used to mean ‘a young person,’ but now it means ‘a young woman.’
The word telephone is cut short to phone, but the two words mean the same thing.（ ）2. What can we learn about the word nice?
It was first used in English around 1100.
It still keeps its old meaning that was used around 1300.
It was used to talk about an important person around 1800.
items.explanation: 1. 選項 (B) 字義由 terrible（恐怖的；糟糕的）轉變為 excellent（優秀的），符合下頁可能會提供「轉佳」的例子。 2. 由第二段可知，西元 1300 年之後的兩百年，即西元 1500 年，nice 開始有「較好的；清楚的」意思，故選 (A)。

items.explanation: 1. 由前半句中的 magic place（不可思議的地方）和後句中提到可以做的事情，如have dinner at an ice table（在冰桌上享用晚餐）、watch movies in an ice chair（坐在冰椅上看電影）或 take a bath in a large ice box（在大冰盒裡洗澡），可知來自世界各地的人們在這個不可思議的 North Hotel 應該會「玩得很開心」，故選 (A)。 2. 由前句 Worried about catching a cold?（擔心著涼嗎？），以及後句的 North Hotel keeps you warm...（North Hotel一直讓你保持溫暖……），可推論來到冰屋的人們並「不需要擔心著涼的問題」，故選 (B) 。 3. 由前半句提到 not easy to tell you about everything here（說明這裡的一切是不容易的），以及後句中建議趕緊打包，可知是要人們親自來體驗冰屋的樂趣，故選 (B)。

items.prompt: (At the beach)Ben：Hi, Judy! I can’t believe you came to join us!Judy：Hello, Ben. I came because I like your idea： when you give, you’re rich. I’m happy that I can do something for the Earth.Ben：Right. That’s why we had this plan to get our clean beach back. Do you know if Paul’s coming? I remember he had the same idea and said he would try his best to come over.Judy：But he just called and said he wouldn’t come today because it’s too hot.Ben：I can’t believe it! He always says, “We can do this and that….”Judy：Don’t you know him? He only pays lip service to what should be done but seldom does anything.Ben：I see. Let’s forget about him. We’ll have Tony and Sophie to help us soon.Judy：That’s great. So where should we start now? Should we pick up those bottles first?Ben：Sure, let’s go.（ ）1. Why are Ben and Judy at the beach? (A) To go swimming. (B) To clean up the beach. (C) To have a beach party. (D) To learn about sea animals.（ ）2. What does Judy mean by saying Paul pays lip service? (A) He enjoys eating. (B) He is good at singing. (C) He talks a lot but does little. (D) He kisses people to show his thanks.（ ）3. Which is true? (A) Paul comes to the beach in the end. (B) Judy feels bad about going to the beach. (C) Ben is surprised to see Judy at the beach. (D) Tony and Sophie will not come to the beach.
choices: To learn about sea animals.（ ）2. What does Judy mean by saying Paul pays lip service?
He talks a lot but does little.
He kisses people to show his thanks.（ ）3. Which is true?
Paul comes to the beach in the end.
Judy feels bad about going to the beach.
Ben is surprised to see Judy at the beach.
Tony and Sophie will not come to the beach.
items.explanation: 1. 由對話內文第四行 Ben 提到 … this plan to get our clean beach back.（……計畫來找回乾淨的海灘。）可知，故選 (B)。2. 由上下文意提到 Paul 總是說：「我們應該做這做那的……」，但卻沒有任何實際行動可推測得知 pays lip service 指的應是「嘴上說得好聽；光說不練」，故選 (C)。3. 由對話內文第一行 Ben 提到 I can’t believe you came to join us! 可知，Ben 對看到 Judy 出現在海邊很驚訝，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: Small Rice, Big DreamCentral Taiwan NewsMay 13, 2008 Two years ago, a small town in Changhua started to grow healthy rice. The healthy rice was not grown by farmers but by students from a small elementary school of only about fifty people. The idea of growing rice came from the school teachers. When making teaching plans, the teachers decided to teach students how to grow healthy rice on school land. They wanted the students to get closer to the land and learn to help each other when doing the rice farming outside the classroom. What’s better, the school made money from selling the rice and giving farming classes to the public. With the money, the school could help students who wished to go to foreign countries some day. Today the dream is becoming real — the students are flying to Japan to share their special farming experiences, and have fun over there, of course! “We all feel very proud that even students from a small town can make themselves seen in the world,” said one of the teachers.（ ）1. What is the reading about? (A) A successful teaching plan. (B) A new way of cooking rice. (C) A language class for farmers. (D) A famous teacher from a small town.（ ）2. Which is said in the reading? (A) Farming makes students healthy. (B) Farming helps the school make money. (C) The school bought the land for the farming classes. (D) It is important for farmers to make good use of land.（ ）3. What is the dream? (A) Growing healthy rice. (B) Building more schools. (C) Visiting a foreign country. (D) Learning outside the classroom.
choices: A new way of cooking rice.
A famous teacher from a small town.（ ）2. Which is said in the reading?
Farming helps the school make money.
The school bought the land for the farming classes.
It is important for farmers to make good use of land.（ ）3. What is the dream?
items.explanation: 1. 由第二段的第二行可知這計畫是個教學計畫，又由最後一段可知這計畫非常成功，故選 (A)。 2. 由第三段開頭可知，種植稻米幫助學校賺到了錢，故選 (B)。3. 由前句「學校可以幫忙有朝一日想要出國的學生」以及後句「學生們將飛到日本去分享他們特別的種植經驗」，可知這個夢想指的是「造訪外國的國家」，故選 (C)。

items.explanation: 1. 由 Kirsten 第三段對話提及，書中的這位母親為了救她的兒子，選擇留下來對抗那些壞人，以及當她試著協助她兒子逃走時，她幾乎快被殺死，因此可知這位母親是盡全力救她的小孩，故選項 (A) 正確；書中的這位母親是和她的兒子一同去旅行，而非為了尋找她的兒子才展開旅行，故選項 (B) 不可選；殘忍對待這位母親的是一群瘋子，而非她的家人，故選項 (C) 不可選；書中的這位母親是幾乎快被一群瘋子殺死，而非已經死亡，故選項 (D) 不可選。 2. 由對話可知，Renee 將會到圖書館借書，且 Kirsten 的書也是從圖書館借來的，故選項 (A) 錯誤；很多人在等待借閱 The Travel，因此它是本受歡迎的圖書館書籍，故選項 (B) 正確； Kristen 覺得 The Travel 很棒，因此她喜歡這本書，故選項 (C) 錯誤； Renee 還沒看 The Travel，但她一直很想看，因此她已聽過這本書，故選項 (D) 錯誤。 3. 由 Kirsten 第三段對話可知，The Travel 這本書在描述一對母子在旅行的過程中被一群瘋子綁架並囚禁住，而母親為了救兒子差點被殺死；且 Kirsten 亦提及看到母親救兒子的過程讓她心碎，因此可推知 grim 是表示「殘忍的；恐怖的」，也就是會使讀者「感到難過的」，故選 (B)。

items.explanation: 1. 由句尾的 many times（許多次）及本句表達媽媽已經和我說過這故事好幾次了可知，說故事這動作是持續進行的，故用現在完成式，故選 (C)。 2. 表達「當時」媽媽正痛苦地忍受著，故用過去進行式，故選 (A)。 3. 本句描述過去發生的事情，因此須選過去式，而事情已發生，因此不可選 (A) would fall 用來表示過去時間裡未來可能會發生的事情，故選 (B) fell。 4. 作者得到這個名字 Stella 的這件「事情」已經發生，因此動詞需用過去式，故選 (A) 。

Allen 喜歡 Last Moment 的服務。下列哪一個是主要原因？(A) 它很舊而且很有名。(B) 它很快而且很方便。(C) 他有機會遇見新朋友。(D) 他會在生日的時候收到驚喜禮物。廣告中有提到「如果訂購物品的話，將會在當天或隔天送達。」而且「在網路上就可訂購，不用出門」，所以由此可推測出Allen喜歡Last Moment 服務的原因為「快又方便」，故答案選 (B)。

items.explanation: 1. 由整篇文章都在描述作者對於 Mary 的黃色洋裝有多麼地喜歡以及夢想可以得到可知，Every day from day to night I saw her in the dress so bright. 指的是「作者非常喜歡那件洋裝」，故選 (C)。2. 由詩中作者的父母哀傷地說著需要買食物、衣服給作者的弟妹可知，作者的家境並不寬裕，故選 (B)。

items.unit: 099年度第二次基測
items.prompt: When I was a child, I could not wait to see the world. I grew like the spring flowers in the garden. When I was a teenager, I could not wait to leave home. I did not want to follow any rules, and I was as angry as the burning sun in the summer sky. But then, I learned to think carefully before doing anything. Both good and bad things in the past became parts of my life, like autumn harvests for a farmer. Now I am old. My body is weak, but my mind has become strong and clear because of those experiences in my younger days. I am like a winter leaf, ready to take a good rest. These are the four seasons of my life.Elizabeth OwenJuly 10, 2010 harvest 收穫 leaf 葉子（ ）1. What does four seasons mean in the reading? (A) Four times of life. (B) Four parts of the year. (C) Four parts of the body. (D) Four kinds of weather.（ ）2. Which is most likely true about the writer? likely 可能 (A) She is wiser than before. (B) She has a strong and healthy body. (C) She enjoys growing flowers in her garden. (D) She tried hard to forget what happened in the past.
choices: Four kinds of weather.（ ）2. Which is most likely true about the writer? likely 可能
She has a strong and healthy body.
She enjoys growing flowers in her garden.
She tried hard to forget what happened in the past.
items.explanation: 1. 由文中作者將自己的孩童時期譬喻為春天、青少年時期譬喻為夏天、青少年時期過後譬喻為秋天，以及年老的時候譬喻為冬天可知，最後一句的 four seasons 是用來引申為「人生的四個階段」。2. 由文章第三段可知，作者學會凡事都先思考再行動，而到了老年時，作者心智變得透徹。因此可以判斷作者比以前更加有智慧。故選 (A)。

items.prompt: Dear Mom, I’m sorry that I can’t go back home for Mother’s Day next week. On that day, I’ll have to go to an important meeting for my boss, who helps me a lot with my work and life here. But I’ll find time to see you at home soon. Mom, thank you for everything you’ve done for Tim and me. After Dad died ten years ago, you had to work in a supermarket in the daytime and in a restaurant at night. But you always gave us two your love and care. Though you don’t have to work now, I still remember your coming home and feeling tired many evenings. Tim is going to finish his studies next month. He said he would move back from school and look for a job near home. I’m glad you won’t live by yourself anymore. Let’s plan to take a trip in the near future. It’s been years since the three of us took a trip together. Happy Mother’s Day. I love you, Mom.Best wishes, John（ ）1. What can we learn about John’s mother? (A) She lives by herself now. (B) She still works day and night. (C) She will make a plan to save money. (D) She used to be too busy to care for her children.（ ）2. What do we know from the letter? (A) John has two brothers. (B) John is unhappy with his boss. (C) John has to work on Mother’s Day. (D) Tim will leave home for his job soon.（ ）3. Which is said in the letter? (A) John’s father died at work. (B) Tim will look for a teaching job. (C) John bought a gift for his mother. (D) John hopes to take a trip with his family.
choices: She still works day and night.
She will make a plan to save money.
She used to be too busy to care for her children.（ ）2. What do we know from the letter?
John is unhappy with his boss.
John has to work on Mother’s Day.
Tim will leave home for his job soon.（ ）3. Which is said in the letter?
Tim will look for a teaching job.
John bought a gift for his mother.
John hopes to take a trip with his family.
items.explanation: 1. 由第三段「Tim 下個月將要完成他的學業了」，「我很高興您不用再自己一個人住了」，可推知 Tim 下個月才會回家和媽媽同住，所以媽媽現在仍是自己一個人住，故選 (A)。2. 由第一段頭兩句話可知，母親節時，John 必須代替老闆出席重要會議，故選 (C)。3. 由第三段倒數兩句可知，John 想要計劃個母子三人的旅遊，故選 (D)。

items.prompt: Here is a page of this month’s Lenses Magazine.Meet Our Contributors----------------------------------------------------------EDWARD FORD has been writing for us since 2008. Stories about his visits abroad are most popular with our readers. This month he writes about his vacation in an old castle and how scared he was during his stay there (p.34). Ford now lives in Lemon City, with his two dogs.----------------------------------------------------------HANNAH GIBSON believes “a good picture says a lot more than words.” This month her photos tell us the history of a six-hundred-year-old church on Orange Island (p.96). Gibson often flies between Lemon City and Apple Town.----------------------------------------------------------ALBERT LANCE started writing for TV shows in 2000 and today is one of the best-selling writers in the country. This month, he interviews Marianne Cruz about how she left the business world and became a world-famous dancer (p.102).----------------------------------------------------------BRETT SHAW is known for drawing for City Daily, Apple Town’s biggest newspaper. His pictures can be seen at www.brettshawdrawing.net. This month he draws for Ford’s trip (p.34). Shaw’s first picture book Catching Watermelons comes out this month.----------------------------------------------------------MAGGIE WALSH writes about movies in every Friday’s City Daily. Her writings can often decide how many movie tickets will be sold. This month, she tells us what makes a good action movie (p.28). Walsh also teaches at Apple Town Art School.-----------------------------------------------------------Lenses Magazine * May 2020【109教育補考】 magazine 雜誌 interview 訪問（ ）1. Which story is NOT covered in this month’s Lenses Magazine? cover 報導 (A) Someone’s life changes. (B) The past of an old church. (C) A trip to a foreign country. (D) The way to start a newspaper.（ ）2. What do we know about these five people? (A) One was a popular TV show actor. (B) One has been famous for writing children’s books. (C) One’s ideas about movies are important for those who see movies. (D) One’s writings started to appear in Lenses Magazine 20 years ago.（ ）3. What does contributors mean in the reading? (A) People who write, draw pictures, or take photos for a magazine. (B) People who decide where in a magazine to put writings, pictures or photos. (C) People who write letters to talk about a magazine’s writings, pictures or photos. (D) People who look for a job of writing, drawing pictures, or taking photos for a magazine.（ ）4. Which is most likely Brett Shaw’s drawing in this month’s Lenses Magazine? likely 可能 (A) (B) (C) (D)
choices: The past of an old church.
A trip to a foreign country.
The way to start a newspaper.（ ）2. What do we know about these five people?
One was a popular TV show actor.
One has been famous for writing children’s books.
One’s ideas about movies are important for those who see movies.
One’s writings started to appear in Lenses Magazine 20 years ago.（ ）3. What does contributors mean in the reading?
People who write, draw pictures, or take photos for a magazine.
People who decide where in a magazine to put writings, pictures or photos.
People who write letters to talk about a magazine’s writings, pictures or photos.
People who look for a job of writing, drawing pictures, or taking photos for a magazine.（ ）4. Which is most likely Brett Shaw’s drawing in this month’s Lenses Magazine? likely 可能
items.explanation: 1. 由全文可知，本月雜誌內容包括關於 Marianne Cruz 的生活改變、位於橘島上一座六百年之久的教堂歷史及 Edward Ford 造訪一座海外古老城堡的旅行等，但未包括「如何創辦一份報紙」，故選 (D)。2. 在對 Maggie Walsh 的簡述中提到她對電影的寫作評論經常能決定該部電影能售出多少張的票，可推知她的影評對經常看電影的人來說非常重要，故選 (C)。3. 由全文可知，Edward Ford 為雜誌寫稿、Hannah Gibson 提供雜誌照片、Albert Lance 為雜誌做人物專訪、Brett Shaw 替雜誌畫 Ford 的旅行插圖以及 Maggie Walsh 也是為雜誌寫稿，故選 (A)。4. 在對 Brett Shaw 的簡述中提到他在本月雜誌中替 Ford 的旅行畫插圖，而 Ford 此次旅行是前往一個令他害怕的古堡，故選 (D)。

items.prompt: Readers’ Words There are many fights in this thick book that you would see in a good action movie. In fact, the book has been made into a movie, but I’m just not interested. How would I enjoy the movie when the book didn’t touch my heart at all? I don’t mind reading about bad guys in a story. In fact, I don’t enjoy a book that has only good people who never do anything wrong, because it’s just not real life. But Lyle Heaton goes too far this time. I’ve read Heaton’s other books, and he is very good at writing about bad guys, but what is he trying to tell us by letting the bad guys in this book win everything in the end? Besides, you always have to guess who the “I” in the book is. Heaton changes it so often that sometimes you just don’t know who is speaking. You might feel a lot of things when you read Purple Star, but believe me, joy wouldn’t be one of them. (Alex)【109教育補考】（ ）1. What does Alex tell people about Purple Star? (A) They might have a difficult time when they read it. (B) They would enjoy it more if they read it a second time. (C) They must read Heaton’s other books before they read this one. (D) They would not find any other books that are as good as this one.（ ）2. What does Alex mean when he says Lyle Heaton goes too far this time? (A) There are too many fights in Purple Star. (B) Heaton keeps changing who the “I” is in Purple Star. (C) The bad guys win everything at the end of Purple Star. (D) The good people in Purple Star never do anything wrong.（ ）3. What can we learn about Alex from the reading? (A) He does not like to read thick books. (B) He seldom watches movies that are made from books. (C) He thinks a story without bad guys in it is not like real life. (D) He has decided to watch the movie made about Purple Star.
choices: They might have a difficult time when they read it.
They would enjoy it more if they read it a second time.
They must read Heaton’s other books before they read this one.
They would not find any other books that are as good as this one.（ ）2. What does Alex mean when he says Lyle Heaton goes too far this time?
There are too many fights in Purple Star.
Heaton keeps changing who the “I” is in Purple Star.
The bad guys win everything at the end of Purple Star.
The good people in Purple Star never do anything wrong.（ ）3. What can we learn about Alex from the reading?
He does not like to read thick books.
He seldom watches movies that are made from books.
He thinks a story without bad guys in it is not like real life.
He has decided to watch the movie made about Purple Star.
items.explanation: 1. 由文章倒數第二段描述，閱讀中必須不斷猜測書中的人稱「我」是指誰，因為作者更換太過頻繁，以致於有時候根本不曉得說話者是誰，可推知在閱讀 Purple Star 時，讀者可能會覺得有些吃力，故選 (A)。2. 由下一句中的「但他藉由讓本書中的壞人最終贏得一切是想要告訴我們什麼？」可知，Alex 雖然認為 Heaton 在撰寫壞人的部分很在行，但對於這樣的結局安排不是很認同，才會說 goes too far this time（這次太超過了），故選 (C)。3. Alex 在文章第二段第二句中有提到書中內容若只有從未做錯事的好人，也就是沒有壞人的存在，他並不會喜愛這樣的書，因為那不是現實生活中會發生的情節，故選 (C)。

Her articles often made them think whether they actually saw the same movie, but if they went to see it again, they experienced the movie in a whole new way.In her short life of 40 years, Rose has made her mark on the world of movies with her articles for Action! US. We are lucky to have had her in our lives. She was a very special person.Alex JacksonHead of Action! US【115教育會考】（ ）1. Why does Alex Jackson write about Rose Lacey? (A) Because she died. (B) Because she is very sick. (C) Because she is moving away. (D) Because she is leaving for another job.（ ）2. How did Rose Lacey and Alex Jackson get to know each other? (A) They met at a party. (B) They were relatives. (C) They worked in the same office. (D) They took a course on movies together.（ ）3. What is special about Rose Lacey’s articles? (A) They are important to movie makers. (B) They talk about movies from a fresh angle. (C) They give interesting information about actors. (D) They are good examples of how to write stories.
choices: Because she is leaving for another job.（ ）2. How did Rose Lacey and Alex Jackson get to know each other?
They worked in the same office.
They took a course on movies together.（ ）3. What is special about Rose Lacey’s articles?
They are important to movie makers.
They talk about movies from a fresh angle.
They give interesting information about actors.
They are good examples of how to write stories.
items.explanation: 1. 由第一段「帶著沉重的心情，我們在這裡向 Rose Lacey 告別」，以及第四段提及「在她短短 40 年的一生中」，可知作者是因為 Rose Lacey 過世而寫下這篇追念文，故選 (A)。2. 由第二段「Rose 和我在 2010 年第一次見面。當時我在一個派對上接我的妻子……」，可知兩人是在派對上認識的，故選 (A)。3. 由第三段提到「Rose 總是能從我們自以為熟知的電影中帶出新意」，以及她的文章能讓讀者「以全新的方式體驗這部電影」，可知其文章特別之處在於能從新鮮的角度探討電影，故選 (B)。

items.prompt: One summer evening when English cello player Beatrice Harrison was practicing in her garden, she was joined by a visitor she did not expect. The visitor was a nightingale. The small brown bird sang together with Harrison’s cello music, and the birdsong sounded like the piece she was playing. For the next few evenings, her visitor kept coming back, sometimes with several of its friends. Harrison decided that more people should hear the little singers. So, on May 19, 1924, Harrison worked with the BBC, the UK’s national TV and radio station, and played in her garden. At first, the artist was playing alone. Fifteen minutes before the end of her playing, the nightingales began to sing with the cello. The nightingale show was popular with radio listeners. It was repeated the next week, and for the next twelve years Harrison played on the radio with her garden friends. During this time, she got 50,000 fan letters. People called her “the Nightingale Lady.【115教育會考】（ ）1. Why was Beatrice Harrison called the Nightingale Lady? (A) She wrote songs about nightingales (B) She sang as beautifully as a nightingale did. (C) She taught nightingales to sing in a radio show. (D) She was famous for playing music with nightingales.（ ）2. Which is NOT used in the reading to mean the nightingale(s)? (A) Her visitor. (B) The little singers. (C) The artist. (D) Her garden friends.
choices: She sang as beautifully as a nightingale did.
She taught nightingales to sing in a radio show.
items.explanation: 1. 文章最後一段提到她和夜鶯一起在廣播中演奏了十二年，收到大量粉絲來信，可知她是因為「和夜鶯一起演奏音樂而聞名」，得到了「夜鶯女士」的稱號，故選 (D)。2. 第一段提到 Libby Larson 自清晨五點開始的一系列動作，以及在 Rolling Acres 的工作之一是展示餵食小羊，故選 (A)。3. 第二段後半部分 Libby 提到，她其實也會希望能睡晚一點，或去參加夏令營，因為忙於家族事業，讓她沒有時間和朋友結伴出遊，然而，Libby 在最後也提到，這份工作讓她和家人之間的感情更加親近。Libby 犧牲了休閒與社交時間，換來家庭的凝聚力，由此可知 making sacrifices 意指「放棄某些重要的事，去做另一件事」，故選 (D)。

Please help us get her back soon.Mr. Chang 8765-4321 July 4th---------------------------------------------------------Pet Found A big black dog was hit by a car and brought to City Animal Hospital. Maurice is quiet and needs only a corner in your room. It will be wonderful to have him in your family.Call 8888-5757 Joyce【109教育補考】 notice 告示（ ）1. What can we learn about Shibas? (A) They are big and tall dogs. (B) They are slow and shy dogs. (C) They need lots of space to move around. (D) Their hair color becomes black with age.（ ）2. What do we know from the four notices? items.explanation: 1. 由告示 For Sale 內容可知，Shiba 可成長為中型犬，生性快樂，並且喜歡在廣大的空地上奔跑和玩耍，因此可推知牠們需要許多空間來活動，故選 (C)。2. 由告示 Lost Pet 內容可知，是要請人協助尋找一隻名為 Vivi 的狗，再由聯絡人為張先生可知，他正在尋找他的狗 Vivi，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: A long time ago, there was an old king who had no child of his own. The king was worried that his land would fall into the wrong hands after his death, so he decided to pick a child in his land to take the high seat. One day, he called all the children to his castle and gave each of them a seed. “Come back on New Year’s Day and show me what you have grown,” he said to them, “and I will ＿1.＿.” Every child brought their seeds home carefully. One of the children, Wong, planted his seed in a pot. He gave it water every day and made sure there was sun to help it grow. ＿2＿. Then, Sung, the child of the richest family in the land, told people that a small plant was growing from his seed. He was ＿3＿. Everyone excitedly said that he would be king. Soon, one after another, more and more children were also saying that they had something in their pots. But Wong still didn’t find anything in his. On the big day, when Wong brought his pot to the castle, he saw all the other children carrying interesting plants. Some had flowers in the shape of a bird, and some had grasses of different colors. Everyone proudly showed their plants to the king, but the king looked unhappy until he saw Wong’s pot. “I boiled the seeds before I gave them out, so no plants could grow from them.” The king looked seriously at the children. “There is only one child who is ＿4.＿ enough to be king.” Ten years later, the king died. On his deathbed, he was not worried because he knew Wong would be a good king.【115教育會考】（ ）1. (A) give you a piece of good land (B) choose a person to be the next king (C) put the beautiful ones in my castle (D) decide who will work in my garden（ ）2. (A) But he lost his pot a few weeks later (B) Months passed but nothing grew from it (C) But soon the plant that grew from it died (D) The seed grew into a big tree in a short time（ ）3. (A) the last one to give up (B) the first one to share good news (C) the first one to bring his pot to the king (D) the only one to take good care of his plant（ ）4. (A) wise (B) strong (C) honest (D) popular
choices: give you a piece of good land
choose a person to be the next king
put the beautiful ones in my castle
decide who will work in my garden（ ）2.
But he lost his pot a few weeks later
Months passed but nothing grew from it
But soon the plant that grew from it died
The seed grew into a big tree in a short time（ ）3.
the last one to give up
the first one to share good news
the first one to bring his pot to the king
the only one to take good care of his plant（ ）4.
items.explanation: 1. 第三段 Sung 的植物長出來時，人們興奮地說 Sung 將會成為國王，由此可推知老國王告訴他們他會「選出一個人來擔任下一任國王」，故選 (B)。2. 第三段提到「Wong 依然沒有在他的盆栽裡發現任何東西」，可知這裡最有可能會說「經過好幾個月，他的盆栽還是什麼也沒有」，故選 (B)。3. 由本段後面提到「每個人都興奮地說他將會成為國王」、「一個接著一個，越來越多孩子也說他們的盆栽裡有一些東西」，可知 Sung 應該是第一個分享好消息的人，故選 (B)。4. 老國王告訴孩子，那些種子已經煮熟了，不可能種出東西來；而所有的孩子裡，只有 Wong 的盆栽是空的，表示他並沒有拿其他植物假冒。由此可知老國王會說只有一個人足夠「誠實」，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: NewPage will be ten years old on May 1, 2016. For more than nine years, many people have lived better lives because of NewPage’s help. Our plan for the coming year is to send love to children in poor families. The first part of this plan is to collect used clothes – shirts, pants, coats, and even school uniforms. If you have too many of these in your home, why not let us have them? What you don’t need can be wonderful gifts to these poor children. All clothes must be washed and cleaned. You can bring them to our office any day before April, or our workers can pick them up at your home if you give us a call first.～ Give away what you have. Give your love. ～91, Park Street, Santa CityTel：0800-919191【109教育補考】（ ）1. What does NewPage do? (A) It sells student uniforms. (B) It plans programs to help people. (C) It collects garbage from school. (D) It gives language tests to children.（ ）2. What does them mean in the reading? (A) Better lives. (B) Used clothes. (C) Poor children. (D) Workers in NewPage.
choices: It plans programs to help people.
It gives language tests to children.（ ）2. What does them mean in the reading?
items.explanation: 1. 由第一段第二、三句描述，許多人因為 NewPage 的幫助而過著較好的生活，且 NewPage 未來一年的規畫是要送愛給貧困家庭的小孩，因此可推知 NewPage 從事助人的活動規畫，故選 (B)。2. them 一般用以代替前述的複數名詞，在此指 many of these，也就是前一句提到的 used clothes，故選 (B)。

There could be a 54% drop in our food without their help.
They need to fight the Varroa Destructor to get enough food.
The lives of bees may be harder because of people’s need for land.（ ）3. What does it mean when someone is a culprit?
They try to fix something bad.
They are hurt by something bad.
They run away from something bad.
items.explanation: 1. 第一段第二句即提到蜜蜂對我們的重要性，在本段最後一句則是提到英國近二十年來蜜蜂數量減少的百分比，而第二段主要在描述蜜蜂數量為何比以前少的可能原因，全文只有「如何拯救蜜蜂」未談到，故選 (A)。2. 由第二段倒數第三、四句可知，愈多的土地被開發利用，愈多的植物跟著消失，也意謂著蜜蜂將無法找到足夠的食物，生活也就更加艱難，故選 (D)。3. 由下一句的描述，Varroa Destructor（瓦蟎）是種寄生在蜜蜂身上的小蟲，而且會慢慢地置蜜蜂於死地，即瓦蟎是使蜜蜂消失的起因，可推知 culprit 在此指造成壞事發生的人事物，故選 (B)。

items.prompt: 【115教育會考】 stir 攪拌（ ）1. Amanda wants to make fruit tea by following The Best Fruit Tea You Can Make at Home. She has several kinds of fruit in the kitchen: apples, bananas, oranges, papayas, pears, and strawberries. Which are some of the fruits she can use to make the fruit tea? (A) Oranges, papayas and pears. (B) Apples, bananas and oranges. (C) Apples, oranges and strawberries. (D) Bananas, papayas and strawberries.（ ）2. According to the reading, which is correct when we make the fruit tea? (A) Boiling water with sugar in it. (B) Making sure to take out the fruit. (C) Putting in the fruit and the lemon juice at the same time. (D) Leaving the teabags in the pot of hot water for 2 to 3 minutes.

Boiling water with sugar in it.
Making sure to take out the fruit.
Putting in the fruit and the lemon juice at the same time.
Leaving the teabags in the pot of hot water for 2 to 3 minutes.
items.explanation: 1. 由準備材料注意事項提到「木瓜和香蕉不適合（用來泡水果茶）」，因此刪除有這兩種水果的選項，故選 (C)。2. 步驟 2 提到「茶包放入那壺熱水中 2 到 3 分鐘」，故選 (D)。

items.prompt: The Chinese say, “If you’re bitten by a snake once, you’ll be scared by a rope for ten years.” I have my own experience of this.It 1. one night. I was cooking dinner, and at that moment, I really needed to go to the bathroom. Without turning the gas off, I quickly went to the bathroom. When I finished, I couldn’t open the door. “I can’t get out!” I shouted. I became worried that I 2. in a fire!“No!” I kicked the door hard but it didn’t move an inch. I turned around and saw hope. I hurried over to the window and pushed it really hard. 3. . I just couldn’t open it. I would have to break it. I started hitting it with the hardest thing I could find—a trash can.With a loud “BANG,” the window broke. “I’m safe!” I took in the fresh air happily. 4. , the cold wind woke me from my joy. I was on the tenth floor and there was no way to get down! I kept shouting for help. Luckily, someone heard me and called 119.Since then, I’ve never closed the door when I use my bathroom.【109教育補考】 gas 瓦斯（ ）1. (A) is all happening (B) all happens (C) has all happened (D) all happened（ ）2. (A) die (B) died (C) am going to die (D) was going to die（ ）3. (A) Then I found a useful tool (B) But luck was not on my side (C) Then things became easier (D) But I was too short to get to it（ ）4. (A) So (B) At least (C) However (D) For example
choices: Then I found a useful tool
But luck was not on my side
But I was too short to get to it（ ）4.
items.explanation: 1. 由第一段最後一句「我自己就有這樣的經驗」，可知第二段開始要講述這個自己過去發生的經驗，要用過去式，故選 (D)。2. 由句意可知作者是指「在那當下」開始擔心「即將死」於火災，要用過去未來式，故選 (D)。3. 由下一句「我就是打不開」可知雖然有窗戶可供逃生，但「幸運女神不站在我身邊」，故選 (B)。4. 由「冷風將我從喜悅中喚醒」可知與前一句「我高興地呼吸新鮮空氣」形成強烈的對比，故選 (C)。

items.source: 康軒 / 115上康軒國中英語題庫 / Database / Examine.mdb

items.prompt: Our dog Lassie hides under the bed every time the moon comes out. She has been ＿＿＿ for years, but we don’t know why.【115教育會考】(A) it(B) like this (C) like us(D) that
items.explanation: like 在此作介系詞，表「像……一樣」；this 則為指示代名詞，代指前面「躲在床底下」的行為或狀態，因此 be like this 表「像（前述）這樣」，故選 (B)。

items.prompt: I thought the girl ＿＿＿ was Kate, but it was her sister, Candy. They sounded almost the same.【115教育會考】(A) answered the phone(B) she answered the phone(C) who answered the phone(D) and answered the phone
items.explanation: 由後方已有主要動詞 was 可知空格為關係子句修飾先行詞 the girl，先行詞為「人」關係代名詞用 who / that，且在關係子句中作主詞時不可省略，故選 (C)。

items.prompt: Colorful goes on sale, starting from March 7th Ted Morrison, a blind singer, touched many hearts with Simple Mind, his best-selling album. His music is popular at home and abroad and is often used in movies. His new work, Colorful, is as great as ever. Here are four songs from the new album that mean the most to him.Let the Light Shine This song is about Ted’s father—he is always there and gives Ted hope in difficult times. Just like how Ted’s father makes him feel, this song can warm your heart.River Ted wrote this song to remember his mother. His mother’s face is what he misses the most since he lost his sight. This is the first time Ted plays the piano on an album.Winter Snow The idea of this song comes from Christmas holidays Ted spent with his grandparents when he was little. They are long gone but he wants to remember those days with the song.Across the Sea Just like New Land on Simple Mind, Ted’s wife joins him in this song. She wrote it to celebrate their love for each other.* Buy two CDs and save 10%! Until March 20th.* $5 from each sale will be given to the School for the Blind.【109教育補考】 album 音樂專輯（ ）1. What are the four songs about? (A) Ted’s family. (B) Ted’s holidays. (C) Ted’s younger years. (D) Ted’s love of nature.（ ）2. What can we know about Ted Morrison from the reading? (A) He was born blind. (B) He is not as popular abroad as at home. (C) He has often played the piano for his albums. (D) He has worked with his wife on his album before.（ ）3. What does the reading say about Colorful? (A) There will be a special two-week sale for it. (B) The four songs were written by Ted Morrison. (C) Some of the songs in it were written for a movie. (D) 10% of the money from each sale will be used to help blind people.
choices: Ted’s love of nature.（ ）2. What can we know about Ted Morrison from the reading?
He is not as popular abroad as at home.
He has often played the piano for his albums.
He has worked with his wife on his album before.（ ）3. What does the reading say about Colorful?
There will be a special two-week sale for it.
The four songs were written by Ted Morrison.
Some of the songs in it were written for a movie.
10% of the money from each sale will be used to help blind people.
items.explanation: 1. 四首歌分別談到 Ted 的父親、母親、祖父母及妻子等家人，故選 (A)。2. 由 Across the Sea 的簡述，可知 Ted 與他的妻子在他以前的音樂專輯 Simple Mind 中的 New Land 這首歌也曾合作過，故選 (D)。3. 由關鍵詞 starting from March 7th 及 Until March 20th 可知，Ted 的音樂專輯 Colorful 將有兩個星期的特賣活動，故選 (A)。

items.prompt: SEA GLASS: GLASS BOTTLES’ SECOND LIFESea glass is made from the magic of the sea. It usually comes from glass bottles that are thrown into the water. Each piece of sea glass looks different, and sea glass is often seen on art pieces. The pictures below explain how sea glass is born.Glass bottles are thrown as garbage into the sea.When these bottles ride the waves of the sea, they hit each other or other garbage in the sea and break into small pieces of glass.Pieces of glass are pushed by sea water and move along the sea floor. The sharp pieces slowly become rounder and rounder.After tens or hundreds of years in the sea, the pieces of glass grow an ice-like white color on the outside and become sea glass.Sea glass is finally pushed up to the beach. Artists collect pieces of sea glass and put them into their works.However, people now seldom use glass to make bottles and bowls—paper bowls and cups have become more popular these days. This means there are fewer glass items in the sea, so less and less sea glass will be found in the future.【115教育會考】（ ）1. Why does the title say “Glass Bottles’ Second Life”? title 標題 (A) People collect sea glass and use it to make new glass bottles. (B) People collect sea glass at the beach and use it to make wishes. (C) Glass bottles that are thrown into the sea become the homes of sea animals. (D) Glass bottles that are thrown into the sea become sea glass which is used in art pieces.（ ）2. According to the reading, how is sea glass made? (A) Sea glass becomes rounder after it is pushed up to the beach. (B) Colder sea water helps pieces of glass become sea glass faster. (C) Pieces of glass become white on the outside after many years in the sea. (D) Glass bottles break into pieces when they are dug out from the sea floor.（ ）3. According to the reading, why will less sea glass be found in the future? (A) People do not make as many glass items as before. (B) People have learned not to throw garbage into the sea. (C) Artists are using too much sea glass in their art pieces. (D) Waves are not big enough to push sea glass up to the beach.
choices: People collect sea glass and use it to make new glass bottles.
People collect sea glass at the beach and use it to make wishes.
Glass bottles that are thrown into the sea become the homes of sea animals.
Glass bottles that are thrown into the sea become sea glass which is used in art pieces.（ ）2. According to the reading, how is sea glass made?
Sea glass becomes rounder after it is pushed up to the beach.
Colder sea water helps pieces of glass become sea glass faster.
Pieces of glass become white on the outside after many years in the sea.
Glass bottles break into pieces when they are dug out from the sea floor.（ ）3. According to the reading, why will less sea glass be found in the future?
People do not make as many glass items as before.
People have learned not to throw garbage into the sea.
Artists are using too much sea glass in their art pieces.
Waves are not big enough to push sea glass up to the beach.
items.explanation: 1. 由 ①「玻璃瓶被當作垃圾丟進海中」以及 ⑥「藝術家收集海玻璃碎塊並將其放入他們的作品中」，可知原本被拋棄的垃圾玻璃瓶轉化為海玻璃並用於藝術創作，賦予了新的用途，故選 (D)。2. 由 ④ 提到玻璃碎塊在海中經過數十年或數百年後，外層會變成像冰一樣的白色，最後成為海玻璃，故選 (C)。3. 由最後一段提到「現在人們很少使用玻璃來製作瓶子和碗……這意味著海中的玻璃物品變少了」，可知因玻璃製品產量減少，導致海中形成海玻璃的來源也隨之減少，故選 (A)。

items.prompt: Ken is going abroad with a woman he met online, though he doesn’t know ＿＿＿ well.【115教育會考】(A) her(B) each other (C) any(D) another
items.explanation: 空格指的即是前句提到的「Ken 要一起出國的女性」，應用「她」來指稱，且動詞後應用受格，表單數女性的受格為 her，故選 (A)。
